sanskrit_iast: svayambhuve brahmaṇe viśvagoptre namaskṛtvā mantradṛgbhyas tathaiva | vivakṣur asmy ṛgvidhānam purāṇam purādṛṣṭam ṛṣibhir mantra dṛgbhiḥ ||
meaning: स्वयम्भुवे ब्रह्मणे विश्वगोप्त्रे नमस्कृत्वा मन्त्रदृग्भ्यस् तथैव | विवक्षुर् अस्म्य् ऋग्विधानम् पुराणम् पुरादृष्टम् ऋषिभिर् मन्त्र दृग्भिः ||
text_mt: Having bowed to Svayambhū Brahman, the protector of the universe, and likewise to the seers of the mantras, / I wish to proclaim the ancient Ṛgvidhāna, seen in the past by the ṛṣis, the seers of the mantras.

sanskrit_iast: mantrebhyo mantra dṛgbhyaś ca samāmnāyānupūrvaśaḥ | karmaṇām ṛṣi dṛṣṭānām vidhim provāca śaunakaḥ ||
meaning: मन्त्रेभ्यो मन्त्र दृग्भ्यश् च समाम्नायानुपूर्वशः | कर्मणाम् ऋषि दृष्टानाम् विधिम् प्रोवाच शौनकः ||
text_mt: Following the traditional order from the mantras and the seers of the mantras, / Śaunaka declared the rule for the rites seen by the ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣibhir vividhā mantrā dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭa prayojanāḥ | prayojanāya coddiṣṭās tasmiṃs tasmin pradarśitāḥ ||
meaning: ऋषिभिर् विविधा मन्त्रा दृष्टा दृष्ट प्रयोजनाः | प्रयोजनाय चोद्दिष्टास् तस्मिंस् तस्मिन् प्रदर्शिताः ||
text_mt: Various mantras were seen by the ṛṣis, having seen their purpose; / and stated for that purpose, they have been demonstrated in each respective case.

sanskrit_iast: nānārthāni ca karmāṇi śānti puṣṭy āśrayāṇi ca | siddhayaś ca tapo mūlāḥ śraddadhānasya kurvataḥ ||
meaning: नानार्थानि च कर्माणि शान्ति पुष्ट्य् आश्रयाणि च | सिद्धयश् च तपो मूलाः श्रद्दधानस्य कुर्वतः ||
text_mt: And the rites having various purposes, resting upon pacification and prosperity, / and the magical accomplishments have ascetic heat as their root for one who performs [them] with faith.

sanskrit_iast: stuty ādayo ye vikārāḥ pradiṣṭās tathā arthavādā rkṣu sūkteṣu caiva | yair yaiḥ kāmair ṛṣir devatāś ca tuṣṭūṣyante tān śṛṇuṣva ucyamānān ||
meaning: स्तुत्य् आदयो ये विकाराः प्रदिष्टास् तथा अर्थवादा र्क्षु सूक्तेषु चैव | यैर् यैः कामैर् ऋषिर् देवताश् च तुष्टूष्यन्ते तान् शृणुष्व उच्यमानान् ||
text_mt: The modifications which are taught, beginning with praise, and likewise the explanatory remarks in the verses and hymns, / by whichever desires the ṛṣi and the deities are wished to be praised—hear them being stated.

sanskrit_iast: āyuḥ svargo draviṇam sūnavaś ca caturvidham proktam āśāsyam agre | anye kāmāḥ śataśaḥ sampradiṣṭāḥ saṃstuvadbhir ṛṣibhir devatāś ca ||
meaning: आयुः स्वर्गो द्रविणम् सूनवश् च चतुर्विधम् प्रोक्तम् आशास्यम् अग्रे | अन्ये कामाः शतशः सम्प्रदिष्टाः संस्तुवद्भिर् ऋषिभिर् देवताश् च ||
text_mt: Lifespan, heaven, wealth, and sons: this fourfold [blessing] was declared first as to be prayed for. / Hundreds of other desires were also indicated by the ṛṣis praising the deities.

sanskrit_iast: siddhā mantrā vidhinā brāhmaṇasya phalam yacchanti vidhivat prayuktāḥ | satyam teṣām sādhanam samyamaś ca śamas titikṣā anasūyā damaś ca ||
meaning: सिद्धा मन्त्रा विधिना ब्राह्मणस्य फलम् यच्छन्ति विधिवत् प्रयुक्ताः | सत्यम् तेषाम् साधनम् सम्यमश् च शमस् तितिक्षा अनसूया दमश् च ||
text_mt: Mantras that have been mastered according to rule grant fruit to a brahmin when properly employed; / truth is their means of accomplishment, and restraint, tranquility, endurance, absence of envy, and self-control.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād dvijaḥ praśānta ātmā japa homa parāyaṇaḥ | tapasy adhyayane yukto bhaved bhūta anukampakaḥ ||
meaning: तस्माद् द्विजः प्रशान्त आत्मा जप होम परायणः | तपस्य् अध्ययने युक्तो भवेद् भूत अनुकम्पकः ||
text_mt: Therefore a twice-born, tranquil in mind, devoted to muttered recitation and fire offerings, / intent upon ascetic heat and Vedic study, should be compassionate to living beings.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyo bāhu vīryeṇa tared āpadam ātmanaḥ | dhanena vaiśya śūdrau tu japa homair dvija uttamaḥ ||
meaning: क्षत्रियो बाहु वीर्येण तरेद् आपदम् आत्मनः | धनेन वैश्य शूद्रौ तु जप होमैर् द्विज उत्तमः ||
text_mt: A kṣatriya overcomes his misfortune by the strength of his arms, / but a vaiśya and a śūdra by wealth, and the highest of the twice-born by muttered recitations and fire offerings.

sanskrit_iast: tapasā svargam āpnoti tapasā vindate mahat | tapo yuktasya sidhyanti karmāṇi niyata ātmanaḥ |
meaning: तपसा स्वर्गम् आप्नोति तपसा विन्दते महत् | तपो युक्तस्य सिध्यन्ति कर्माणि नियत आत्मनः |
text_mt: By ascetic heat one attains heaven; by ascetic heat one finds greatness. / For one endowed with ascetic heat whose self is restrained, rites succeed.

sanskrit_iast: vidveṣaṇam saṃvananam viṣaghnam roga nāśanam | yena yena artham ṛṣiṇā yad artham devatāḥ stutāḥ ||
meaning: विद्वेषणम् संवननम् विषघ्नम् रोग नाशनम् | येन येन अर्थम् ऋषिणा यद् अर्थम् देवताः स्तुताः ||
text_mt: Causing hatred, subjugation, destroying poison, and curing disease: / for whatever purpose the deities were praised by the ṛṣi for that specific object,

sanskrit_iast: sa sa kāmaḥ samṛddhaś ca teṣām teṣām tathā tathā | tāni karmāṇi vakṣyāmi vividhāni ca karmaṇām ||
meaning: स स कामः समृद्धश् च तेषाम् तेषाम् तथा तथा | तानि कर्माणि वक्ष्यामि विविधानि च कर्मणाम् ||
text_mt: that particular desire was fulfilled for each of them in that manner. / I shall speak of those diverse rites among rites.

sanskrit_iast: puraścaraṇam ādau tu karmaṇām siddhi kārakam | svādhyāya abhyasanasya ādau prājāpatyam cared dvijaḥ ||
meaning: पुरश्चरणम् आदौ तु कर्मणाम् सिद्धि कारकम् | स्वाध्याय अभ्यसनस्य आदौ प्राजापत्यम् चरेद् द्विजः ||
text_mt: Preparatory rite at the beginning, however, brings about the magical accomplishment of rites. / At the beginning of the repeated practice of daily Vedic recitation, a twice-born should perform the Prājāpatya penance.

sanskrit_iast: keśa śmaśru loma nakhān vāpayitvā āplutaḥ śuciḥ | tiṣṭhed ahani rātrau tu śucir āsīta vāg yataḥ ||
meaning: केश श्मश्रु लोम नखान् वापयित्वा आप्लुतः शुचिः | तिष्ठेद् अहनि रात्रौ तु शुचिर् आसीत वाग् यतः ||
text_mt: Having shaved head-hair, beard, body-hair, and nails, bathed and pure, / he should stand by day, but by night he should sit pure, restraining speech.

sanskrit_iast: satya vādī pavitrāṇi japed vyāhṛtayas tathā | om kāra ādyās tu tā japtvā sāvitrīm ca tad ity ṛcam ||
meaning: सत्य वादी पवित्राणि जपेद् व्याहृतयस् तथा | ओम् कार आद्यास् तु ता जप्त्वा सावित्रीम् च तद् इत्य् ऋचम् ||
text_mt: Speaking the truth, he should recite purificatory [verses] and likewise the mystic utterances. / Having recited them preceded by the syllable Om, and the Sāvitrī, the verse beginning with 'tat',

sanskrit_iast: āpo hi ṣṭha iti sūktam tu śuddhavatyo aghamarṣaṇam | śaṃvatyaḥ svastimatyaś ca pāvamānyas tathaiva ca ||
meaning: आपो हि ष्ठ इति सूक्तम् तु शुद्धवत्यो अघमर्षणम् | शंवत्यः स्वस्तिमत्यश् च पावमान्यस् तथैव च ||
text_mt: and the hymn 'āpo hi ṣṭha', the Śuddhavatī verses, the Aghamarṣaṇa, / the Śaṃvatī verses, the Svastimatī verses, and likewise the Pāvamānī verses—

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra etat prayoktavyam ādāv ante ca karmaṇām | āsahasrād āśatād vā daśa antam athavā japet ||
meaning: सर्वत्र एतत् प्रयोक्तव्यम् आदाव् अन्ते च कर्मणाम् | आसहस्राद् आशताद् वा दश अन्तम् अथवा जपेत् ||
text_mt: this must be employed everywhere at the beginning and the end of rites. / He should recite [them] up to a thousand times, up to a hundred times, or ending at ten.

sanskrit_iast: om kāram vyāhṛtīs tisraḥ sāvitrīm athavā ayutam | tarpayitvā adbhir ācāryān ṛṣīṃś chandāṃsi devatāḥ ||
meaning: ओम् कारम् व्याहृतीस् तिस्रः सावित्रीम् अथवा अयुतम् | तर्पयित्वा अद्भिर् आचार्यान् ऋषींश् छन्दांसि देवताः ||
text_mt: Or ten thousand times the syllable Om, the three mystic utterances, and the Sāvitrī. / Having gratified the teachers, ṛṣis, metres, and deities with water,

sanskrit_iast: prapadyeta virūka akṣam raudram mantra gaṇam japan | anāryair na ca bhāṣeta na śūdrair na api garhitai ḥ ||
meaning: प्रपद्येत विरूक अक्षम् रौद्रम् मन्त्र गणम् जपन् | अनार्यैर् न च भाषेत न शूद्रैर् न अपि गर्हितै ः ||
text_mt: he should seek refuge in Virūpākṣa, reciting the group of Rudra-mantras. / And he should not converse with non-Aryans, nor with śūdras, nor even with the censured,

sanskrit_iast: na rajasvalayā nāryā patitair na antyajair nṛbhi ḥ | na deva brāhmaṇa dviṣṭair na ācārya guru nindakaiḥ ||
meaning: न रजस्वलया नार्या पतितैर् न अन्त्यजैर् नृभि ः | न देव ब्राह्मण द्विष्टैर् न आचार्य गुरु निन्दकैः ||
text_mt: nor with a menstruating woman, nor with outcasts, nor with low-caste men, / nor with those hostile to gods and brahmins, nor with revilers of teachers and gurus,

sanskrit_iast: na mātṛ pitṛ vidviṣṭair na avamanyeta kaṃcana | maṅgala ācāra yukta ḥ syāt trir ahno abhyupayan apaḥ ||
meaning: न मातृ पितृ विद्विष्टैर् न अवमन्येत कंचन | मङ्गल आचार युक्त ः स्यात् त्रिर् अह्नो अभ्युपयन् अपः ||
text_mt: nor with those hated by mother and father; nor should he despise anyone. / He should be engaged in auspicious conduct, approaching water three times a day.

sanskrit_iast: ante dvādaśa rātrasya sthālī pākam prakalpayet | agnaye ca atha somāya tṛtīyām ca tayoḥ saha ||
meaning: अन्ते द्वादश रात्रस्य स्थाली पाकम् प्रकल्पयेत् | अग्नये च अथ सोमाय तृतीयाम् च तयोः सह ||
text_mt: At the end of the twelve nights, he should prepare a cooked mess of grain; / [offering] to Agni, and then to Soma, and a third to both of them together,

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevīm ca raudrīm ca juhuyād uttare tataḥ | avasānasya pataye tathā anumataye api ca ||
meaning: वैश्वदेवीम् च रौद्रीम् च जुहुयाद् उत्तरे ततः | अवसानस्य पतये तथा अनुमतये अपि च ||
text_mt: and then he should sacrifice the two subsequent [oblations], one to the Viśvedevas and one to Rudra, / to the Lord of the End, and also to Anumati,

sanskrit_iast: dhanvantaraya ity anyā gandharva apsarasām api | daśamī brāhmaṇaspatyā parā tu brahmaṇe smṛtā ||
meaning: धन्वन्तरय इत्य् अन्या गन्धर्व अप्सरसाम् अपि | दशमी ब्राह्मणस्पत्या परा तु ब्रह्मणे स्मृता ||
text_mt: another to Dhanvantari, also [one] to the Gandharvas and Apsarases; / the tenth is to Brahmaṇaspati, and the next is remembered for Brahman,

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatyai tathā viṣṇor antyā sauviṣṭakṛty api | ājya āhutaya eva ādau sthālī pāke hute punaḥ ||
meaning: सरस्वत्यै तथा विष्णोर् अन्त्या सौविष्टकृत्य् अपि | आज्य आहुतय एव आदौ स्थाली पाके हुते पुनः ||
text_mt: to Sarasvatī, and to Viṣṇu, and the final one is the Sviṣṭakṛt oblation. / There are offerings of ghee at the beginning, but once the cooked mess of grain has been offered,

sanskrit_iast: hutvā agnim tarpayed viprān śucir bhuñjīta vāg yataḥ | tataḥ śeṣam vidhānena śucir bhuñjīta vāg yataḥ ||
meaning: हुत्वा अग्निम् तर्पयेद् विप्रान् शुचिर् भुञ्जीत वाग् यतः | ततः शेषम् विधानेन शुचिर् भुञ्जीत वाग् यतः ||
text_mt: having sacrificed into the fire, he should gratify the brahmins; pure, he should eat, restraining his speech. / Then, pure, he should eat the remainder according to rule, restraining his speech.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrāṇām eṣa sarveṣām vidhir ukto anupūrvaśaḥ | prājāpatya atikṛcchrasya tathā sāṃtapanasya ca ||
meaning: कृच्छ्राणाम् एष सर्वेषाम् विधिर् उक्तो अनुपूर्वशः | प्राजापत्य अतिकृच्छ्रस्य तथा सांतपनस्य च ||
text_mt: This is the rule for all kṛcchra penances stated in regular order: / for the Prājāpatya penance, the Atikṛcchra penance, and the Sāṃtapana penance,

sanskrit_iast: parākasya ca kṛcchrasya vidhiś cāndrāyaṇasya ca | ekena śuddhim āpnoti dvābhyām pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: पराकस्य च कृच्छ्रस्य विधिश् चान्द्रायणस्य च | एकेन शुद्धिम् आप्नोति द्वाभ्याम् पापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: and the rule for the Parāka penance and the Cāndrāyaṇa observance. / By one he attains purity; by two he is released from sins.

sanskrit_iast: tribhir sidhyanti mantrāś ca mucyate ca upapātakai h | caturbhir bhrūṇahatyāyās tathaiva ayājya yājanāt ||
meaning: त्रिभिर् सिध्यन्ति मन्त्राश् च मुच्यते च उपपातकै ह् | चतुर्भिर् भ्रूणहत्यायास् तथैव अयाज्य याजनात् ||
text_mt: By three, mantras succeed and he is freed from secondary sins; / by four, from foeticide, and likewise from sacrificing for those unfit to sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhiḥ pātakaiḥ sarvair duṣkṛtaiś ca pramucyate | tapta kṛcchreṇa sarvāṇi pāpāni pratibādhate ||
meaning: पञ्चभिः पातकैः सर्वैर् दुष्कृतैश् च प्रमुच्यते | तप्त कृच्छ्रेण सर्वाणि पापानि प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: By five, he is released from all major sins and wicked deeds. / By the Taptakṛcchra penance, he removes all sins.

sanskrit_iast: cāndrāyaṇam saha ādy antam ebhi ḥ kṛcchraiḥ samam smṛtam | tribhiś cāndrāyaṇaiḥ pūto brahma lokam samaśnute ||
meaning: चान्द्रायणम् सह आद्य् अन्तम् एभि ः कृच्छ्रैः समम् स्मृतम् | त्रिभिश् चान्द्रायणैः पूतो ब्रह्म लोकम् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: A Cāndrāyaṇa observance, complete with its beginning and end, is held to be equal to these kṛcchra penances. / Purified by three Cāndrāyaṇa observances, one attains the world of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭābhir devatāḥ sākṣāt paśyeta varadās tathā | chandāṃsi daśabhir jñātvā sarvān kāmānt samaśnute ||
meaning: अष्टाभिर् देवताः साक्षात् पश्येत वरदास् तथा | छन्दांसि दशभिर् ज्ञात्वा सर्वान् कामान्त् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: By eight, he would see the deities directly, granting boons. / Knowing the metres by ten, he attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast: tryaham prātas tryaham sāyam tryaham adyād ayācitam | tryaham param ca na aśnīyāt prājāpatyam caran dvijaḥ ||
meaning: त्र्यहम् प्रातस् त्र्यहम् सायम् त्र्यहम् अद्याद् अयाचितम् | त्र्यहम् परम् च न अश्नीयात् प्राजापत्यम् चरन् द्विजः ||
text_mt: For three days in the morning, for three days in the evening, for three days he should eat unasked food, / and for three days further he should not eat: [thus] a twice-born performs the Prājāpatya penance.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekam grāsam aśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat | tryaham ca upavased antyam atikṛcchram caran dvijaḥ ||
meaning: एक एकम् ग्रासम् अश्नीयात् त्र्यहाणि त्रीणि पूर्ववत् | त्र्यहम् च उपवसेद् अन्त्यम् अतिकृच्छ्रम् चरन् द्विजः ||
text_mt: He should eat a single mouthful [each day] for three triads of days as before, / and he should fast for the final three days: [thus] a twice-born performs the Atikṛcchra penance.

sanskrit_iast: go mūtram gomayam kṣīram dadhi sarpiḥ kuśa udakam | eka rātra upavāsaś ca kṛcchraḥ sāṃtapanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: गो मूत्रम् गोमयम् क्षीरम् दधि सर्पिः कुश उदकम् | एक रात्र उपवासश् च कृच्छ्रः सांतपनः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, ghee, and water with kuśa grass, / and fasting for one night: this is remembered as the Sāṃtapana penance.

sanskrit_iast: etam eva tryahair yuktam mahā sāṃtapanam viduḥ | upavāsas tu sata aham śiśu sāṃtapanam smṛtam ||
meaning: एतम् एव त्र्यहैर् युक्तम् महा सांतपनम् विदुः | उपवासस् तु सत अहम् शिशु सांतपनम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: They know this very [rite] undertaken in three-day periods as the Mahāsāṃtapana penance. / But fasting for seven days is remembered as the Śiśusāṃtapana penance.

sanskrit_iast: tapta kṛcchram caran vipro jala kṣīra ghṛta anilān | pratitryaham pibed uṣṇānt sakṛtsnāyī saṃhāhitaḥ ||
meaning: तप्त कृच्छ्रम् चरन् विप्रो जल क्षीर घृत अनिलान् | प्रतित्र्यहम् पिबेद् उष्णान्त् सकृत्स्नायी संहाहितः ||
text_mt: Performing the Taptakṛcchra penance, a brahmin should drink hot water, milk, ghee, and air, / each for three days, bathing once [a day], composed.

sanskrit_iast: niyatas tu pibed apaḥ prājāpatya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | yati kṛcchram vadanty etad rapasām apanodanam ||
meaning: नियतस् तु पिबेद् अपः प्राजापत्य विधिः स्मृतः | यति कृच्छ्रम् वदन्त्य् एतद् रपसाम् अपनोदनम् ||
text_mt: Restrained, he should drink water; this is remembered as the Prājāpatya rule. / They declare this to be the Yatikṛcchra penance, dispelling sins.

sanskrit_iast: yata ātmano apramattasya dvādaśa aham abhojanam | parāko nāma kṛcchro ayam sarva pāpa apanodanaḥ ||
meaning: यत आत्मनो अप्रमत्तस्य द्वादश अहम् अभोजनम् | पराको नाम कृच्छ्रो अयम् सर्व पाप अपनोदनः ||
text_mt: Not eating for twelve days for one who is self-controlled and heedful: / this is the kṛcchra penance called Parāka, the dispeller of all sins.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekam hrāsayet piṇḍam kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet | upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇam etac cāndrāyaṇam vratam ||
meaning: एक एकम् ह्रासयेत् पिण्डम् कृष्णे शुक्ले च वर्धयेत् | उपस्पृशंस् त्रिषवणम् एतच् चान्द्रायणम् व्रतम् ||
text_mt: He should decrease by one mouthful in the dark half and increase by one in the bright half, / performing ablutions three times a day: this is the Cāndrāyaṇa observance.

sanskrit_iast: etam eva vidhim kṛtsnam ācared yava madhyame | śukla pakṣa ādi niyataḥ caraṃś cāndrāyaṇa vratam ||
meaning: एतम् एव विधिम् कृत्स्नम् आचरेद् यव मध्यमे | शुक्ल पक्ष आदि नियतः चरंश् चान्द्रायण व्रतम् ||
text_mt: He should perform this entire rule in the barley-shaped course, / restrained, starting from the bright fortnight, observing the Cāndrāyaṇa observance.

sanskrit_iast: caturaḥ prātar aśnīyād vipraḥ piṇḍān kṛta āhnikaḥ | caturo astamite sūrye śiśu cāndrayaṇam smṛtam ||
meaning: चतुरः प्रातर् अश्नीयाद् विप्रः पिण्डान् कृत आह्निकः | चतुरो अस्तमिते सूर्ये शिशु चान्द्रयणम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: A brahmin who has performed his daily rites should eat four mouthfuls in the morning / and four when the sun has set: this is remembered as the Śiśucāndrāyaṇa observance.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāv aṣṭau samaśnīyāt piṇḍān madhyaṃdine sthite | niyata ātmā haviṣyasya yati cāndrāyaṇa vratam ||
meaning: अष्टाव् अष्टौ समश्नीयात् पिण्डान् मध्यंदिने स्थिते | नियत आत्मा हविष्यस्य यति चान्द्रायण व्रतम् ||
text_mt: He should eat eight mouthfuls of sacrificial food when midday has arrived, / his self restrained: this is the Yaticāndrāyaṇa observance.

sanskrit_iast: yathā kathaṃcit piṇḍānām tisro aśītīḥ samāhitaḥ | māsena aśnan haviṣyasya candrasya eti salokatām ||
meaning: यथा कथंचित् पिण्डानाम् तिस्रो अशीतीः समाहितः | मासेन अश्नन् हविष्यस्य चन्द्रस्य एति सलोकताम् ||
text_mt:
In whatever manner, eating concentrated two hundred and forty mouthfuls
of sacrificial food within a month, one attains the world of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast: etad rudrās tathā ādityā vasavaś ca ācaran vratam | sarva akuśala mokṣāya marutaś ca ṛbhubhiḥ saha ||
meaning: एतद् रुद्रास् तथा आदित्या वसवश् च आचरन् व्रतम् | सर्व अकुशल मोक्षाय मरुतश् च ऋभुभिः सह ||
text_mt:
This observance the Rudras, the Ādityas, and the Vasus practiced,
and the Maruts along with the Ṛbhus, for release from all ill fortune.

sanskrit_iast: yāvakaḥ sapta rātram tu pātavyo niyata ātmanā | sthāna āsana triṣavaṇair japatā pāvanāni ca ||
meaning: यावकः सप्त रात्रम् तु पातव्यो नियत आत्मना | स्थान आसन त्रिषवणैर् जपता पावनानि च ||
text_mt:
Barley gruel should be drunk for seven nights by one who is self-restrained,
standing, sitting, taking three daily ablutions, and muttering purifying [texts].

sanskrit_iast: eka ekam sapta rātreṇa punāti vidhivat kṛtaḥ | tvag asṛk piśita asthīni medo majjānam eva ca ||
meaning: एक एकम् सप्त रात्रेण पुनाति विधिवत् कृतः | त्वग् असृक् पिशित अस्थीनि मेदो मज्जानम् एव च ||
text_mt:
Performed according to the rule, every seven nights it purifies one by one:
skin, blood, flesh, and bones, and also fat and marrow.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekam sapta rātram tu tvag ādīnām viśodhanam | ebhir vratair vipūta ātmā kuryāt karmāṇy atandritaḥ ||
meaning: एक एकम् सप्त रात्रम् तु त्वग् आदीनाम् विशोधनम् | एभिर् व्रतैर् विपूत आत्मा कुर्यात् कर्माण्य् अतन्द्रितः ||
text_mt:
Seven nights is the purification of each one, beginning with the skin.
With his self thoroughly purified by these observances, he should unweariedly perform rites.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭān kāmān tataḥ sarvān avāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ | kaṇa piṇyāka takrāṇām eka ekam śodhanam bhavet ||
meaning: इष्टान् कामान् ततः सर्वान् अवाप्नोति न संशयः | कण पिण्याक तक्राणाम् एक एकम् शोधनम् भवेत् ||
text_mt:
He then obtains all desired wishes, there is no doubt.
Broken grains, oil-cake, and buttermilk should each be a means of purification.

sanskrit_iast: śuddha ātmā karma kurvīta satya vādī jita indriyaḥ | evam śuddhasya karmāṇi mantrair vakṣyāmi tadyathā ||
meaning: शुद्ध आत्मा कर्म कुर्वीत सत्य वादी जित इन्द्रियः | एवम् शुद्धस्य कर्माणि मन्त्रैर् वक्ष्यामि तद्यथा ||
text_mt:
With a purified self, truthful in speech, his senses mastered, he should perform the rite.
I shall explain the rites with mantras for one thus purified, as follows:

sanskrit_iast: trirātram eva upavased āditaḥ sarva karmaṇām | trīṇi naktāni vā kuryāt tataḥ karma samārabhet ||
meaning: त्रिरात्रम् एव उपवसेद् आदितः सर्व कर्मणाम् | त्रीणि नक्तानि वा कुर्यात् ततः कर्म समारभेत् ||
text_mt:
He should fast for three nights at the beginning of all rites;
or he should observe three nights [eating only at night]; then he should undertake the rite.

sanskrit_iast: nitya prayogiṇām caiva prayoga ādau vratam tryaham | upariṣṭād upavaset kṛtvā vā sāmnipātikam ||
meaning: नित्य प्रयोगिणाम् चैव प्रयोग आदौ व्रतम् त्र्यहम् | उपरिष्टाद् उपवसेत् कृत्वा वा साम्निपातिकम् ||
text_mt:
And for those who regularly perform rites, there is a three-day observance at the beginning of the performance;
or having performed it, he should fast afterwards, or perform an accumulated penance.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣyāṇy eva karmāṇi matra yuktaḥ samārabhet | śaṃvatyaḥ svastimatyaś ca japeta trivṛtā ṛcaḥ ||
meaning: आयुष्याण्य् एव कर्माणि मत्र युक्तः समारभेत् | शंवत्यः स्वस्तिमत्यश् च जपेत त्रिवृता ऋचः ||
text_mt:
Intent on mantras, he should undertake rites that promote long life.
He should mutter the Śaṃvatī and Svastimatī verses threefold.

sanskrit_iast: araṇye ca udite sūrye diśam prāpya aparājitām | prācīm atha uttarām vā api śucau deśe samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: अरण्ये च उदिते सूर्ये दिशम् प्राप्य अपराजिताम् | प्राचीम् अथ उत्तराम् वा अपि शुचौ देशे समाहितः ||
text_mt:
And in the wilderness when the sun has risen, facing the invincible direction [the northeast],
or the east or the north, concentrated in a pure place,

sanskrit_iast: savāsāḥ saśirasko apsu snātvā abhyukṣya japed dvijaḥ | śuddhavatyas tathā abvatyaḥ pāvamānyo aghamarṣaṇam ||
meaning: सवासाः सशिरस्को अप्सु स्नात्वा अभ्युक्ष्य जपेद् द्विजः | शुद्धवत्यस् तथा अब्वत्यः पावमान्यो अघमर्षणम् ||
text_mt:
bathing in water with clothes on and immersing his head, sprinkling himself, the twice-born should mutter
the Śuddhavatī verses, and the Abvatī verses, the Pāvamānī verses, and the Aghamarṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: evam trir āplutya śuciḥ prāṇa āyāmānt samācaret | trīn ṣaḍ aṣṭau dvādaśa vā ṣoḍaśa aṣṭādaśa api vā ||
meaning: एवम् त्रिर् आप्लुत्य शुचिः प्राण आयामान्त् समाचरेत् | त्रीन् षड् अष्टौ द्वादश वा षोडश अष्टादश अपि वा ||
text_mt:
Having thus plunged three times, pure, he should practice breath controls:
three, six, eight, or twelve, or sixteen, or even eighteen.

sanskrit_iast: āśatād vāyamet prāṇān japan brahma aghamarṣaṇam | yāvad vā manasas tuṣṭis tāvat prāṇānt samāyamet ||
meaning: आशताद् वायमेत् प्राणान् जपन् ब्रह्म अघमर्षणम् | यावद् वा मनसस् तुष्टिस् तावत् प्राणान्त् समायमेत् ||
text_mt:
He should hold the breaths up to a hundred times, muttering the Aghamarṣaṇa sacred text,
or he should hold the breaths as long as the satisfaction of his mind lasts.

sanskrit_iast: yathā yathā manas tasya duṣkṛtam karma garhati | tathā tathā śarīram tat tena adharmeṇa mucyate ||
meaning: यथा यथा मनस् तस्य दुष्कृतम् कर्म गर्हति | तथा तथा शरीरम् तत् तेन अधर्मेण मुच्यते ||
text_mt:
In whatever measure his mind blames an evil deed,
in that measure is that body freed from that unrighteousness.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇa āyāmair dagdha doṣaḥ śukla ambara dharaḥ śuciḥ | yathā vidhy apa ācamya ārohed dharma prastaram ||
meaning: प्राण आयामैर् दग्ध दोषः शुक्ल अम्बर धरः शुचिः | यथा विध्य् अप आचम्य आरोहेद् धर्म प्रस्तरम् ||
text_mt:
With faults burnt away through breath controls, wearing white garments, pure,
having sipped water according to rule, he should step onto the sacred grass mat.

sanskrit_iast: pavitra pāṇiḥ kṛtvā tu upastham dakṣiṇa uttaram | diśor eva antaram prekṣya animiṣam chādya cakṣuṣī ||
meaning: पवित्र पाणिः कृत्वा तु उपस्थम् दक्षिण उत्तरम् | दिशोर् एव अन्तरम् प्रेक्ष्य अनिमिषम् छाद्य चक्षुषी ||
text_mt:
Holding a purifier in his hand, placing the right [foot] on the upper [thigh],
looking only between the directions, unblinking, having shaded his eyes,

sanskrit_iast: om kārma vyāhṛtīs tisraḥ sāvitrīm ca tad ity ṛcam | manasā etā anudrutya veda ādim samupakamet ||
meaning: ओम् कार्म व्याहृतीस् तिस्रः सावित्रीम् च तद् इत्य् ऋचम् | मनसा एता अनुद्रुत्य वेद आदिम् समुपकमेत् ||
text_mt:
having mentally repeated the syllable Om, the three mystic utterances,
and the Sāvitrī verse beginning with 'tat', he should undertake the beginning of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: mandram eva paṭhet prātar uccair madhyaṃdine paṭhet | uccair eva apara ahne tu saṃdhyā kāla upāramet ||
meaning: मन्द्रम् एव पठेत् प्रातर् उच्चैर् मध्यंदिने पठेत् | उच्चैर् एव अपर अह्ने तु संध्या काल उपारमेत् ||
text_mt:
He should recite in a low voice in the morning, aloud at midday;
and aloud in the afternoon, but he should stop at twilight.

sanskrit_iast: brāhme muhūrte ca utthāya trir āplutya paṭhed dvijaḥ | madhyamām vṛttim āsthāya na drutām na vilambitām ||
meaning: ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते च उत्थाय त्रिर् आप्लुत्य पठेद् द्विजः | मध्यमाम् वृत्तिम् आस्थाय न द्रुताम् न विलम्बिताम् ||
text_mt:
Rising at the hour of Brahman and plunging three times, the twice-born should recite,
adopting a middle pace, neither hurried nor drawn out.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvām saṃdhyām japais tiṣṭhed upāsīta ca paścimām | na ca antarā vyāhareta viramed vā kathaṃcana ||
meaning: पूर्वाम् संध्याम् जपैस् तिष्ठेद् उपासीत च पश्चिमाम् | न च अन्तरा व्याहरेत विरमेद् वा कथंचन ||
text_mt:
He should stand muttering through the morning twilight, and sit through the evening [twilight];
he should not speak in between nor pause in any way.

sanskrit_iast: viramed brāhmaṇe prāpte kāmam tena tu saṃvadet | śūdram dṛṣṭvā eva samprāptam na adhīyīta kathaṃcana ||
meaning: विरमेद् ब्राह्मणे प्राप्ते कामम् तेन तु संवदेत् | शूद्रम् दृष्ट्वा एव सम्प्राप्तम् न अधीयीत कथंचन ||
text_mt:
He should pause if a brahmin arrives, and he may speak with him as he wishes;
but having seen a śūdra arrive, he must by no means recite.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam sūktam ādyam tu mukhyam brahma ṛṣi sammatam | rāyas poṣa karam dhanyam japan vipro artham āpnuyāt ||
meaning: आग्नेयम् सूक्तम् आद्यम् तु मुख्यम् ब्रह्म ऋषि सम्मतम् | रायस् पोष करम् धन्यम् जपन् विप्रो अर्थम् आप्नुयात् ||
text_mt:
The first hymn addressed to Agni is foremost, approved by the seers of the Veda;
it produces increase of wealth and brings prosperity; muttering it, a brahmin obtains wealth.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣim sarvam idam japtvā saputam niyata ḥ śuciḥ | saṃhitā phalam āpnoti ṛgvedasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: ऋषिम् सर्वम् इदम् जप्त्वा सपुतम् नियत ः शुचिः | संहिता फलम् आप्नोति ऋग्वेदस्य न संशयः ||
text_mt:
Having muttered this entire hymn of the ṛṣi, purified, self-restrained, and clean,
he obtains the fruit of the Ṛgveda Saṃhitā, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa guṇam hy etaj japan brahma sanātanam | sarvān kāmān avāpnoti pāpaiś ca parimucyate ||
meaning: एकादश गुणम् ह्य् एतज् जपन् ब्रह्म सनातनम् | सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति पापैश् च परिमुच्यते ||
text_mt:
For, muttering this eternal sacred text eleven times,
he obtains all desires and is completely freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast: anaśnan saṃhitām etām prātaḥ prātar dine dine | āyur vidhyām dhanam putrān gṛhāṃś ca āpnoty anāmayān ||
meaning: अनश्नन् संहिताम् एताम् प्रातः प्रातर् दिने दिने | आयुर् विध्याम् धनम् पुत्रान् गृहांश् च आप्नोत्य् अनामयान् ||
text_mt:
Without eating, [muttering] this collection every morning day after day,
he obtains long life, knowledge, wealth, sons, and disease-free homes.

sanskrit_iast: etad brahma japan śūdrān na īkṣeta anyāṃś ca tadvidhān | prekṣya ācamya udakam pūtaḥ paśyed gām agni bhāskarau ||
meaning: एतद् ब्रह्म जपन् शूद्रान् न ईक्षेत अन्यांश् च तद्विधान् | प्रेक्ष्य आचम्य उदकम् पूतः पश्येद् गाम् अग्नि भास्करौ ||
text_mt:
While muttering this sacred text, he should not look at śūdras or others like them.
If he looks, having sipped water, purified, he should look at a cow, fire, and the sun.

sanskrit_iast: mandram japo daśa guṇa upāṃśu syāt śata anvitaḥ | sahasram mānasam vidyād eṣa japya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: मन्द्रम् जपो दश गुण उपांशु स्यात् शत अन्वितः | सहस्रम् मानसम् विद्याद् एष जप्य विधिः स्मृतः ||
text_mt:
A muttered recitation in a low voice is tenfold; a whispered one is a hundredfold;
one should know that a mental one is a thousandfold: this is recorded as the rule of muttering.

sanskrit_iast: ādāv eva tu sāvitryā karma kurvīta śāntaye | puṣṭaye dhana lābhāya paśu lābhāya bhūtaye ||
meaning: आदाव् एव तु सावित्र्या कर्म कुर्वीत शान्तये | पुष्टये धन लाभाय पशु लाभाय भूतये ||
text_mt:
Right at the beginning, he should perform the rite with the Sāvitrī for pacification,
for prosperity, for obtaining wealth, for obtaining cattle, and for welfare.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā hi sammitā vedaiḥ sarva brahmamaī nicṛt | ugreṇa tapasā dṛṣṭā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ||
meaning: एषा हि सम्मिता वेदैः सर्व ब्रह्ममई निचृत् | उग्रेण तपसा दृष्टा विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ||
text_mt:
For it is equal to the Vedas, consists of all the sacred text, in the nicṛt meter,
seen through fierce ascetic heat by the wise Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit_iast: homāṃś ca japa yajñāṃś ca nityam kurvīta ca etayā | sarva kāma samṛddhy artham param braham idam ucyate ||
meaning: होमांश् च जप यज्ञांश् च नित्यम् कुर्वीत च एतया | सर्व काम समृद्ध्य् अर्थम् परम् ब्रहम् इदम् उच्यते ||
text_mt:
With this he should constantly perform fire offerings and sacrifices of muttered recitation
for the fulfillment of all desires; this is called the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā eva pratiloma uktā pacchaḥ śatru vināśinī | akṣara pratilomā iyam abhicāreṣu śasyate ||
meaning: एषा एव प्रतिलोम उक्ता पच्छः शत्रु विनाशिनी | अक्षर प्रतिलोमा इयम् अभिचारेषु शस्यते ||
text_mt:
When recited backward quarter-verse by quarter-verse, it destroys enemies;
[recited] backward syllable by syllable, it is recommended in malevolent sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: akṣara pratikomā iyam yasmin yujyeta karmaṇi | tad amogham vijānīyād etad vai brahmaṇo balam ||
meaning: अक्षर प्रतिकोमा इयम् यस्मिन् युज्येत कर्मणि | तद् अमोघम् विजानीयाद् एतद् वै ब्रह्मणो बलम् ||
text_mt:
In whatever rite this [verse] is employed backward syllable by syllable,
he should know that it is unfailing: such indeed is the power of the sacred text.

sanskrit_iast: vyāghātaka idhma samidho akṣara pratilomayā | juhuyāt sārṣapam tailam vaibhītaka kṛta srucā ||
meaning: व्याघातक इध्म समिधो अक्षर प्रतिलोमया | जुहुयात् सार्षपम् तैलम् वैभीतक कृत स्रुचा ||
text_mt:
With firewood kindling of vyāghātaka, [reciting] it backward syllable by syllable,
he should offer mustard oil with a ladle made of vibhītaka wood.

sanskrit_iast: ya icchet pīḍanam śatror api vā uccāṭanam punaḥ | pacchaḥ sampīḍayet śatrūn varṇaśaś ca pramāpayet ||
meaning: य इच्छेत् पीडनम् शत्रोर् अपि वा उच्चाटनम् पुनः | पच्छः सम्पीडयेत् शत्रून् वर्णशश् च प्रमापयेत् ||
text_mt:
If he wishes the affliction of an enemy, or again his expulsion:
quarter-verse by quarter-verse he torments enemies, and syllable by syllable he destroys them.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgveda ādya sūktasya vidhim vakṣyāmy ataḥ param | yathā ṛṣir madhucchandāḥ karma etena akarot purā ||
meaning: ऋग्वेद आद्य सूक्तस्य विधिम् वक्ष्याम्य् अतः परम् | यथा ऋषिर् मधुच्छन्दाः कर्म एतेन अकरोत् पुरा ||
text_mt:
Hereafter I shall explain the rule for the first hymn of the Ṛgveda,
as the ṛṣi Madhucchandas performed a rite with it of old.

sanskrit_iast: śirasā dhārayed agnim niyataḥ parivatsaram | caturtha prāṇa kālīyo huta śiṣṭam adan haviḥ ||
meaning: शिरसा धारयेद् अग्निम् नियतः परिवत्सरम् | चतुर्थ प्राण कालीयो हुत शिष्टम् अदन् हविः ||
text_mt:
Self-restrained, he should carry the fire on his head for a full year,
eating at every fourth mealtime sacrificial food left over from offerings.

sanskrit_iast: juhvat trir upatiṣṭheta satya vādī dine dine | vrata kāle tu samprāpta āgneyam nirvapec carutm ||
meaning: जुह्वत् त्रिर् उपतिष्ठेत सत्य वादी दिने दिने | व्रत काले तु सम्प्राप्त आग्नेयम् निर्वपेच् चरुत्म् ||
text_mt:
Offering oblations, he should worship three times [a day], truthful in speech, day after day;
and when the time of the observance is reached, he should distribute an oblation of boiled rice to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: anagnau dhyāta mātro agnir vrata ante asya upatiṣṭhati | daheyam iti yam cecchettam dahaty eva pāvakaḥ ||
meaning: अनग्नौ ध्यात मात्रो अग्निर् व्रत अन्ते अस्य उपतिष्ठति | दहेयम् इति यम् चेच्छेत्तम् दहत्य् एव पावकः ||
text_mt:
At the end of his observance, the fire attends upon him merely upon being meditated upon, even without physical fire;
and whomever he wishes, saying 'May I burn him,' that person the Fire burns indeed.

sanskrit_iast: apsv apy agnir jvalaty eva tad vratasya mahātmanaḥ | samardhayati tam ca iṣṭaiḥ kāmair vahniḥ prayatnataḥ ||
meaning: अप्स्व् अप्य् अग्निर् ज्वलत्य् एव तद् व्रतस्य महात्मनः | समर्धयति तम् च इष्टैः कामैर् वह्निः प्रयत्नतः ||
text_mt:
Even in waters the fire blazes up for that great-souled man of such observance,
and the Fire eagerly fulfills him with his desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast: ataḥ param tṛcāḥ sapta vāyv ādyā ye prakīrtitāḥ | tān japan prayato nityam iṣṭān kāmānt samaśnute ||
meaning: अतः परम् तृचाः सप्त वाय्व् आद्या ये प्रकीर्तिताः | तान् जपन् प्रयतो नित्यम् इष्टान् कामान्त् समश्नुते ||
text_mt:
Hereafter, the seven triplets beginning with Vāyu which have been proclaimed:
muttering them constantly with self-control, he attains his desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast: medhātithāv ṛṣau punaḥ sadasas patim ity ṛcam | medhā kāmo japen nityam juhuyāt ca ājyam etayā ||
meaning: मेधातिथाव् ऋषौ पुनः सदसस् पतिम् इत्य् ऋचम् | मेधा कामो जपेन् नित्यम् जुहुयात् च आज्यम् एतया ||
text_mt:
Further, in the [hymn] whose ṛṣi is Medhātithi, [with] the verse 'sadasas patim',
one desiring mental brilliance should constantly mutter and offer clarified butter with it.

sanskrit_iast: syonā iti pṛthivīm nityam snātvā vipraḥ śucir japet | vindate mahatīm bhūmim asapatnām akaṇṭakām ||
meaning: स्योना इति पृथिवीम् नित्यम् स्नात्वा विप्रः शुचिर् जपेत् | विन्दते महतीम् भूमिम् असपत्नाम् अकण्टकाम् ||
text_mt:
Having bathed, a pure brahmin should constantly mutter [the hymn to] the Earth, beginning with 'syonā';
he obtains great land, without rivals and without obstacles.

sanskrit_iast: idam viṣṇur iti imābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śrāddha karmaṇi | aṅguṣṭham anne avagāhya tena rakṣāṃsi bādhate ||
meaning: इदम् विष्णुर् इति इमाभिः पञ्चभिः श्राद्ध कर्मणि | अङ्गुष्ठम् अन्ने अवगाह्य तेन रक्षांसि बाधते ||
text_mt:
In the ancestral rite, with these five [verses] beginning with 'idam viṣṇuḥ',
plunging his thumb into the food, through that he keeps off the rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast: sapta janma kṛtam pāpam kṛtvā ca abhakṣya bhakṣaṇam | tad viṣṇor ity apām madhye sakṛj japtvā viśudhyati ||
meaning: सप्त जन्म कृतम् पापम् कृत्वा च अभक्ष्य भक्षणम् | तद् विष्णोर् इत्य् अपाम् मध्ये सकृज् जप्त्वा विशुध्यति ||
text_mt: Having committed a sin done across seven births, and having eaten inedible food, / he is purified by reciting once in the middle of water: 'That [step] of Viṣṇu' (tad viṣṇoḥ).

sanskrit_iast: ambayo yanti yā proktā navarcas tv abhiṣecanīḥ | āyuṣyās tāḥ pariproktā bhaiṣajyāḥ pāpa mocanīḥ ||
meaning: अम्बयो यन्ति या प्रोक्ता नवर्चस् त्व् अभिषेचनीः | आयुष्यास् ताः परिप्रोक्ता भैषज्याः पाप मोचनीः ||
text_mt: The nine verses proclaimed as 'the mothers go' (ambayo yanti) are used for consecration; / they are declared to bring long life, to be curative, and to free from sin.

sanskrit_iast: śunahśepam ṛṣim baddhaḥ samniruddho athavā japet | mucyate sarva pāśebhyo gadī ca apy agadī bhavet ||
meaning: शुनह्शेपम् ऋषिम् बद्धः सम्निरुद्धो अथवा जपेत् | मुच्यते सर्व पाशेभ्यो गदी च अप्य् अगदी भवेत् ||
text_mt: One who is bound or imprisoned should recite the [hymns of the] ṛṣi Śunahśepa; / he is freed from all bonds, and a sick man becomes healthy.

sanskrit_iast: ya icchet śāśvatān kāmān indrāt prāptum puraṃdarāt | sa ṣoḍaśabhir eva ṛgbhir indram stūyād dine dine ||
meaning: य इच्छेत् शाश्वतान् कामान् इन्द्रात् प्राप्तुम् पुरंदरात् | स षोडशभिर् एव ऋग्भिर् इन्द्रम् स्तूयाद् दिने दिने ||
text_mt: One who desires to attain eternal wishes from Indra Puraṃdara / should praise Indra day after day with sixteen verses.

sanskrit_iast: hairaṇyastūpam indrasya sūktam karma abhisaṃstavam | taj japan prayataḥ śatrūn ayatnāt pratibādhate ||
meaning: हैरण्यस्तूपम् इन्द्रस्य सूक्तम् कर्म अभिसंस्तवम् | तज् जपन् प्रयतः शत्रून् अयत्नात् प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: Reciting with self-restraint the hymn of Indra by Hiraṇyastūpa, which praises his deeds, / he repels enemies without effort.

sanskrit_iast: ākṛṣṇena ity ṛcā tv eva yo nityam sūryam arcati | prātar madhye astagam vā api sa jīved agadaḥ sukhī ||
meaning: आकृष्णेन इत्य् ऋचा त्व् एव यो नित्यम् सूर्यम् अर्चति | प्रातर् मध्ये अस्तगम् वा अपि स जीवेद् अगदः सुखी ||
text_mt: He who constantly worships the sun with the verse 'through the dark space' (ā kṛṣṇena), / at morning, noon, or when it has set, will live healthy and happy.

sanskrit_iast: ākṛṣṇena ity ṛcam tv ekām dhyāyan niśi diva okasaḥ | agnau hutvā etayā ca ājyam dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: आकृष्णेन इत्य् ऋचम् त्व् एकाम् ध्यायन् निशि दिव ओकसः | अग्नौ हुत्वा एतया च आज्यम् दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Meditating on the single verse 'through the dark space' (ā kṛṣṇena) at night, [mindful of] the celestial dwellers, / and offering clarified butter in the fire with it, one attains a long life.

sanskrit_iast: ye te panthā iti imām tu sāvitrīm adhvago abhyaset | svastimān vrajate adhvānam gṛhāṃś ca āpnoty anāmayān ||
meaning: ये ते पन्था इति इमाम् तु सावित्रीम् अध्वगो अभ्यसेत् | स्वस्तिमान् व्रजते अध्वानम् गृहांश् च आप्नोत्य् अनामयान् ||
text_mt: A traveler should practice this Sāvitrī verse: 'those which are your paths' (ye te panthāḥ); / he travels on his road safely and reaches his home free from disease.

sanskrit_iast: sam pūṣann iti yat sūktam ghauraiḥ kaṇvo jagāv ṛṣiḥ | adhvany etad vijñeyam paripanthy apasedhanam ||
meaning: सम् पूषन्न् इति यत् सूक्तम् घौरैः कण्वो जगाव् ऋषिः | अध्वन्य् एतद् विज्ञेयम् परिपन्थ्य् अपसेधनम् ||
text_mt: The hymn 'together, Pūṣan' (saṃ pūṣan), which the ṛṣi Kaṇva, son of Ghora, sang, / is to be recognized on the road as driving away robbers.

sanskrit_iast: raudrībhiḥ ṣaḍbhir īśānam tuṣṭūyād yo dine dine | sa nārī nara go śāntim śaṅkarāt prāpnuyāt sadā ||
meaning: रौद्रीभिः षड्भिर् ईशानम् तुष्टूयाद् यो दिने दिने | स नारी नर गो शान्तिम् शङ्करात् प्राप्नुयात् सदा ||
text_mt: He who praises Īśāna day after day with the six verses to Rudra / always obtains pacification for women, men, and cattle from Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast: etena eva ṣaḍarcena juhuyād ājyam anvaham | carum vā kalpayed raudram bhūti kāmo atha parvasu ||
meaning: एतेन एव षडर्चेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् | चरुम् वा कल्पयेद् रौद्रम् भूति कामो अथ पर्वसु ||
text_mt: One desiring prosperity should offer clarified butter daily with this six-verse [hymn], / or prepare a caru for Rudra on the parvan days.

sanskrit_iast: ud ity udyantam ādityam upatiṣṭhed dine dine | hṛd roga nāśanam hy etat parama ārogya vardhanam ||
meaning: उद् इत्य् उद्यन्तम् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठेद् दिने दिने | हृद् रोग नाशनम् ह्य् एतत् परम आरोग्य वर्धनम् ||
text_mt: He should attend upon the rising sun day after day with [the hymn] 'Up' (ud [u tyam]); / for this destroys heart disease and greatly increases health.

sanskrit_iast: dviṣantam ity atha ardharcam yam dviṣyāt tam japant smaret | āgas kṛt sapta rātreṇa vidveṣam adhigacchati ||
meaning: द्विषन्तम् इत्य् अथ अर्धर्चम् यम् द्विष्यात् तम् जपन्त् स्मरेत् | आगस् कृत् सप्त रात्रेण विद्वेषम् अधिगच्छति ||
text_mt: While reciting the half-verse 'the hater' (dviṣantam), he should think of him whom he hates; / if [the other] committed an offense, he incurs hatred within seven nights.

sanskrit_iast: rogair gṛhīto arogī ca praskaṇvasya utttamam tṛcam | ārogyam etat prayato japen nityam anekaśaḥ ||
meaning: रोगैर् गृहीतो अरोगी च प्रस्कण्वस्य उत्त्तमम् तृचम् | आरोग्यम् एतत् प्रयतो जपेन् नित्यम् अनेकशः ||
text_mt: One seized by diseases and one free from disease, restrained, should constantly recite many times / the highest triplet of Praskaṇva, [which brings] health.

sanskrit_iast: uttamas tasya ca ardharco dviṣad dveṣa iti smṛtaḥ | yam dviṣyāt tam abhidhyāyed dṛṣṭvā ca enam japed idam ||
meaning: उत्तमस् तस्य च अर्धर्चो द्विषद् द्वेष इति स्मृतः | यम् द्विष्यात् तम् अभिध्यायेद् दृष्ट्वा च एनम् जपेद् इदम् ||
text_mt: Its final half-verse is remembered as the hatred of enemies (dviṣaddveṣa); / he should meditate on him whom he hates, and having seen him, recite this.

sanskrit_iast: āgas kṛc cet tri rātreṇa vidveṣam samniyacchati | udayaty āyur akṣayyam tejo madhyaṃdine japan ||
meaning: आगस् कृच् चेत् त्रि रात्रेण विद्वेषम् सम्नियच्छति | उदयत्य् आयुर् अक्षय्यम् तेजो मध्यंदिने जपन् ||
text_mt: If he has committed an offense, he restrains hatred within three nights; / reciting at sunrise [he gains] imperishable life, and at midday [he gains] luster.

sanskrit_iast: astam vrajati sūrye tu dviṣantam pratibādhate | ojas tejas tathā ārogyam dviṣad dveṣam prakīrtitam ||
meaning: अस्तम् व्रजति सूर्ये तु द्विषन्तम् प्रतिबाधते | ओजस् तेजस् तथा आरोग्यम् द्विषद् द्वेषम् प्रकीर्तितम् ||
text_mt: When the sun goes down, he repels the hater; / vigor, luster, and health, as well as the hatred of enemies, are proclaimed [as the fruits].

sanskrit_iast: nava paśvā iti sūktāni yāni garbhe parāśaraḥ | arātīnām haret prāṇān chatraṃś caiva niyacchati ||
meaning: नव पश्वा इति सूक्तानि यानि गर्भे पराशरः | अरातीनाम् हरेत् प्राणान् छत्रंश् चैव नियच्छति ||
text_mt: The nine hymns 'like cattle' (paśvā) which Parāśara [composed] while in the womb / take away the lives of adversaries and restrain foes.

sanskrit_iast: sauparṇāni pavitrāṇi sūktāny ekādaśa abhyaset | vāñchan putrān paśūn vittam svargam āyur anandhatām ||
meaning: सौपर्णानि पवित्राणि सूक्तान्य् एकादश अभ्यसेत् | वाञ्छन् पुत्रान् पशून् वित्तम् स्वर्गम् आयुर् अनन्धताम् ||
text_mt: Wishing for sons, cattle, wealth, heaven, long life, and freedom from blindness, / he should practice the eleven purifying Sauparṇa hymns.

sanskrit_iast: ādhyātmikīḥ ka ity etā japais tu susamāhitaḥ | prāpnuyāt sa param dhāma viśvam jyotiḥ sanātanam ||
meaning: आध्यात्मिकीः क इत्य् एता जपैस् तु सुसमाहितः | प्राप्नुयात् स परम् धाम विश्वम् ज्योतिः सनातनम् ||
text_mt: Well-concentrated, through muttered recitations of these metaphysical verses beginning with 'Who' (ka), / he attains the supreme abode, the universal, eternal light.

sanskrit_iast: ānohadrīyam āyuṣyam vaiśvadevam japan muniḥ | mumūrṣur api japtvā etat sarvam āyur avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: आनोहद्रीयम् आयुष्यम् वैश्वदेवम् जपन् मुनिः | मुमूर्षुर् अपि जप्त्वा एतत् सर्वम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: The sage, muttering the longevity-giving hymn to all the gods, beginning with 'to us, fortunate' (ā no bhadrāḥ), / even if about to die, after reciting this attains a full span of life.

sanskrit_iast: pitṝṇām śrāddha kāle tu madhv ity etat tṛcam japet | aghorāḥ pitaras tasya viśanti jyotir uttamam ||
meaning: पितॄणाम् श्राद्ध काले तु मध्व् इत्य् एतत् तृचम् जपेत् | अघोराः पितरस् तस्य विशन्ति ज्योतिर् उत्तमम् ||
text_mt: At the time of the śrāddha for the ancestors, he should recite the triplet beginning with 'sweet' (madhu); / his ancestors, harmless, enter the supreme light.

sanskrit_iast: tvam soma iti tu sūktena paśyec candram upoditam | upatiṣṭhet samit pāṇir māsi māsi navam navam ||
meaning: त्वम् सोम इति तु सूक्तेन पश्येच् चन्द्रम् उपोदितम् | उपतिष्ठेत् समित् पाणिर् मासि मासि नवम् नवम् ||
text_mt: With the hymn 'You, Soma' (tvaṃ soma), he should look upon the moon when it has risen; / with kindling sticks in hand, he should attend upon the new [moon] month after month.

sanskrit_iast: tam māsam tasya duhkham hi na jātu trividham bhavet | gotamena purā dṛṣṭam mṛtyor nāśanam ātmanaḥ ||
meaning: तम् मासम् तस्य दुह्खम् हि न जातु त्रिविधम् भवेत् | गोतमेन पुरा दृष्टम् मृत्योर् नाशनम् आत्मनः ||
text_mt: For that month, the threefold suffering will never befall him; / in ancient times this was seen by Gotama as the destruction of his own death.

sanskrit_iast: udyantam upatiṣṭheta pūrṇe ca etat samāhitaḥ | vāsāṃsy api sa vindeta candrasya eti salokatām ||
meaning: उद्यन्तम् उपतिष्ठेत पूर्णे च एतत् समाहितः | वासांस्य् अपि स विन्देत चन्द्रस्य एति सलोकताम् ||
text_mt: Concentrated, he should attend upon [the moon] when rising, and when it is full; / he obtains garments and goes to the moon's world.

sanskrit_iast: dhana kāmo japen nityam etā iti tu nityaśaḥ |
meaning: धन कामो जपेन् नित्यम् एता इति तु नित्यशः |
text_mt: One desiring wealth should recite constantly, at all times, [the verses beginning with] 'These' (etāḥ);

sanskrit_iast: snātvā śucis tu niyata iṣṭam dhanam avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: स्नात्वा शुचिस् तु नियत इष्टम् धनम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Having bathed, pure and self-restrained, he obtains the desired wealth.

sanskrit_iast: āyur īpsann imam iti kautsam sūktam sadā abhyaset | ājya āhutiś ca juhuyāt pratyṛcam vāg yataḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: आयुर् ईप्सन्न् इमम् इति कौत्सम् सूक्तम् सदा अभ्यसेत् | आज्य आहुतिश् च जुहुयात् प्रत्यृचम् वाग् यतः शुचिः ||
text_mt: Wishing for long life, he should always practice the hymn of Kutsa beginning with 'this' (imam); / restrained in speech and pure, he should offer an oblation of clarified butter verse by verse.

sanskrit_iast: japed āplutya niyataḥ sa sākṣād āpadam taret | apa naḥ śośucad iti snātvā madhyaṃdine ravau ||
meaning: जपेद् आप्लुत्य नियतः स साक्षाद् आपदम् तरेत् | अप नः शोशुचद् इति स्नात्वा मध्यंदिने रवौ ||
text_mt: Having bathed, self-restrained, he should recite; he crosses directly over misfortune; / having bathed at midday under the sun with 'Blazing away from us' (apa naḥ śośucat).

sanskrit_iast: śuddhi kāmo yata āhāraḥ pratyṛcam juhuyād ghṛtam | samidho anvaham aṣṭau vā sūktam etad agha apaham ||
meaning: शुद्धि कामो यत आहारः प्रत्यृचम् जुहुयाद् घृतम् | समिधो अन्वहम् अष्टौ वा सूक्तम् एतद् अघ अपहम् ||
text_mt: Desiring purity, restrained in food, he should offer clarified butter verse by verse / or eight kindling sticks daily; this hymn removes sin.

sanskrit_iast: yathā muñja ādi veṣīkā tathā pāpāt pramucyate | jātavedasa ity ādi sadā svastyayane japet ||
meaning: यथा मुञ्ज आदि वेषीका तथा पापात् प्रमुच्यते | जातवेदस इत्य् आदि सदा स्वस्त्ययने जपेत् ||
text_mt: Just as a stalk is freed from muñja grass, so he is freed from sin; / he should always recite [the verse] beginning with 'to Jātavedas' (jātavedase) for securing well-being.

sanskrit_iast: durge pathi prayātasya na asya aribhyo bhayam bhavet | rāja kārye aśva yūthe vā abhiśasto apy anekadhā ||
meaning: दुर्गे पथि प्रयातस्य न अस्य अरिभ्यो भयम् भवेत् | राज कार्ये अश्व यूथे वा अभिशस्तो अप्य् अनेकधा ||
text_mt: When he has set out on a difficult path, he has no fear of enemies; / in the business of a king, or among a herd of horses, or even when repeatedly accused,

sanskrit_iast: aśakye pratibhā kārye bhaye prāṇa antike api vā | jātavedasa ity etām japaṃs tebhyaḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: अशक्ये प्रतिभा कार्ये भये प्राण अन्तिके अपि वा | जातवेदस इत्य् एताम् जपंस् तेभ्यः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: in an impossible enterprise of high stakes, or in a fear that threatens life, / reciting this [verse] beginning with 'to Jātavedas' (jātavedase), he is freed from these.

sanskrit_iast: siṣādhayiṣur artham ca prasthito manasā japet | siddha arthaḥ svastimān eti pramīyeta na ca adhvani ||
meaning: सिषाधयिषुर् अर्थम् च प्रस्थितो मनसा जपेत् | सिद्ध अर्थः स्वस्तिमान् एति प्रमीयेत न च अध्वनि ||
text_mt: Wishing to accomplish an enterprise and having set out, he should recite it mentally; / with his goal accomplished, he returns safely and does not perish on the road.

sanskrit_iast: kṛta arthaḥ sva gṛhān gacchann etām eva sadā abhyaset | udite savitary etām japed astam gate tathā ||
meaning: कृत अर्थः स्व गृहान् गच्छन्न् एताम् एव सदा अभ्यसेत् | उदिते सवितर्य् एताम् जपेद् अस्तम् गते तथा ||
text_mt: Having attained his purpose, going to his own home, he should always practice this very [verse]; / he should recite it when the sun has risen, and likewise when it has set.

sanskrit_iast: ahaḥ svastyayanam prātā rātri svastyayanam niśi | vyuṣṭāyām ca japen nityam etām duhsvapna nāśinīm ||
meaning: अहः स्वस्त्ययनम् प्राता रात्रि स्वस्त्ययनम् निशि | व्युष्टायाम् च जपेन् नित्यम् एताम् दुह्स्वप्न नाशिनीम् ||
text_mt: A blessing of well-being for the day in the morning, a blessing of well-being for the night at dusk, / and at daybreak he should always recite this [verse], which destroys nightmares.

sanskrit_iast: pramandina iti sūyantyām japed garbha pramocinīm | indram ca manasā dhyāyen nārī garbham pramuñcati ||
meaning: प्रमन्दिन इति सूयन्त्याम् जपेद् गर्भ प्रमोचिनीम् | इन्द्रम् च मनसा ध्यायेन् नारी गर्भम् प्रमुञ्चति ||
text_mt: When a woman is giving birth, one should recite 'The very intoxicating' (pramandine), which delivers the embryo; / and he should meditate on Indra in his mind: the woman delivers the embryo.

sanskrit_iast: āpatsu sarva kāmo vā tritam nityam japed ṛṣim | japann indrma iti snāto vaiśvadevam tu saptakam ||
meaning: आपत्सु सर्व कामो वा त्रितम् नित्यम् जपेद् ऋषिम् | जपन्न् इन्द्र्म इति स्नातो वैश्वदेवम् तु सप्तकम् ||
text_mt: In misfortunes or desiring all things, he should always recite the ṛṣi Trita; / having bathed, reciting the seven-verse hymn to all the gods beginning with 'Indra' (indram),

sanskrit_iast: mucyate juhvad ājyam tu viśvasmād eva so aṃhasaḥ | śantātīyam param sūktam pañca viṃśakam uttamam ||
meaning: मुच्यते जुह्वद् आज्यम् तु विश्वस्माद् एव सो अंहसः | शन्तातीयम् परम् सूक्तम् पञ्च विंशकम् उत्तमम् ||
text_mt: and offering clarified butter, he is freed from all distress; / the Śantātīya, containing twenty-five verses, is an excellent supreme hymn.

sanskrit_iast: nāsatyau tu namas kṛtvā parā m ṛddhim avāpnuyāt | dharma saṃstavam sūktam rapasaś ca pramocanam ||
meaning: नासत्यौ तु नमस् कृत्वा परा म् ऋद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् | धर्म संस्तवम् सूक्तम् रपसश् च प्रमोचनम् ||
text_mt: Having made obeisance to the two Nāsatyas, he attains the highest prosperity; / the hymn is a praise of dharma and frees from defilement.

sanskrit_iast: imā iti japet śaśvad raudram sūktam dvijaḥ śuciḥ | āyur vidyām dhanam putrān gṛhāṃś ca āpnoty anāmayān ||
meaning: इमा इति जपेत् शश्वद् रौद्रम् सूक्तम् द्विजः शुचिः | आयुर् विद्याम् धनम् पुत्रान् गृहांश् च आप्नोत्य् अनामयान् ||
text_mt: A pure twice-born should constantly recite the hymn to Rudra beginning with 'These' (imāḥ); / he obtains long life, learning, wealth, sons, and a home free from disease.

sanskrit_iast: vīreṣv apatya goṣṭheṣu duhsvapne ripram ātmanaḥ | mā no mahāntam ity ābhyām tri rātra upoṣitaḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: वीरेष्व् अपत्य गोष्ठेषु दुह्स्वप्ने रिप्रम् आत्मनः | मा नो महान्तम् इत्य् आभ्याम् त्रि रात्र उपोषितः शुचिः ||
text_mt: Among heroes, children, cow-pens, [or after] a nightmare, [to remove] one's own impurity, / having fasted for three nights, pure, with the two verses 'Do not harm our great' (mā no mahāntam),

sanskrit_iast: audumbarīs tu juhuyād dadhi madhv ājya saṃskṛtāḥ | sūktena juhuyād ājyam ādāv ante ca karmaṇām ||
meaning: औदुम्बरीस् तु जुहुयाद् दधि मध्व् आज्य संस्कृताः | सूक्तेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् आदाव् अन्ते च कर्मणाम् ||
text_mt: he should offer sticks of udumbara wood prepared with curds, honey, and clarified butter; / he should offer clarified butter with the hymn at the beginning and the end of rituals.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhva bāhus tu sūktena tuṣṭvā ca śataśo bhavam | chittvā sarvān mṛtyu pāśān jīved rogair vivarjitaḥ ||
meaning: ऊर्ध्व बाहुस् तु सूक्तेन तुष्ट्वा च शतशो भवम् | छित्त्वा सर्वान् मृत्यु पाशान् जीवेद् रोगैर् विवर्जितः ||
text_mt: With raised arms, having praised Bhava with the hymn hundreds of times, / having severed all the bonds of death, he lives free from diseases.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhann udyantam ādityam samit pāṇiḥ śuciḥ sadā | citram ity upatiṣṭheta sūktena anena bhāskaram ||
meaning: तिष्ठन्न् उद्यन्तम् आदित्यम् समित् पाणिः शुचिः सदा | चित्रम् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत सूक्तेन अनेन भास्करम् ||
text_mt: Standing, pure, holding kindling in his hand, facing the rising sun, / he should always attend upon the light-maker with this hymn: 'Wondrous' (citram).

sanskrit_iast: atistavena ca etena nityam madhyaṃdine ravim | gṛṇann apohate ripram prāpnoti ca dhana āyuṣī ||
meaning: अतिस्तवेन च एतेन नित्यम् मध्यंदिने रविम् | गृणन्न् अपोहते रिप्रम् प्राप्नोति च धन आयुषी ||
text_mt:
And with this supreme praise, praising the Sun every day at midday,
he dispels impurity and attains wealth and life.

sanskrit_iast: adhaḥ svapnasya iti japet prātaḥ prātar dine dine | duḥ svapnam nudate kṣipram na ca asya abhojanād bhayam ||
meaning: अधः स्वप्नस्य इति जपेत् प्रातः प्रातर् दिने दिने | दुः स्वप्नम् नुदते क्षिप्रम् न च अस्य अभोजनाद् भयम् ||
text_mt:
He should mutter "Down from sleep" every morning day after day;
he quickly drives away bad dreams, and he has no fear of lack of food.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe punāmi iti parā ripughnyas tu prakīrtitāḥ | tā japan hanti rakṣāṃsi sapatnāṃś ca niyacchati ||
meaning: उभे पुनामि इति परा रिपुघ्न्यस् तु प्रकीर्तिताः | ता जपन् हन्ति रक्षांसि सपत्नांश् च नियच्छति ||
text_mt:
The following verses beginning "I purify both" are declared to be enemy-slaying;
muttering them, he slays the rakṣasas and curbs his rivals.

sanskrit_iast: nirvartya pañca yajñāṃś ca hutvā ca agnim kṛta āhnikaḥ | ye devāso divya nayā japan kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: निर्वर्त्य पञ्च यज्ञांश् च हुत्वा च अग्निम् कृत आह्निकः | ये देवासो दिव्य नया जपन् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt:
Having performed the five sacrifices, offered into the fire, and finished his daily rites,
he should obtain his desires by muttering "Those gods" with heavenly guidance.

sanskrit_iast: indrā viṣṇū namas kṛtya viṣṇor nu kam iti tribhiḥ | samit pāṇiḥ śucir bhūtvā upatiṣṭhed dine dine ||
meaning: इन्द्रा विष्णू नमस् कृत्य विष्णोर् नु कम् इति त्रिभिः | समित् पाणिः शुचिर् भूत्वा उपतिष्ठेद् दिने दिने ||
text_mt:
Having bowed to Indra and Viṣṇu, with fuel in hand, having become pure,
he should worship day after day with the three [verses] "Viṣṇu now".

sanskrit_iast: dharmam buddhim dhanam putrān ārogyam brahma vardhanam | prāpnoti ca param sthānam jyotī rūpam sanātanam ||
meaning: धर्मम् बुद्धिम् धनम् पुत्रान् आरोग्यम् ब्रह्म वर्धनम् | प्राप्नोति च परम् स्थानम् ज्योती रूपम् सनातनम् ||
text_mt:
Dharma, intellect, wealth, sons, health, increase of Brahman,
and the supreme place whose form is light, eternal, he attains.

sanskrit_iast: ātatāyinam āyāntam dṛṣṭvā vyāghram atho vṛkam | na mā garann iti japaṃs tebhya eva pramucyate ||
meaning: आततायिनम् आयान्तम् दृष्ट्वा व्याघ्रम् अथो वृकम् | न मा गरन्न् इति जपंस् तेभ्य एव प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt:
Seeing an assailant approaching, or a tiger, or a wolf,
muttering "May they not swallow me", he is freed from them indeed.

sanskrit_iast: tri rātra upoṣito rātrau japed āsūrya darśanāt | āplutya prayataḥ saurīr upatiṣṭhed divākaram ||
meaning: त्रि रात्र उपोषितो रात्रौ जपेद् आसूर्य दर्शनात् | आप्लुत्य प्रयतः सौरीर् उपतिष्ठेद् दिवाकरम् ||
text_mt:
Having fasted for three nights, he should mutter at night until the sun is seen;
having bathed, disciplined, he should worship the Sun with the solar verses.

sanskrit_iast: na enam paśyanti vai caurās tathā anye pāpa vṛttayaḥ | ekaḥ śatāni trāyeta taskarebhyaś caran pathi ||
meaning: न एनम् पश्यन्ति वै चौरास् तथा अन्ये पाप वृत्तयः | एकः शतानि त्रायेत तस्करेभ्यश् चरन् पथि ||
text_mt:
Thieves do not see him, nor others of evil conduct;
alone, walking on the path, he can protect hundreds from robbers.

sanskrit_iast: steyam kṛtvā dvijo mohāt tri rātra upoṣitaḥ śuciḥ | sūktam japtvā asya vāmīyam kṣipram mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
meaning: स्तेयम् कृत्वा द्विजो मोहात् त्रि रात्र उपोषितः शुचिः | सूक्तम् जप्त्वा अस्य वामीयम् क्षिप्रम् मुच्येत किल्बिषात् ||
text_mt:
Having committed theft out of delusion, a twice-born, having fasted for three nights, pure,
by muttering the hymn of Asyavāma, would quickly be freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast: jñāti putra suhṛn mitrair yaś ca rājyam cikīrṣati | nityam sa niyato bhūtvā sūktam tu manasā japet ||
meaning: ज्ञाति पुत्र सुहृन् मित्रैर् यश् च राज्यम् चिकीर्षति | नित्यम् स नियतो भूत्वा सूक्तम् तु मनसा जपेत् ||
text_mt:
And he who desires kingship along with his kinsmen, sons, well-wishers, and friends,
being constantly restrained, should mutter the hymn mentally.

sanskrit_iast: kayā śubhā iti paiśunyam kṛtvā ācārya nṛpa dvijaiḥ | śrutvā para rahasyam tu guror apy āha śaunakaḥ ||
meaning: कया शुभा इति पैशुन्यम् कृत्वा आचार्य नृप द्विजैः | श्रुत्वा पर रहस्यम् तु गुरोर् अप्य् आह शौनकः ||
text_mt:
Having uttered slander against teachers, kings, and twice-born with "By what splendid...?",
or having heard another's secret, even of a guru, Śaunaka has declared:

sanskrit_iast: imam nu somam ity ete dve ṛcau prayato japet | sarvān kāmān avāpnoti na kiṃcit pātakam bhavet ||
meaning: इमम् नु सोमम् इत्य् एते द्वे ऋचौ प्रयतो जपेत् | सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति न किंचित् पातकम् भवेत् ||
text_mt:
He should, disciplined, mutter these two verses, "Now this Soma";
he obtains all desires, and there will be no major sin whatever.

sanskrit_iast: pitum nv ity upatiṣṭheta nityam annam upasthitam | pūjayed aśanam nityam bhuñjīyād avikutsitam ||
meaning: पितुम् न्व् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत नित्यम् अन्नम् उपस्थितम् | पूजयेद् अशनम् नित्यम् भुञ्जीयाद् अविकुत्सितम् ||
text_mt:
He should constantly worship food that has been set down with "Now the food...";
he should constantly revere his food and eat without finding fault with it.

sanskrit_iast: na asya syād annajo vyādhir viṣam apy annatām iyāt | viṣam ca pītvā etat sūktam japeta viṣa nāśanam ||
meaning: न अस्य स्याद् अन्नजो व्याधिर् विषम् अप्य् अन्नताम् इयात् | विषम् च पीत्वा एतत् सूक्तम् जपेत विष नाशनम् ||
text_mt:
He would have no disease born of food; even poison would turn into food;
and having drunk poison, he should mutter this poison-destroying hymn.

sanskrit_iast: na avāg yatas tu bhuñjīta na aśucir na jugupsitam | dadyāc ca pūjayec caiva juhuyāc ca śuciḥ sadā ||
meaning: न अवाग् यतस् तु भुञ्जीत न अशुचिर् न जुगुप्सितम् | दद्याच् च पूजयेच् चैव जुहुयाच् च शुचिः सदा ||
text_mt:
He should not eat without restraining his speech, nor impure, nor disgusting food;
pure, he should constantly give, revere, and make offerings.

sanskrit_iast: kṣud bhayam na asya kiṃcit syān na annajam vyādhim āpnuyāt | utpatha pratipanno yo bhraṣṭo vā api pathaḥ kvacit ||
meaning: क्षुद् भयम् न अस्य किंचित् स्यान् न अन्नजम् व्याधिम् आप्नुयात् | उत्पथ प्रतिपन्नो यो भ्रष्टो वा अपि पथः क्वचित् ||
text_mt:
He would have no fear of hunger, nor would he contract a disease born of food.
He who has taken a wrong path or strayed from the path anywhere,

sanskrit_iast: panthānam pratipadyeta kṛtvā vā karma garhitam | agne naya iti sūktena pratyṛcam juhuyād ghṛtam ||
meaning: पन्थानम् प्रतिपद्येत कृत्वा वा कर्म गर्हितम् | अग्ने नय इति सूक्तेन प्रत्यृचम् जुहुयाद् घृतम् ||
text_mt:
would regain the path, or having done a censured deed,
he should offer ghee verse by verse with the hymn "Agni, lead...".

sanskrit_iast: japaṃś ca prayato nityam upatiṣṭheta ca analam | snātvā japed anarvāṇam namas kṛtya bṛhaspatim ||
meaning: जपंश् च प्रयतो नित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत च अनलम् | स्नात्वा जपेद् अनर्वाणम् नमस् कृत्य बृहस्पतिम् ||
text_mt:
And muttering, disciplined, he should constantly worship the fire;
having bathed, he should mutter the Anarvan hymn, having bowed to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: vīrān dhanam ca prāpnoti suślokyam ca niyacchati | kaṅkato na iti sūktam tu viṣa ārtaḥ prayato japet ||
meaning: वीरान् धनम् च प्राप्नोति सुश्लोक्यम् च नियच्छति | कङ्कतो न इति सूक्तम् तु विष आर्तः प्रयतो जपेत् ||
text_mt:
He attains heroes and wealth, and secures good renown;
and afflicted by poison, he should, disciplined, mutter the hymn "Like a comb...".

sanskrit_iast: viṣam na kramate ca asya sarpād dṛṣṭi viṣād api | yat kīṭalūṭāsu viṣam daṃṣṭri vṛścikajam ca yat ||
meaning: विषम् न क्रमते च अस्य सर्पाद् दृष्टि विषाद् अपि | यत् कीटलूटासु विषम् दंष्ट्रि वृश्चिकजम् च यत् ||
text_mt:
And poison does not take effect on him, even from a snake whose gaze is poison,
nor whatever poison is in insects and spiders, or born of tusked beasts and scorpions.

sanskrit_iast: maulam ca kṛtrimam caiva japant sarvam vyapohati | dharmam buddhim dhanam putrān saubhāgyam brahma varcasam ||
meaning: मौलम् च कृत्रिमम् चैव जपन्त् सर्वम् व्यपोहति | धर्मम् बुद्धिम् धनम् पुत्रान् सौभाग्यम् ब्रह्म वर्चसम् ||
text_mt:
Both root poison and artificial poison, he dispels it all while muttering;
dharma, intellect, wealth, sons, good fortune, spiritual lustre,

sanskrit_iast: ārogyam puṣṭim āyuṣyam paśūn vidyām mahad yaśaḥ | tri rātra upoṣitaḥ snātaḥ prayataḥ carita vrataḥ ||
meaning: आरोग्यम् पुष्टिम् आयुष्यम् पशून् विद्याम् महद् यशः | त्रि रात्र उपोषितः स्नातः प्रयतः चरित व्रतः ||
text_mt:
health, prosperity, longevity, cattle, knowledge, great fame—
having fasted for three nights, bathed, disciplined, his vow observed,

sanskrit_iast: prāṇa āyāma śatam kṛtvā upatiṣṭhet śata kratum | eka aham kṣura samyuktaḥ pādau saṃdhāya vāg yataḥ ||
meaning: प्राण आयाम शतम् कृत्वा उपतिष्ठेत् शत क्रतुम् | एक अहम् क्षुर सम्युक्तः पादौ संधाय वाग् यतः ||
text_mt:
having performed a hundred breath controls, he should worship Śatakratu;
for one day with razor shaved, joining his feet, his speech restrained,

sanskrit_iast: yo jāta iti sūktena ṛṣim gṛtsamadam smaran | śata kṛtvo japed etad indra śreṣṭha iti ca antataḥ ||
meaning: यो जात इति सूक्तेन ऋषिम् गृत्समदम् स्मरन् | शत कृत्वो जपेद् एतद् इन्द्र श्रेष्ठ इति च अन्ततः ||
text_mt:
with the hymn "He who was born...", remembering the ṛṣi Gṛtsamada,
he should mutter this a hundred times, and at the end "Indra, best...".

sanskrit_iast: eka ahāl labhate vittam dvy ahāt siddhim anuttamām | ahobhir tribhir ārogyam caturbhir aśanam bahu ||
meaning: एक अहाल् लभते वित्तम् द्व्य् अहात् सिद्धिम् अनुत्तमाम् | अहोभिर् त्रिभिर् आरोग्यम् चतुर्भिर् अशनम् बहु ||
text_mt:
From one day he obtains wealth, from two days unequalled magical accomplishment,
from three days health, from four days abundant food,

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhir brahmavarcasyam ṣaḍbhir āyuḥ sukha āvaham | saptabhis tanayān puṣṭim aṣṭahiḥ prāpnuyād yaśaḥ ||
meaning: पञ्चभिर् ब्रह्मवर्चस्यम् षड्भिर् आयुः सुख आवहम् | सप्तभिस् तनयान् पुष्टिम् अष्टहिः प्राप्नुयाद् यशः ||
text_mt:
from five days spiritual lustre, from six days a life bringing happiness,
from seven days sons and prosperity, from eight days he would obtain fame.

sanskrit_iast: priyo bhavati ca indrasya priyam dhāma sa gacchati | ripughnam dasyu śamanam rāyas pṣa karam param ||
meaning: प्रियो भवति च इन्द्रस्य प्रियम् धाम स गच्छति | रिपुघ्नम् दस्यु शमनम् रायस् प्ष करम् परम् ||
text_mt:
And he becomes dear to Indra, and he goes to his beloved abode.
Enemy-slaying, dasyu-calming, causing supreme increase of wealth,

sanskrit_iast: gaṇānām iti yat sūktam taj japet sukha vardhanam | saṃdhyayoḥ prayatas tv etaj japen nityam bṛhaspatim ||
meaning: गणानाम् इति यत् सूक्तम् तज् जपेत् सुख वर्धनम् | संध्ययोः प्रयतस् त्व् एतज् जपेन् नित्यम् बृहस्पतिम् ||
text_mt:
that hymn which is "Of the hosts..." he should mutter, bringing increase of happiness;
disciplined, at the two twilights, he should constantly mutter this to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: upatiṣṭheta sūktena sarva kāma samṛddhaye | yo me rājann iti imām tu duhsvapna śamanīm ṛcam ||
meaning: उपतिष्ठेत सूक्तेन सर्व काम समृद्धये | यो मे राजन्न् इति इमाम् तु दुह्स्वप्न शमनीम् ऋचम् ||
text_mt:
He should worship with the hymn for the complete attainment of all desires.
This verse, however, which pacifies bad dreams, "He who to me, O king...":

sanskrit_iast: japtvā nāśayati kṣipram duhsvapnam brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ | aho rātram upoṣya ekam niyato brahmavittamaḥ ||
meaning: जप्त्वा नाशयति क्षिप्रम् दुह्स्वप्नम् ब्राह्मणः शुचिः | अहो रात्रम् उपोष्य एकम् नियतो ब्रह्मवित्तमः ||
text_mt:
having muttered it, the pure brahmin quickly destroys a bad dream;
having fasted for one day and night, restrained, the best knower of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast: prajā artham juhuyād ājyam carum vā payasi śritam | rākā maham iti imābhiḥ ṣaṣṭhyām śuklasya pañcabhiḥ ||
meaning: प्रजा अर्थम् जुहुयाद् आज्यम् चरुम् वा पयसि श्रितम् | राका महम् इति इमाभिः षष्ठ्याम् शुक्लस्य पञ्चभिः ||
text_mt:
should offer ghee for the sake of offspring, or boiled rice cooked in milk,
with these five [verses] beginning "Rākā I..." on the sixth [tithi] of the bright [fortnight].

sanskrit_iast: haviḥ śeṣam svayam prāśya vindate mahatīm prajām | vyādhinā yo abhibhūtaḥ syād ghoreṇa prāṇa hāriṇā ||
meaning: हविः शेषम् स्वयम् प्राश्य विन्दते महतीम् प्रजाम् | व्याधिना यो अभिभूतः स्याद् घोरेण प्राण हारिणा ||
text_mt:
Having himself consumed the remainder of the offering, he obtains great offspring.
He who is overcome by a severe, life-taking disease,

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśīm upoṣya ekām kṛṣṇasya juhuyāc carum | ā te sūktena raudreṇa pratyṛcam vāg yataḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: चतुर्दशीम् उपोष्य एकाम् कृष्णस्य जुहुयाच् चरुम् | आ ते सूक्तेन रौद्रेण प्रत्यृचम् वाग् यतः शुचिः ||
text_mt:
having fasted on the fourteenth [tithi] of the dark [fortnight], should offer boiled rice
with the Rudra hymn "To you...", verse by verse, with restrained speech, pure.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvam ājya āhutīr hutvā atha upasthāya śaṃkaram | haviḥ śeṣeṇa varteta ekāntaram atandritaḥ ||
meaning: पूर्वम् आज्य आहुतीर् हुत्वा अथ उपस्थाय शंकरम् | हविः शेषेण वर्तेत एकान्तरम् अतन्द्रितः ||
text_mt:
Having first offered oblations of ghee, then having worshipped Śaṃkara,
he should subsist on the remainder of the offering every other day, untiring.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇe māsi japen mṛtyum rogebhyaś ca pramucyate | abhiśasyeta yo mohāt kuryād vā karma garhitam ||
meaning: पूर्णे मासि जपेन् मृत्युम् रोगेभ्यश् च प्रमुच्यते | अभिशस्येत यो मोहात् कुर्याद् वा कर्म गर्हितम् ||
text_mt:
When the month is full, he should mutter [it against] death, and he is freed from diseases.
He who is accused out of delusion, or would do a censured deed,

sanskrit_iast: snātvā bhuñjan japed apsu ambī ity ṛcam atandritaḥ | adhvani prasthito yas tu paśyet śakunim utthitam ||
meaning: स्नात्वा भुञ्जन् जपेद् अप्सु अम्बी इत्य् ऋचम् अतन्द्रितः | अध्वनि प्रस्थितो यस् तु पश्येत् शकुनिम् उत्थितम् ||
text_mt:
having bathed, while eating, should mutter the verse "Mother..." in the waters, untiring.
And he who, set out on a journey, should see an omen bird arisen,

sanskrit_iast: apraśastam praśastam vā sthitvā aikṣya prayato japet | kanikradad iti sūktābhyām upatiṣṭhet kṛta svaram ||
meaning: अप्रशस्तम् प्रशस्तम् वा स्थित्वा ऐक्ष्य प्रयतो जपेत् | कनिक्रदद् इति सूक्ताभ्याम् उपतिष्ठेत् कृत स्वरम् ||
text_mt:
inauspicious or auspicious, having stopped and observed, disciplined, he should mutter;
with the two hymns "Crying loudly...", he should worship the one making the sound,

sanskrit_iast: śakunim vāyasam vā api mṛgam daṃṣṭriṇam eva ca | apy adṛṣṭvā eva japtavyam etat taskara mohanam | E
meaning: शकुनिम् वायसम् वा अपि मृगम् दंष्ट्रिणम् एव च | अप्य् अदृष्ट्वा एव जप्तव्यम् एतत् तस्कर मोहनम् | ए
text_mt:
a bird, or a crow, or a beast, or a tusked animal;
even without seeing it, this should be muttered, bewildering thieves.

sanskrit_iast: kalyāṇa vādī vā anyo vā na vā rauti na dṛśyate | japed eva namas kṛtya siddha arthaḥ san nivartate ||
meaning: कल्याण वादी वा अन्यो वा न वा रौति न दृश्यते | जपेद् एव नमस् कृत्य सिद्ध अर्थः सन् निवर्तते ||
text_mt:
Whether speaking auspiciously or otherwise, or neither crying nor seen,
he should just mutter, having bowed down; having accomplished his purpose, he returns.

sanskrit_iast: na tasya asti bhayam kiṃcid dasyubhyo adhvani vā kvacit | taraty api ca durgāṇi svastimāṃś ca sukhī bhavet ||
meaning: न तस्य अस्ति भयम् किंचिद् दस्युभ्यो अध्वनि वा क्वचित् | तरत्य् अपि च दुर्गाणि स्वस्तिमांश् च सुखी भवेत् ||
text_mt:
There is no fear whatever for him from dasyus on the journey anywhere;
he crosses even over difficulties, and becomes safe and happy.

sanskrit_iast: yasya bhuktam na jīryeta na tiṣṭhed vā kathaṃcana | dhyātvā so attāram annasya agnir asmi ity rcam japet ||
meaning: यस्य भुक्तम् न जीर्येत न तिष्ठेद् वा कथंचन | ध्यात्वा सो अत्तारम् अन्नस्य अग्निर् अस्मि इत्य् र्चम् जपेत् ||
text_mt:
He whose eaten food does not digest, or does not stay down by any means,
having meditated on that eater of food, should mutter the verse "I am fire...".

sanskrit_iast: viśvāmitrasya saṃvādam nady atikramaṇe japet | āplutasya ācamya vidhivad udakasya añjalim kṣipet ||
meaning: विश्वामित्रस्य संवादम् नद्य् अतिक्रमणे जपेत् | आप्लुतस्य आचम्य विधिवद् उदकस्य अञ्जलिम् क्षिपेत् ||
text_mt:
One should mutter the dialogue of Viśvāmitra when crossing a river;
having bathed and sipped water according to rule, he should toss a folded handful of water.

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ sravadbhya ity etad yo nityam hi samācaret | tam nadyaḥ srotasaḥ pānti svam putram iva mātaraḥ ||
meaning: नमः स्रवद्भ्य इत्य् एतद् यो नित्यम् हि समाचरेत् | तम् नद्यः स्रोतसः पान्ति स्वम् पुत्रम् इव मातरः ||
text_mt:
He who indeed constantly performs this [verse] "Homage to the flowing...",
him the rivers of the torrent protect, just as mothers their own son.

sanskrit_iast: bhayam ca asya na vidyate nadī tīra careṣv api | jala carebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ śīta uṣṇair na ca bādhyate ||
meaning: भयम् च अस्य न विद्यते नदी तीर चरेष्व् अपि | जल चरेभ्यो भूतेभ्यः शीत उष्णैर् न च बाध्यते ||
text_mt: And he has no fear even among those that move on the riverbanks / or from creatures moving in the water, nor is he afflicted by cold or heat.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇām titīrṣuḥ saritam ramadhvam iti saṃsmaret | o sv ity ṛcam apām madhye japed yo vai nadīm taran ||
meaning: पूर्णाम् तितीर्षुः सरितम् रमध्वम् इति संस्मरेत् | ओ स्व् इत्य् ऋचम् अपाम् मध्ये जपेद् यो वै नदीम् तरन् ||
text_mt: Wishing to cross a full river, he should contemplate, "Ramadhvam" ("Rest ye"). / When crossing a river, one should recite in the midst of the waters the verse, "O ṣu" ("O come").

sanskrit_iast: sa śīghram tīram āpnoti gādham vā vindate dvijaḥ | yuktena eva rathena āśu yo apām pāram titīrṣati ||
meaning: स शीघ्रम् तीरम् आप्नोति गाधम् वा विन्दते द्विजः | युक्तेन एव रथेन आशु यो अपाम् पारम् तितीर्षति ||
text_mt: The twice-born quickly reaches the bank or finds a shallow. / He who wishes to cross swiftly to the other side of the waters with a yoked chariot,

sanskrit_iast: ud va ūrmir iti imām tu japeta niyataḥ svayam | adhvānam prasthitaś caivam āmandrair iti saṃsmaret ||
meaning: उद् व ऊर्मिर् इति इमाम् तु जपेत नियतः स्वयम् | अध्वानम् प्रस्थितश् चैवम् आमन्द्रैर् इति संस्मरेत् ||
text_mt: restrained in himself, should recite this [verse], "Ud va ūrmiḥ" ("Up your wave"). / And setting out on a journey, he should contemplate [the hymn] beginning with "Ā mandraiḥ" ("With joy-bringing").

sanskrit_iast: kāryāṇy aśeṣataḥ kṛtvā punar āyāti vai gṛham | adātāram supuṣṭa artham sarvadā āviṣṭa cetanam ||
meaning: कार्याण्य् अशेषतः कृत्वा पुनर् आयाति वै गृहम् | अदातारम् सुपुष्ट अर्थम् सर्वदा आविष्ट चेतनम् ||
text_mt: Having accomplished his affairs completely, he returns home. / [Against] a non-giver whose wealth is well flourished, whose mind is always possessed [by greed],

sanskrit_iast: hatvā tad dhanam anvicchet kim te kṛṇvanti iti smaran | indrā parvata iti sūktam āyuṣyam drāviṇam smṛtam ||
meaning: हत्वा तद् धनम् अन्विच्छेत् किम् ते कृण्वन्ति इति स्मरन् | इन्द्रा पर्वत इति सूक्तम् आयुष्यम् द्राविणम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: he should seek his wealth after striking him down, remembering [the verse], "Kiṃ te kṛṇvanti" ("What do they do for thee"). / The hymn, "Indrāparvatā" ("O Indra and Parvata"), is traditionally taught to bring long life and wealth.

sanskrit_iast: vāg indriya pramūḍho yo na vidyām pratipadyate | indriya arthāny atha arthān vā yo na vetti kathaṃcana ||
meaning: वाग् इन्द्रिय प्रमूढो यो न विद्याम् प्रतिपद्यते | इन्द्रिय अर्थान्य् अथ अर्थान् वा यो न वेत्ति कथंचन ||
text_mt: He who is bewildered in the organ of speech and does not acquire learning, / or who does not understand at all the objects of the senses or their meanings,

sanskrit_iast: vidyā vā adhigatā yasya praṇaśyeta punaḥ punaḥ | sasarparīr ṛcau japan dvau māsau pratipadyate ||
meaning: विद्या वा अधिगता यस्य प्रणश्येत पुनः पुनः | ससर्परीर् ऋचौ जपन् द्वौ मासौ प्रतिपद्यते ||
text_mt: or he whose acquired knowledge is lost again and again, / muttering the two "Sasarparī" verses for two months, acquires it.

sanskrit_iast: anasā samprayātas tu sthirau gāvāv iti smaret | catasraḥ kuśalena eti siddha arthaḥ sthirayā anugaḥ ||
meaning: अनसा सम्प्रयातस् तु स्थिरौ गावाव् इति स्मरेत् | चतस्रः कुशलेन एति सिद्ध अर्थः स्थिरया अनुगः ||
text_mt: When setting out on a cart, he should remember [the hymn], "Sthirau gāvau" ("Firm be the pair of oxen"). / With the four [verses], accompanied by a steady [vehicle], he reaches safety, his goal attained.

sanskrit_iast: yāna akṣam apabhagna antam dṛṣṭvā durge adhvani dvijaḥ | abhi vyayasva iti japed dvṛcam akṣa balam dadhat ||
meaning: यान अक्षम् अपभग्न अन्तम् दृष्ट्वा दुर्गे अध्वनि द्विजः | अभि व्ययस्व इति जपेद् द्वृचम् अक्ष बलम् दधत् ||
text_mt: Seeing the axle of his vehicle broken at the end on a difficult road, the twice-born / should recite the two verses, "Abhi vyayasva" ("Envelop"), imparting strength to the axle.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇa pakṣe caturdaśyām tri rātra upoṣitaḥ śuciḥ | dakṣiṇa pravaṇe deśe śmaśānasthaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: कृष्ण पक्षे चतुर्दश्याम् त्रि रात्र उपोषितः शुचिः | दक्षिण प्रवणे देशे श्मशानस्थः समाहितः ||
text_mt: Fasting for three nights on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, pure, / standing in a cremation ground in a region sloping to the south, concentrated,

sanskrit_iast: rakta uṣṇīṣy asi pāṇiś ca bailvaka idhmo nila aśanaḥ | sapta aham juhuyāt tailam sārṣapam lavaṇa anvitam ||
meaning: रक्त उष्णीष्य् असि पाणिश् च बैल्वक इध्मो निल अशनः | सप्त अहम् जुहुयात् तैलम् सार्षपम् लवण अन्वितम् ||
text_mt: wearing a red turban, with a sword in hand, using bilva firewood, eating wind (or: living on air), / he should offer mustard oil mixed with salt for seven days,

sanskrit_iast: samidho rāja vṛkṣasya vasiṣṭha dveṣiṇīḥ paṭhan | yam dviṣyāt tasya kṛtvā tu śamyākena ākṛtim niśi ||
meaning: समिधो राज वृक्षस्य वसिष्ठ द्वेषिणीः पठन् | यम् द्विष्यात् तस्य कृत्वा तु शम्याकेन आकृतिम् निशि ||
text_mt: using kindling sticks of the royal tree (āragvadha), reciting the Vasiṣṭha-hating verses. / Having made an image with śamyāka at night of him whom he hates,

sanskrit_iast: adhiṣṭhāya ca tām kuryād ṛgbhiś catasṛbhir dvijaḥ | uddiśya nāma homo ayam sapta rātram na jīvati ||
meaning: अधिष्ठाय च ताम् कुर्याद् ऋग्भिश् चतसृभिर् द्विजः | उद्दिश्य नाम होमो अयम् सप्त रात्रम् न जीवति ||
text_mt: and standing upon it, the twice-born should perform [the rite] with four verses. / This fire offering, naming the intended person, ensures that he does not live past seven nights.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhān antato hanti brahma etat kuśika uditam | na asya kaścid avadhyo asti japato juhvato api vā ||
meaning: वसिष्ठान् अन्ततो हन्ति ब्रह्म एतत् कुशिक उदितम् | न अस्य कश्चिद् अवध्यो अस्ति जपतो जुह्वतो अपि वा ||
text_mt: This sacred lore spoken by the Kuśika kills even Vasiṣṭhas. / There is no one who may not be slain by him while muttering or offering this.

sanskrit_iast: dvāviṃśakam japet sūktam ādhyātmikam anuttamam | parvasu prayato nityam iṣṭān kāmānt samaśnute ||
meaning: द्वाविंशकम् जपेत् सूक्तम् आध्यात्मिकम् अनुत्तमम् | पर्वसु प्रयतो नित्यम् इष्टान् कामान्त् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: He should recite the twenty-second hymn, which is supreme and relates to the Self. / Restrained constantly on the change-of-moon days, he attains his desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatim aja aśvam ca savitāram babhrum eva ca | ṛtāvṛdhau dine dine tṛcaiḥ pañcabhir anvaham ||
meaning: बृहस्पतिम् अज अश्वम् च सवितारम् बभ्रुम् एव च | ऋतावृधौ दिने दिने तृचैः पञ्चभिर् अन्वहम् ||
text_mt: [Offering to] Bṛhaspati, the goat-horsed [Pūṣan], Savitṛ, the tawny [Soma], / and the two increasers of cosmic order (Mitra and Varuṇa), day after day with five triplets daily,

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspata iti pañca aham pratyṛcam juhuyād ghṛtam | hutvā agnim arcayitvā tu gandha mālyaiḥ sadhūpakaiḥ ||
meaning: बृहस्पत इति पञ्च अहम् प्रत्यृचम् जुहुयाद् घृतम् | हुत्वा अग्निम् अर्चयित्वा तु गन्ध माल्यैः सधूपकैः ||
text_mt: he should offer ghee verse by verse for five days with [the hymn], "Bṛhaspate" ("O Bṛhaspati"). / Having offered and worshiped the fire with fragrant garlands and incense,

sanskrit_iast: tā eva devatāḥ pañca kāmair arcanti pañcabhiḥ | ratnair apatyaiḥ paśubhir makhair dīrgheṇa ca āyuṣā ||
meaning: ता एव देवताः पञ्च कामैर् अर्चन्ति पञ्चभिः | रत्नैर् अपत्यैः पशुभिर् मखैर् दीर्घेण च आयुषा ||
text_mt: those very five deities honor him with five desires: / jewels, offspring, cattle, sacrifices, and a long life.

sanskrit_iast: atha veda ādi gītāyāḥ prasāda jananam vidhim | gāyatryāḥ sampravakṣyāmi dharma kāma artha mokṣadam ||
meaning: अथ वेद आदि गीतायाः प्रसाद जननम् विधिम् | गायत्र्याः सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्म काम अर्थ मोक्षदम् ||
text_mt: Now I shall declare the rule producing the favor of the Gāyatrī, / sung at the beginning of the Veda, bestowing virtue, pleasure, wealth, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: nitye naimittike kāmye tritaye tu parāyaṇam | gāyatryās tu param na asti iha loke paratra ca ||
meaning: नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये त्रितये तु परायणम् | गायत्र्यास् तु परम् न अस्ति इह लोके परत्र च ||
text_mt: In the triad of regular, occasional, and optional [rites], it is the highest refuge; / there is nothing higher than the Gāyatrī in this world or in the next.

sanskrit_iast: medhya anna mita bhug maunī triḥ snāna arcana tatparaḥ | japel lakṣa trayam dhīmān ananya mānasa kriyaḥ ||
meaning: मेध्य अन्न मित भुग् मौनी त्रिः स्नान अर्चन तत्परः | जपेल् लक्ष त्रयम् धीमान् अनन्य मानस क्रियः ||
text_mt: Eating measured pure food, silent, devoted to threefold bathing and worship, / the wise man, his mind and acts single-focused, should recite [it] three hundred thousand times.

sanskrit_iast: karmabhir yojayet paścāt kramaśaḥ sva icchayā api vā | yāvat kāryam sa kurvīta na lopet tāvat tad vratam ||
meaning: कर्मभिर् योजयेत् पश्चात् क्रमशः स्व इच्छया अपि वा | यावत् कार्यम् स कुर्वीत न लोपेत् तावत् तद् व्रतम् ||
text_mt: Afterward he may apply it to rituals gradually, or at his own will; / as long as he performs the work, he should not break that observance.

sanskrit_iast: ādityasya udaye snātvā sahasram pratyaham japet | āyur ārogyam aiśvaryam dhanam ca labhate dhruvam ||
meaning: आदित्यस्य उदये स्नात्वा सहस्रम् प्रत्यहम् जपेत् | आयुर् आरोग्यम् ऐश्वर्यम् धनम् च लभते ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: Having bathed at the rising of the sun, he should recite [it] a thousand times daily; / he surely obtains long life, health, sovereignty, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast: tri rātra upoṣitaḥ samyag ghṛtam hutvā sahasraśaḥ | sahasra lābham āpnoti huta aśe khādira indhane ||
meaning: त्रि रात्र उपोषितः सम्यग् घृतम् हुत्वा सहस्रशः | सहस्र लाभम् आप्नोति हुत अशे खादिर इन्धने ||
text_mt: Having fasted for three nights and offering ghee properly by thousands / into the fire fueled with khadira wood, he obtains a gain of a thousand.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśa samidhām caiva ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | sahasra lābham āpnoti rāhu sūrya samāgame ||
meaning: पालाश समिधाम् चैव घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | सहस्र लाभम् आप्नोति राहु सूर्य समागमे ||
text_mt: And [offering] kindling-sticks of palāśa smeared with ghee into the fire, / he obtains a gain of a thousand at an eclipse of the sun by Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā tu khādire vahnau saghṛtam rakta candanam | sahasram homam āpnoti rāhu sūrya samāgamet ||
meaning: हुत्वा तु खादिरे वह्नौ सघृतम् रक्त चन्दनम् | सहस्रम् होमम् आप्नोति राहु सूर्य समागमेत् ||
text_mt: Having offered red sandalwood with ghee into a fire of khadira wood, / he obtains a thousandfold offering at an eclipse of the sun by Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast: rakta candana miśram tu saghṛtam havya vāhane | hutvā gomayam āpnoti sahasram go dhanam dvijaḥ ||
meaning: रक्त चन्दन मिश्रम् तु सघृतम् हव्य वाहने | हुत्वा गोमयम् आप्नोति सहस्रम् गो धनम् द्विजः ||
text_mt: Having offered [into] the fire [fuel of] dried cow dung mixed with red sandalwood and ghee, / the twice-born obtains a wealth of a thousand cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yasyās tu gor gomayena guṭikānām sahasraśaḥ | hutvā tām gām avāpnoti ghṛta aktānām huta aśane ||
meaning: यस्यास् तु गोर् गोमयेन गुटिकानाम् सहस्रशः | हुत्वा ताम् गाम् अवाप्नोति घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने ||
text_mt: Having offered thousands of pellets made of the dung of that cow, / smeared with ghee, into the fire, he obtains that cow.
