sanskrit_iast: yavair aśvāṃs tilair hastīn mahiṣyo yāvakais tathā | śālī tāṇḍula homena kanyā lābham avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: यवैर् अश्वांस् तिलैर् हस्तीन् महिष्यो यावकैस् तथा | शाली ताण्डुल होमेन कन्या लाभम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: [He gains] horses with barley, elephants with sesame, buffaloes likewise with barley gruel; / with an offering of husked rice grains, he obtains a maiden.

sanskrit_iast: jātī campaka rāja arka kusumānām sahasraśaḥ | hutvā vastrāṇy avāpnoti ghṛta aktānām huta aśane ||
meaning: जाती चम्पक राज अर्क कुसुमानाम् सहस्रशः | हुत्वा वस्त्राण्य् अवाप्नोति घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने ||
text_mt: Having offered thousands of jātī, campaka, and rājārka flowers / smeared with ghee into the fire, he obtains garments.

sanskrit_iast: sūrya bimbe jala madhye toyam hutvā sahasraśaḥ | sahasram prāpnuyādd haimam raupyam indumaye hute ||
meaning: सूर्य बिम्बे जल मध्ये तोयम् हुत्वा सहस्रशः | सहस्रम् प्राप्नुयाद्द् हैमम् रौप्यम् इन्दुमये हुते ||
text_mt: Having offered water a thousand times in the midst of water toward the orb of the sun, / he obtains a thousand gold pieces; when offered toward that of the moon, [a thousand] silver pieces.

sanskrit_iast: alakṣmī pāpa samyukto mala vyādhi vināyakaiḥ | mucyet sahasra japtena snāyād yas tu jalena vai ||
meaning: अलक्ष्मी पाप सम्युक्तो मल व्याधि विनायकैः | मुच्येत् सहस्र जप्तेन स्नायाद् यस् तु जलेन वै ||
text_mt: Afflicted with misfortune and sin, or by impurities, disease, and Vināyakas, / he who bathes with water over which [the Gāyatrī] was recited a thousand times is freed.

sanskrit_iast: yām diśam sapta japtena loṣṭena sampracāṭayet | caura agni māruta utthāni bhayāni na bhavanti vai ||
meaning: याम् दिशम् सप्त जप्तेन लोष्टेन सम्प्रचाटयेत् | चौर अग्नि मारुत उत्थानि भयानि न भवन्ति वै ||
text_mt: Toward whatever direction one hurls a clod of earth recited over seven times, / fears arising from thieves, fire, and wind do not arise there.

sanskrit_iast: kṣīra āhāro japel lakṣam apamṛtyum vyapohati |
meaning: क्षीर आहारो जपेल् लक्षम् अपमृत्युम् व्यपोहति |
text_mt: Living on a diet of milk, reciting it a hundred thousand times, he wards off premature death.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛta āśī prāpnuyān medhyām bahu vijñāna saṃcayam ||
meaning: घृत आशी प्राप्नुयान् मेध्याम् बहु विज्ञान संचयम् ||
text_mt: Eating ghee, he acquires pure [intellect] and an accumulation of extensive knowledge.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vetasa patrāṇi ghṛta aktāni huta aśane | lakṣād varṣāpayed devam sārvabhaumam na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: हुत्वा वेतस पत्राणि घृत अक्तानि हुत अशने | लक्षाद् वर्षापयेद् देवम् सार्वभौमम् न संशयः ||
text_mt: Having offered cane leaves smeared with ghee into the fire, / from a hundred thousand [oblations], he causes the god to make rain over the entire earth, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: lakṣeṇa bhasma homasya kṛtyā hy uttiṣṭhate jalāt | āditya abhimukhaḥ sthitvā na abhimātre jale śuciḥ ||
meaning: लक्षेण भस्म होमस्य कृत्या ह्य् उत्तिष्ठते जलात् | आदित्य अभिमुखः स्थित्वा न अभिमात्रे जले शुचिः ||
text_mt: With a hundred thousand offerings of ashes, a magical spirit arises from the water / when, pure, he stands facing the sun in water up to the navel.

sanskrit_iast: tilānām lakṣa homena ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | sarva kāma samṛddha ātmā parām siddhim avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: तिलानाम् लक्ष होमेन घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | सर्व काम समृद्ध आत्मा पराम् सिद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: With an offering of a hundred thousand sesame seeds smeared with ghee into the fire, / his self enriched with all desires, he attains supreme magical accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast: yavānām lakṣa homena ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | sarva kāma samṛddha ātmā param sthānam avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: यवानाम् लक्ष होमेन घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | सर्व काम समृद्ध आत्मा परम् स्थानम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: With an offering of a hundred thousand barley grains smeared with ghee into the fire, / his self enriched with all desires, he attains the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya āhuti lakṣeṇa sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt | pañca gavya aśano lakṣam japej jāti smaro bhavet ||
meaning: घृतस्य आहुति लक्षेण सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् | पञ्च गव्य अशनो लक्षम् जपेज् जाति स्मरो भवेत् ||
text_mt: With a hundred thousand oblations of ghee, he attains all desires. / Eating the five products of the cow and reciting [it] a hundred thousand times, he remembers his past births.

sanskrit_iast: tad eva hy anale hutvā prāpnoti bahuśo dhanam | anna adya havanān nityam anna adyam ca bhavet sadā ||
meaning: तद् एव ह्य् अनले हुत्वा प्राप्नोति बहुशो धनम् | अन्न अद्य हवनान् नित्यम् अन्न अद्यम् च भवेत् सदा ||
text_mt: By offering that very [pañcagavya] into the fire, he obtains abundant wealth; / from constant offerings of food, food will always be his.

sanskrit_iast: juhuyāt sarva sādhyānām āhuty ayuta saṃkhyayā | rakta siddha arthakān hutvā sarvānt sādhayate ripūn ||
meaning: जुहुयात् सर्व साध्यानाम् आहुत्य् अयुत संख्यया | रक्त सिद्ध अर्थकान् हुत्वा सर्वान्त् साधयते रिपून् ||
text_mt: He should offer for all attainable ends with ten thousand oblations; / having offered red mustard seeds, he subdues all enemies.

sanskrit_iast: lavaṇam madhu samyuktam hutvā sarvam vaśo bhavet | hutvā hu kara vīrāṇi raktāni janayej jvaram ||
meaning: लवणम् मधु सम्युक्तम् हुत्वा सर्वम् वशो भवेत् | हुत्वा हु कर वीराणि रक्तानि जनयेज् ज्वरम् ||
text_mt: Having offered salt mixed with honey, everyone becomes subject to his will; / having offered red oleander flowers, he causes fever.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vaibhītakam tailam deśād eva pracāṭayet | hutvā tu nimba patrāṇi vidveṣam janayen nṛṇām ||
meaning: हुत्वा वैभीतकम् तैलम् देशाद् एव प्रचाटयेत् | हुत्वा तु निम्ब पत्राणि विद्वेषम् जनयेन् नृणाम् ||
text_mt: Having offered vibhītaka oil, he drives [an enemy] away from the land; / and having offered neem leaves, he causes hatred among men.

sanskrit_iast: raktānām taṇḍulānām tu ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | hutvā balam avāpnoti śatrubhir na jīyate ||
meaning: रक्तानाम् तण्डुलानाम् तु घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | हुत्वा बलम् अवाप्नोति शत्रुभिर् न जीयते ||
text_mt: By offering into the fire red grains of rice / smeared with ghee, he obtains strength and is not conquered by enemies.

sanskrit_iast: pratyānayana siddhy artham madhu sarpiḥ samanvitam | gavyam kṣīram pradīpte gnau juhvatas tat praśāmyati ||
meaning: प्रत्यानयन सिद्ध्य् अर्थम् मधु सर्पिः समन्वितम् | गव्यम् क्षीरम् प्रदीप्ते ग्नौ जुह्वतस् तत् प्रशाम्यति ||
text_mt: For the sake of success in bringing someone back, when one offers into a blazing fire / cow's milk combined with honey and ghee, that [situation] is pacified.

sanskrit_iast: brahma cārī mita āhāro yaḥ sahasra trayam japet | saṃvatsareṇa labhate dhana aiśvaryam na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: ब्रह्म चारी मित आहारो यः सहस्र त्रयम् जपेत् | संवत्सरेण लभते धन ऐश्वर्यम् न संशयः ||
text_mt: A student of the Veda, eating measured food, who mutters [the mantra] three thousand times, / obtains wealth and sovereignty within a year; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: śamī bilva palāśānām arkasya tu viśeṣataḥ | puṣpāṇām samidhām caiva hutvā haimam avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: शमी बिल्व पलाशानाम् अर्कस्य तु विशेषतः | पुष्पाणाम् समिधाम् चैव हुत्वा हैमम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Having offered flowers and fuel-sticks of the śamī, bilva, and palāśa trees, / and especially of arka, he will obtain gold.

sanskrit_iast: abrahma tryambaka ādīnām yasya āyatanam āśritaḥ | japel lakṣam nirāhāraḥ sa tasya varado bhavet ||
meaning: अब्रह्म त्र्यम्बक आदीनाम् यस्य आयतनम् आश्रितः | जपेल् लक्षम् निराहारः स तस्य वरदो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Resorting to the abode of whatever deity, from Brahman up to Tryambaka, / he mutters a hundred thousand times without food, that deity becomes the giver of a boon to him.

sanskrit_iast: bilvānām lakṣa homena ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | parām śriyam avāpnoti yadi na bhrūṇahā bhavet ||
meaning: बिल्वानाम् लक्ष होमेन घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | पराम् श्रियम् अवाप्नोति यदि न भ्रूणहा भवेत् ||
text_mt: By an offering into the fire of a hundred thousand bilva [fruits] smeared with ghee, / he obtains supreme fortune, if he is not the slayer of an embryo.

sanskrit_iast: padmānām lakṣa homena ghṛta aktānām huta aśane | prāpnoti rājyam nikhilam asapatnam akaṇṭakam ||
meaning: पद्मानाम् लक्ष होमेन घृत अक्तानाम् हुत अशने | प्राप्नोति राज्यम् निखिलम् असपत्नम् अकण्टकम् ||
text_mt: By an offering into the fire of a hundred thousand lotuses smeared with ghee, / he obtains an entire kingdom, free of rivals and thorns.

sanskrit_iast: pañca viṃśati lakṣeṇa dadhi kṣīra ghṛta aśanaḥ | sva dehe sidhyate jantuḥ kauśikasya matam yathā ||
meaning: पञ्च विंशति लक्षेण दधि क्षीर घृत अशनः | स्व देहे सिध्यते जन्तुः कौशिकस्य मतम् यथा ||
text_mt: With twenty-five hundred thousand [recitations], subsisting on curds, milk, and ghee, / a person attains magical accomplishment in his own body, according to the doctrine of Kauśika.

sanskrit_iast: eka aham pañca gavya āśī eka aham māruta aśanaḥ | eka aham brāhmaṇa anna āśī gāyatrī japa ucyate ||
meaning: एक अहम् पञ्च गव्य आशी एक अहम् मारुत अशनः | एक अहम् ब्राह्मण अन्न आशी गायत्री जप उच्यते ||
text_mt: Eating the five products of the cow for one day, feeding on air for one day, / and eating a brahmin's food for one day, [the rite] is called the muttered recitation of the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: śatena gāyatryā snātvā śatam antar jale japet | śatena apas tataḥ pītvā sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: शतेन गायत्र्या स्नात्वा शतम् अन्तर् जले जपेत् | शतेन अपस् ततः पीत्वा सर्व पापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Having bathed with a hundred [recitations] of the Gāyatrī, he should mutter a hundred under water; / then having drunk water with a hundred [recitations], he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast: godhnaḥ pitṛghno mātṛghno brahmahā guru talpaṇaḥ | suvarṇa ratna hārī ca yaś ca vipraḥ surām pibet ||
meaning: गोध्नः पितृघ्नो मातृघ्नो ब्रह्महा गुरु तल्पणः | सुवर्ण रत्न हारी च यश् च विप्रः सुराम् पिबेत् ||
text_mt: A cow-slayer, a father-slayer, a mother-slayer, a slayer of a brahmin, one who violates the teacher's bed, / a stealer of gold and jewels, and whatever brahmin drinks liquor,

sanskrit_iast: ayājya yājanam kṛtvā kṛtvā vā karma garhitam | na sīdet pratigṛhṇāno mahīm api sasāgarām ||
meaning: अयाज्य याजनम् कृत्वा कृत्वा वा कर्म गर्हितम् | न सीदेत् प्रतिगृह्णानो महीम् अपि ससागराम् ||
text_mt: having sacrificed for those unfit to sacrifice, or having done a reprehensible deed, / does not sink, even if he accepts [the gift of] the earth together with the oceans.

sanskrit_iast: ye ca asya duhsthitā loke grahāḥ sūrya ādayo bhuvi | te yānti saumyatām sarve śivā iti na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: ये च अस्य दुह्स्थिता लोके ग्रहाः सूर्य आदयो भुवि | ते यान्ति सौम्यताम् सर्वे शिवा इति न संशयः ||
text_mt: And whatever planets on earth, beginning with the Sun, are ill-disposed toward him in this world, / they all become gentle and auspicious; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva iti japant sūktam rakṣoghnam dasyubhir vṛtaḥ | arātīnām haret prāṇān rakṣāṃsy api na nāśayet ||
meaning: कृणुष्व इति जपन्त् सूक्तम् रक्षोघ्नम् दस्युभिर् वृतः | अरातीनाम् हरेत् प्राणान् रक्षांस्य् अपि न नाशयेत् ||
text_mt: Surrounded by robbers, muttering the demon-slaying hymn 'Kṛṇuṣva,' / he would take the lives of his enemies; nor would demons destroy him.

sanskrit_iast: upatiṣṭheta yo vahnim pari ity ṛcā dine dine | tam rakṣati svayam vahnir viśvato viśvato mukhaḥ ||
meaning: उपतिष्ठेत यो वह्निम् परि इत्य् ऋचा दिने दिने | तम् रक्षति स्वयम् वह्निर् विश्वतो विश्वतो मुखः ||
text_mt: He who reveres the fire day after day with the verse 'Pari,' / Fire himself, facing in every direction, protects him from every quarter.

sanskrit_iast: ko adya iti tu sūktena yo nityam śakram arcati | japed vā atha namas kāraiḥ śakrato labhate varān ||
meaning: को अद्य इति तु सूक्तेन यो नित्यम् शक्रम् अर्चति | जपेद् वा अथ नमस् कारैः शक्रतो लभते वरान् ||
text_mt: He who worships Śakra daily with the hymn 'Ko adya,' / or mutters it with obeisances, obtains boons from Śakra.

sanskrit_iast: kayā iti vāmadevyena kuryāt svastyayanam niśi | japed vā saṃdhi velāsu brahma etat kuśika uditam ||
meaning: कया इति वामदेव्येन कुर्यात् स्वस्त्ययनम् निशि | जपेद् वा संधि वेलासु ब्रह्म एतत् कुशिक उदितम् ||
text_mt: With the Vāmadevya [hymn] 'Kayā,' he should make a safe-conduct rite at night, / or he should mutter it at the junctures of the day; this is the Brahman-formula taught by Kuśika.

sanskrit_iast: haṃsaḥ śuciṣad ity ṛcā śucir īkṣed divākaram | anta kāle japann eti brahmaṇaḥ sadma śāśvatam ||
meaning: हंसः शुचिषद् इत्य् ऋचा शुचिर् ईक्षेद् दिवाकरम् | अन्त काले जपन्न् एति ब्रह्मणः सद्म शाश्वतम् ||
text_mt: Pure, he should look at the sun with the verse 'Haṃsaḥ śuciṣad'; / muttering it at the time of death, he goes to the eternal abode of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣim prapadyamānas tu sthālī pākam yathā vidhi | juhuyāt kṣetra madhye tu śunam vāhās tu pañcabhiḥ ||
meaning: कृषिम् प्रपद्यमानस् तु स्थाली पाकम् यथा विधि | जुहुयात् क्षेत्र मध्ये तु शुनम् वाहास् तु पञ्चभिः ||
text_mt: Undertaking agriculture, he should offer according to the rule a cooked mess of grain / in the middle of the field with the five [verses beginning with] 'Śunaṃ vāhāḥ.'

sanskrit_iast: yathā liṅgam tu viharel lāṅgalam kṛṣīvalaḥ | indrāya ca marudbhyaś ca parjanyāya bhagāya ca ||
meaning: यथा लिङ्गम् तु विहरेल् लाङ्गलम् कृषीवलः | इन्द्राय च मरुद्भ्यश् च पर्जन्याय भगाय च ||
text_mt: According to the characteristics [of the mantras], the plowman should direct the plow / to Indra, to the Maruts, to Parjanya, and to Bhaga,

sanskrit_iast: pūṣṇe dhānyāya sītāyai śunā sīram atha uttaram | hutvā tu pṛthag etāsām yajed etāś ca devatāḥ ||
meaning: पूष्णे धान्याय सीतायै शुना सीरम् अथ उत्तरम् | हुत्वा तु पृथग् एतासाम् यजेद् एताश् च देवताः ||
text_mt: to Pūṣan, to the Grain, to Sītā, and then with the next [verse] to Śunāsīra; / having offered separately to these, he should worship these deities.

sanskrit_iast: gandha mālya upahāraiś ca phala lājā surā āsavaiḥ | pravapaṇe pralavane khala sīta upahārayoḥ ||
meaning: गन्ध माल्य उपहारैश् च फल लाजा सुरा आसवैः | प्रवपणे प्रलवने खल सीत उपहारयोः ||
text_mt: And with offerings of perfumes and garlands, and with fruits, parched grain, surā, and fermented liquor, / at the sowing, at the harvesting, and at the offerings to the threshing floor and furrow,

sanskrit_iast: etā eva yajen nityam devatā vidhinā śuciḥ | amogham karma bhavati kṛṣir vardhati sarvadā ||
meaning: एता एव यजेन् नित्यम् देवता विधिना शुचिः | अमोघम् कर्म भवति कृषिर् वर्धति सर्वदा ||
text_mt: a pure man should always worship these very deities according to the rule; / his work becomes fruitful, and his agriculture always thrives.

sanskrit_iast: kṣetrasya patinā ity etat kṣaitrapatyam tṛcam japet | īkṣet sūryam dvijo nityam vindate kṣetram uttamam ||
meaning: क्षेत्रस्य पतिना इत्य् एतत् क्षैत्रपत्यम् तृचम् जपेत् | ईक्षेत् सूर्यम् द्विजो नित्यम् विन्दते क्षेत्रम् उत्तमम् ||
text_mt: He should mutter the triplet addressed to Kṣetra-pati beginning with 'Kṣetrasya patinā'; / the twice-born should gaze daily at the sun, and he obtains an excellent field.

sanskrit_iast: ākhu utkareṣu caruṇā yajed etena mūṣikān | citra id rāja ity anayā stutvā ca ākhu patim sadā ||
meaning: आखु उत्करेषु चरुणा यजेद् एतेन मूषिकान् | चित्र इद् राज इत्य् अनया स्तुत्वा च आखु पतिम् सदा ||
text_mt: On rat-mounds he should worship the mice with this sacrificial food, / and having praised the lord of rats continuously with the verse 'Citra id rājā,'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān bhojayed atra kīnāśāṃś caiva bhojayet | apramattaḥ śānti paraḥ svayam eva kṛṣim vrajet ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद् अत्र कीनाशांश् चैव भोजयेत् | अप्रमत्तः शान्ति परः स्वयम् एव कृषिम् व्रजेत् ||
text_mt: he should feed brahmins here, and he should also feed the plowmen; / uncareless and devoted to pacification, he himself should go to the field.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmi bhaṅgo gavām hiṃsā tṛṇa kīṭa ādi nāśanam | eteṣu yat kṛtam pāpam khala dānena śudhyati ||
meaning: भूमि भङ्गो गवाम् हिंसा तृण कीट आदि नाशनम् | एतेषु यत् कृतम् पापम् खल दानेन शुध्यति ||
text_mt: The breaking of the earth, injury to cattle, the destruction of grass, insects, and the like: / whatever sin is committed among these is purified by a gift at the threshing floor.

sanskrit_iast: dhānyānām viṃśakam bhāgam śrotriyebhyo nivedayet | viṃśakasya hi dānena kṛṣi doṣāt pramucyate ||
meaning: धान्यानाम् विंशकम् भागम् श्रोत्रियेभ्यो निवेदयेत् | विंशकस्य हि दानेन कृषि दोषात् प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: He should present a twentieth portion of the grain to those learned in the Veda; / indeed, by giving the twentieth portion he is freed from the fault of agriculture.

sanskrit_iast: samudrād iti sūktena yaḥ sadā juhuyād ghṛtam | pūrva uktena eva kalpena samyata ātmā jita indriyaḥ ||
meaning: समुद्राद् इति सूक्तेन यः सदा जुहुयाद् घृतम् | पूर्व उक्तेन एव कल्पेन सम्यत आत्मा जित इन्द्रियः ||
text_mt: He who would always offer ghee with the hymn 'Samudrāt,' / by the rite explained earlier, self-controlled and with conquered senses,

sanskrit_iast: vi jyotiṣā iti jvalayed yatra icchej jātavedasi | tam agniḥ sarvataḥ pāti bhadreṇa draviṇena ca ||
meaning: वि ज्योतिषा इति ज्वलयेद् यत्र इच्छेज् जातवेदसि | तम् अग्निः सर्वतः पाति भद्रेण द्रविणेन च ||
text_mt: should kindle [the fire] wherever he wishes in Jātavedas with the verse 'Vi jyotiṣā'; / Fire protects him from every quarter with auspicious wealth.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāni na iti dvābhyām ṛgbhyām yo vahnim arcati | sa taraty āpadaḥ sarvā yaśaḥ prāpnoti ca akṣayam ||
meaning: विश्वानि न इति द्वाभ्याम् ऋग्भ्याम् यो वह्निम् अर्चति | स तरत्य् आपदः सर्वा यशः प्राप्नोति च अक्षयम् ||
text_mt: He who worships the fire with the two verses 'Viśvāni naḥ,' / overcomes all distress and attains imperishable fame.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vahni rūpa stheyaḥ prāṇa artham havya vāhanaḥ | agne tvam iti sūktena dhanam āyuś ca vāñchatā ||
meaning: हुत्वा वह्नि रूप स्थेयः प्राण अर्थम् हव्य वाहनः | अग्ने त्वम् इति सूक्तेन धनम् आयुश् च वाञ्छता ||
text_mt: Having offered, Fire the conveyor of oblations stands manifest in bodily form to grant life / for him who desires wealth and long life with the hymn 'Agne tvam.'

sanskrit_iast: ya ic ched vividham vittam sattvam ca anupamam mahat | uro ṣṭa iti sūktena upatiṣṭhet śatakratum ||
meaning: य इच् छेद् विविधम् वित्तम् सत्त्वम् च अनुपमम् महत् | उरो ष्ट इति सूक्तेन उपतिष्ठेत् शतक्रतुम् ||
text_mt: He who desires manifold wealth and great, matchless courage, / should revere the one of a hundred rites with the hymn 'Uroṣṭa.'

sanskrit_iast: prajā kāmo yajej nityam caruṇā deva patnayaḥ | upahṛtya upahāram ca śeṣam bhuñjīta vāg yataḥ ||
meaning: प्रजा कामो यजेज् नित्यम् चरुणा देव पत्नयः | उपहृत्य उपहारम् च शेषम् भुञ्जीत वाग् यतः ||
text_mt: Desiring offspring, he should always worship the wives of the gods with a sacrificial porridge; / having presented the offering, he should eat the remainder, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭam ca pradātavyam bhāryāyai putram icchatā | dhenvāḥ sarūpa vatsāyāḥ payasā sādhayec carum ||
meaning: उच्छिष्टम् च प्रदातव्यम् भार्यायै पुत्रम् इच्छता | धेन्वाः सरूप वत्सायाः पयसा साधयेच् चरुम् ||
text_mt: And the leftover food should be given to his wife by him who desires a son; / he should prepare the sacrificial porridge with the milk of a cow that has a calf of the same colour.

sanskrit_iast: anurūpām prajām āśu labhate na atra saṃśayaḥ | svastyātreyam japen nityam prātaḥ prātar dvijaḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: अनुरूपाम् प्रजाम् आशु लभते न अत्र संशयः | स्वस्त्यात्रेयम् जपेन् नित्यम् प्रातः प्रातर् द्विजः शुचिः ||
text_mt: He quickly obtains suitable offspring; of this there is no doubt. / The pure twice-born should daily mutter the Svastyātreya hymn every morning.

sanskrit_iast: etat svastyayanam puṇyam sarva kalmaṣa nāśanam | suhṛdam jñātinam caiva gacchantam anumantrayet ||
meaning: एतत् स्वस्त्ययनम् पुण्यम् सर्व कल्मष नाशनम् | सुहृदम् ज्ञातिनम् चैव गच्छन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयेत् ||
text_mt: This holy rite for well-being is the destroyer of all impurities; / and he should consecrate a friend or kinsman who is departing [on a journey].

sanskrit_iast: svasti panthām iti procya svastimān vrajate adhvani | vijihīṣva vanaspate tad idam cyāvanam smṛtam ||
meaning: स्वस्ति पन्थाम् इति प्रोच्य स्वस्तिमान् व्रजते अध्वनि | विजिहीष्व वनस्पते तद् इदम् च्यावनम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: Having uttered 'Svasti panthām,' he travels safely on the road. / 'Vijihīṣva vanaspate': this is regarded as the expulsion formula.

sanskrit_iast: yam cyāvayitu kāmaḥ syāc cyāvayet tam idam japan | dviṣantam vā padā ākramya bhūmau pāṃsumayīm kṛtim ||
meaning: यम् च्यावयितु कामः स्याच् च्यावयेत् तम् इदम् जपन् | द्विषन्तम् वा पदा आक्रम्य भूमौ पांसुमयीम् कृतिम् ||
text_mt: Whomever he wishes to expel, he should expel muttering this, / or stepping with his foot upon a dust-image on the ground of an enemy,

sanskrit_iast: niṣpekṣyann iva saṃgrāmāc cyavate na atra saṃśayaḥ | striyam garbha pramūḍhām vā pāyayed anumantritam ||
meaning: निष्पेक्ष्यन्न् इव संग्रामाच् च्यवते न अत्र संशयः | स्त्रियम् गर्भ प्रमूढाम् वा पाययेद् अनुमन्त्रितम् ||
text_mt: as if about to crush him, he falls from battle; of this there is no doubt. / Or he should make a woman whose delivery is obstructed drink [water] consecrated with it.

sanskrit_iast: udakam cyāvanena eva garbho adhaḥ cyavate sukham | acchā vada iti sūktam tu vṛṣṭi kāmaḥ prayojayet ||
meaning: उदकम् च्यावनेन एव गर्भो अधः च्यवते सुखम् | अच्छा वद इति सूक्तम् तु वृष्टि कामः प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: With water [consecrated] by this very expulsion formula, the fetus comfortably descends downward. / One who desires rain should employ the hymn 'Acchā vada.'

sanskrit_iast: nirāhāraḥ khinna vāsā acireṇa pravarṣati | hutvā ayutam vaitasīnām kṣīra aktānām huta aśane ||
meaning: निराहारः खिन्न वासा अचिरेण प्रवर्षति | हुत्वा अयुतम् वैतसीनाम् क्षीर अक्तानाम् हुत अशने ||
text_mt: Without food, with wet clothes, it soon rains. / Having offered into the fire ten thousand cane sticks smeared with milk,

sanskrit_iast: mahad varṣam avāpnoti sūktena ācchā vadena hi | ya icched varadām devīm śriyam nityam kule sthitām ||
meaning: महद् वर्षम् अवाप्नोति सूक्तेन आच्छा वदेन हि | य इच्छेद् वरदाम् देवीम् श्रियम् नित्यम् कुले स्थिताम् ||
text_mt: he obtains heavy rain by means of the hymn 'Acchā vada.' / He who wishes the boon-giving goddess Śrī to abide constantly in his family,

sanskrit_iast: sa śuciḥ prayato bhūtvā juhuyād ājyam anvaham | śriyaḥ pañca daśa ṛcam ca śrī kāmaḥ satatam japet ||
meaning: स शुचिः प्रयतो भूत्वा जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् | श्रियः पञ्च दश ऋचम् च श्री कामः सततम् जपेत् ||
text_mt: becoming pure and self-restrained, should offer clarified butter daily; / and desiring prosperity, he should constantly mutter the fifteen-verse hymn of Śrī.

sanskrit_iast: āvāhayet śriyam padme pañcabhiḥ kanako api vā | upahārān upaharet śuklān bhakṣān payo dadhi ||
meaning: आवाहयेत् श्रियम् पद्मे पञ्चभिः कनको अपि वा | उपहारान् उपहरेत् शुक्लान् भक्षान् पयो दधि ||
text_mt: He should invoke Śrī onto a lotus with the five [verses], or even onto gold; / he should offer gifts: white food, milk, and curds.

sanskrit_iast: sthālī pākam ca śālīnām payasā samprakalpayet | cāndrāyaṇa kṛta ātmā tu prapadyet prayataḥ śriyai ||
meaning: स्थाली पाकम् च शालीनाम् पयसा सम्प्रकल्पयेत् | चान्द्रायण कृत आत्मा तु प्रपद्येत् प्रयतः श्रियै ||
text_mt: And he should prepare a cooked mess of grain of rice with milk. / Having purified his soul through the Cāndrāyaṇa observance, attentive, he should turn to Śrī for fortune.

sanskrit_iast: sarva auṣadhībhiḥ phāṇṭābhiḥ snātvā adbhiḥ pāvanair api | upaitu mām deva sakha iti rājño abhiṣecanī ||
meaning: सर्व औषधीभिः फाण्टाभिः स्नात्वा अद्भिः पावनैर् अपि | उपैतु माम् देव सख इति राज्ञो अभिषेचनी ||
text_mt: Having bathed with all herbs, infusions, and purifying waters, / [the verse] "Let the friend of the god come unto me" (upaitu māṃ devasakhaḥ) serves for the consecration of a king.

sanskrit_iast: manasaḥ kāmam ity eṣā paśu kāma abhiṣecanī | kadarmena iti yaḥ snāyāt prajā kāmaḥ śuci vrataḥ ||
meaning: मनसः कामम् इत्य् एषा पशु काम अभिषेचनी | कदर्मेन इति यः स्नायात् प्रजा कामः शुचि व्रतः ||
text_mt: "The desire of the mind" (manasaḥ kāmam)—this serves for the consecration of one desiring cattle. / One desiring offspring, pure of vow, should bathe with [the verse] "By mud" (kardamena).

sanskrit_iast: aśva pūrṇām iti snāyād rājya kāmaḥ śuci vrataḥ | rohite carmaṇi snāyād brāhmaṇas tu yathā vidhi ||
meaning: अश्व पूर्णाम् इति स्नायाद् राज्य कामः शुचि व्रतः | रोहिते चर्मणि स्नायाद् ब्राह्मणस् तु यथा विधि ||
text_mt: One desiring kingship, pure of vow, should bathe with [the verse] "Rich in horses" (aśvapūrnām). / But a brahmin should bathe on a red hide according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast: rājā carmaṇi vaiyāghre kṣatriyas tv atha raurave | basta carmaṇi vaiśyas tu homaḥ kāryas tv anantaram ||
meaning: राजा चर्मणि वैयाघ्रे क्षत्रियस् त्व् अथ रौरवे | बस्त चर्मणि वैश्यस् तु होमः कार्यस् त्व् अनन्तरम् ||
text_mt: a king on a tiger skin, a kṣatriya on the hide of a ruru deer, / and a vaiśya on a goat skin; immediately thereafter the fire offering should be performed.

sanskrit_iast: candrām iti tu padmāni juhuyāt sarpiṣā dvijaḥ | āditya varṇa ity anayā bilva homo vidhīyate ||
meaning: चन्द्राम् इति तु पद्मानि जुहुयात् सर्पिषा द्विजः | आदित्य वर्ण इत्य् अनया बिल्व होमो विधीयते ||
text_mt: With [the verse] "Shining" (candrām), a twice-born should offer lotuses with clarified butter. / With "Sun-colored" (ādityavarṇe), a fire offering of bilva fruits is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: bilva idhma eva vā agniḥ syāt sthālīś ca juhuyād dvijaḥ | daśa sāhasriko homaḥ śrī kāmaḥ prathamo vidhiḥ ||
meaning: बिल्व इध्म एव वा अग्निः स्यात् स्थालीश् च जुहुयाद् द्विजः | दश साहस्रिको होमः श्री कामः प्रथमो विधिः ||
text_mt: Or the fire should have only bilva firewood, and the twice-born should offer the cooked messes of grain. / A fire offering of ten thousand [oblations] for one desiring fortune is the first rule.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā tu prayutam samyag anantām vindate śriyam | ayutam śatakṛtvas tu hutvā śuklāni sarpiṣā ||
meaning: हुत्वा तु प्रयुतम् सम्यग् अनन्ताम् विन्दते श्रियम् | अयुतम् शतकृत्वस् तु हुत्वा शुक्लानि सर्पिषा ||
text_mt: Having offered a hundred thousand [oblations] properly, he attains endless fortune. / But having offered white [substances] with clarified butter ten thousand times a hundredfold,

sanskrit_iast: anantām avyavacchinām śāśvatīm vindate śriyam | aśaktau japa eva ukto daśa sāhasriko varaḥ ||
meaning: अनन्ताम् अव्यवच्छिनाम् शाश्वतीम् विन्दते श्रियम् | अशक्तौ जप एव उक्तो दश साहस्रिको वरः ||
text_mt: he attains endless, uninterrupted, eternal fortune. / If unable [to offer], muttered recitation of ten thousand is declared excellent.

sanskrit_iast: aptvā nu prayutam samyag anantām vindate śriyam | ayutam śatakṛtvas tu japtvā śriyam upāśnute ||
meaning: अप्त्वा नु प्रयुतम् सम्यग् अनन्ताम् विन्दते श्रियम् | अयुतम् शतकृत्वस् तु जप्त्वा श्रियम् उपाश्नुते ||
text_mt: Having recited a hundred thousand properly, he attains endless fortune; / but having recited ten thousand a hundredfold, he attains fortune.

sanskrit_iast: apsv eva juhuyān nityam padmāny ayutaśo niśi | dṛṣṭvā śriyam tu uparamet kilāsatvād bibheta vai ||
meaning: अप्स्व् एव जुहुयान् नित्यम् पद्मान्य् अयुतशो निशि | दृष्ट्वा श्रियम् तु उपरमेत् किलासत्वाद् बिभेत वै ||
text_mt: He should constantly offer lotuses into water by the ten thousands at night. / But seeing Śrī, he should desist; for he might fear becoming leprous.

sanskrit_iast: bilva āśī bilva nilayo juhuyād bilvāni sarpiṣā | eka viṃśati rātreṇa parām siddhim niyacchati ||
meaning: बिल्व आशी बिल्व निलयो जुहुयाद् बिल्वानि सर्पिषा | एक विंशति रात्रेण पराम् सिद्धिम् नियच्छति ||
text_mt: Eating bilva fruits, dwelling in a bilva tree, he should offer bilva fruits with clarified butter; / within twenty-one nights he obtains the supreme magical accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast: yena yena ca kāmena juhoti prayataḥ śriyai | padmāny atha api bilvāni sa sa kāmaḥ samṛdhyati ||
meaning: येन येन च कामेन जुहोति प्रयतः श्रियै | पद्मान्य् अथ अपि बिल्वानि स स कामः समृध्यति ||
text_mt: With whatever desire, attentive, he offers to Śrī / either lotuses or bilva fruits, that desire of his succeeds.

sanskrit_iast: na jātu kṛpaṇa arthāya śriyam āvāhayet kvacit | na yat kiṃcana kāmena homaḥ kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ||
meaning: न जातु कृपण अर्थाय श्रियम् आवाहयेत् क्वचित् | न यत् किंचन कामेन होमः कार्यः कथंचन ||
text_mt: He should never invoke Śrī for a petty purpose anywhere; / a fire offering should under no circumstances be made for any trifling desire.

sanskrit_iast: mahad vā prārthyamānena rājya kāmena vā punaḥ | vācaḥ param prārthayitā yatnād yuktaḥ śriyam yajet ||
meaning: महद् वा प्रार्थ्यमानेन राज्य कामेन वा पुनः | वाचः परम् प्रार्थयिता यत्नाद् युक्तः श्रियम् यजेत् ||
text_mt: Whether seeking something great, or again desiring kingship, / or seeking the highest speech, he should worship Śrī with effort and concentrated mind.

sanskrit_iast: agnir etv iti sūktena juhuyād ājyam anvaham | ojasvinīm avāpnoti prajām dharmavatīm śubhām ||
meaning: अग्निर् एत्व् इति सूक्तेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् | ओजस्विनीम् अवाप्नोति प्रजाम् धर्मवतीम् शुभाम् ||
text_mt: With the hymn "May Agni come" (agnir etu), he should offer clarified butter every day; / he obtains vigorous, virtuous, and auspicious progeny.

sanskrit_iast: acchā na ity ṛcā dīptam upatiṣṭhed vibhāvasum | prajām prāpya jayet śatrūṃs tarate duritāni ca ||
meaning: अच्छा न इत्य् ऋचा दीप्तम् उपतिष्ठेद् विभावसुम् | प्रजाम् प्राप्य जयेत् शत्रूंस् तरते दुरितानि च ||
text_mt: With the verse "Toward us" (acchā naḥ), he should worship the blazing fire; / having obtained offspring, he conquers enemies and overcomes misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast: ā gāva iti sūktena goṣṭhagā loka mātaraḥ | upatiṣṭhed vrajantīś ca ya icchet tāḥ sadā akṣayāḥ ||
meaning: आ गाव इति सूक्तेन गोष्ठगा लोक मातरः | उपतिष्ठेद् व्रजन्तीश् च य इच्छेत् ताः सदा अक्षयाः ||
text_mt: With the hymn "Hither, the cows" (ā gāvaḥ), he who desires that they be forever imperishable / should worship the mothers of the world standing in the cowpen and moving about.

sanskrit_iast: tvām iddhi iti pragāthena upatiṣṭhet śatakratum | madhya ahne saṃdhyayoś caiva japan dhanam avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: त्वाम् इद्धि इति प्रगाथेन उपतिष्ठेत् शतक्रतुम् | मध्य अह्ने संध्ययोश् चैव जपन् धनम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: With the pragātha "You indeed" (tvām iddhi), he should worship Śatakratu; / reciting it at midday and at the two twilights, he will obtain wealth.

sanskrit_iast: upa iti tisṛbhī rājño dundubhīn saṃspṛśed raṇe | ojo balam avāpnoti śatrūṃś caiva niyacchati ||
meaning: उप इति तिसृभी राज्ञो दुन्दुभीन् संस्पृशेद् रणे | ओजो बलम् अवाप्नोति शत्रूंश् चैव नियच्छति ||
text_mt: With the three [verses] "Up..." (upa), he should touch the king's war drums in battle; / he obtains vigor and strength, and subdues enemies.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇinā tṛṇam ādāya yajña ayajña iti yo abhyaset | so adhītasya asya sūktasya phalam prāpnoti na atṛṇaḥ ||
meaning: पाणिना तृणम् आदाय यज्ञ अयज्ञ इति यो अभ्यसेत् | सो अधीतस्य अस्य सूक्तस्य फलम् प्राप्नोति न अतृणः ||
text_mt: Taking a blade of grass in his hand, whoever repeats [the hymn beginning] "Sacrifice, non-sacrifice" (yajñāyajñā), / he obtains the fruit of this recited hymn, not one without a blade of grass.

sanskrit_iast: sūkta ante ca tṛṇam tv agnāv iriṇe vā udake api vā | nikṣipet tat prayatnena tyaktvā anyatra bhaya āvaham ||
meaning: सूक्त अन्ते च तृणम् त्व् अग्नाव् इरिणे वा उदके अपि वा | निक्षिपेत् तत् प्रयत्नेन त्यक्त्वा अन्यत्र भय आवहम् ||
text_mt: And at the end of the hymn, he should cast that blade of grass carefully into fire, or into a barren land, or into water; / if discarded elsewhere, it brings danger.

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇa pāṇir japan sūktam rakṣoghnam dasyubhir vṛtaḥ | na bhayam vindate kiṃcid rakṣobhyo aribhya eva ca ||
meaning: तृण पाणिर् जपन् सूक्तम् रक्षोघ्नम् दस्युभिर् वृतः | न भयम् विन्दते किंचिद् रक्षोभ्यो अरिभ्य एव च ||
text_mt: With a blade of grass in hand, reciting the demon-slaying hymn when surrounded by robbers, / he finds no fear at all from demons and from enemies.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhāt prapadyamānas tu panthānam dhana kāmyayā | japet so adhvani yatnena api panthām iti vrajan ||
meaning: गृहात् प्रपद्यमानस् तु पन्थानम् धन काम्यया | जपेत् सो अध्वनि यत्नेन अपि पन्थाम् इति व्रजन् ||
text_mt: Setting out from home onto the road with the desire for wealth, / walking on the road, he should recite with care [the verse] "Even the path" (api panthām).

sanskrit_iast: ye ke ca jmā ity ṛcam tv etām dhyāyan niśi diva okasaḥ | agnau hutvā etayā ca ājyam dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: ये के च ज्मा इत्य् ऋचम् त्व् एताम् ध्यायन् निशि दिव ओकसः | अग्नौ हुत्वा एतया च आज्यम् दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Meditating on this verse "Whoever on earth" (ye kecā jmā) upon the dwellers of heaven at night, / and having offered clarified butter with it into the fire, he will attain a long life.

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvā iti sūktam tu pauṣṇam draviṇa vardhanam | nityam japet śucir bhūtvā dhanam vindaty abhīpsitam ||
meaning: वयम् उ त्वा इति सूक्तम् तु पौष्णम् द्रविण वर्धनम् | नित्यम् जपेत् शुचिर् भूत्वा धनम् विन्दत्य् अभीप्सितम् ||
text_mt: The hymn to Pūṣan "We indeed thee" (vayam u tvā), which increases wealth— / having become pure, he should recite it constantly; he finds the desired wealth.

sanskrit_iast: yasya naṣṭam bhavet kiṃcid dravyam gaur dvipadam dhanam | naśyed vā adhvani yo mohāt sampūṣan sa japen niśi ||
meaning: यस्य नष्टम् भवेत् किंचिद् द्रव्यम् गौर् द्विपदम् धनम् | नश्येद् वा अध्वनि यो मोहात् सम्पूषन् स जपेन् निशि ||
text_mt: One whose property, cattle, bipeds, or wealth is lost, / or who loses his way on a road through confusion, should recite [the hymn beginning] "Together, Pūṣan" (saṃ pūṣan) at night.

sanskrit_iast: iyam ity etad ādy antam sūktam sārasvatam dvijaḥ | nityam japet śucir bhūtvā vāgmī bhavati buddhimān ||
meaning: इयम् इत्य् एतद् आद्य् अन्तम् सूक्तम् सारस्वतम् द्विजः | नित्यम् जपेत् शुचिर् भूत्वा वाग्मी भवति बुद्धिमान् ||
text_mt: A twice-born, having become pure, should constantly recite this hymn to Sarasvatī from beginning to end, "This" (iyam); / he becomes eloquent and wise.

sanskrit_iast: sam vām iti tu yat sūktam aṣṭa ṛcam traiṣṭubham smṛtam | taj japan prayato nityam iṣṭān kāmānt samaśnute ||
meaning: सम् वाम् इति तु यत् सूक्तम् अष्ट ऋचम् त्रैष्टुभम् स्मृतम् | तज् जपन् प्रयतो नित्यम् इष्टान् कामान्त् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: The hymn "Together for both of you" (saṃ vām), which consists of eight triṣṭubh verses, / reciting it constantly with concentrated mind, he attains all desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast: yo adri bhit tu yat sūktam tat sapatna nibarhaṇam | bṛhaspatim namas kṛtvā sapatnānt stṛṇute bahūn ||
meaning: यो अद्रि भित् तु यत् सूक्तम् तत् सपत्न निबर्हणम् | बृहस्पतिम् नमस् कृत्वा सपत्नान्त् स्तृणुते बहून् ||
text_mt: The hymn "Who splits the rock" (yo adribhit) destroys rivals; / having paid homage to Bṛhaspati, he strikes down many rivals.

sanskrit_iast: enasvī vā abhiśasto vā kṛtvā vā karma garhitam | somā raudram japet sūktam kṛtsnam eno vyapohati ||
meaning: एनस्वी वा अभिशस्तो वा कृत्वा वा कर्म गर्हितम् | सोमा रौद्रम् जपेत् सूक्तम् कृत्स्नम् एनो व्यपोहति ||
text_mt: Whether sinful, accused, or having done a despised deed, / he should recite the hymn to Soma and Rudra; it removes all sin.

sanskrit_iast: juhuyād vā ya etābhir ṛgbhir nityam ghṛta vrataḥ | vāruṇebhyo sa pāśebhyo mucyate śam tathā āpnuyāt ||
meaning: जुहुयाद् वा य एताभिर् ऋग्भिर् नित्यम् घृत व्रतः | वारुणेभ्यो स पाशेभ्यो मुच्यते शम् तथा आप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: Or whoever, holding a vow of clarified butter, constantly offers with these verses, / he is released from the nooses of Varuṇa and attains well-being.

sanskrit_iast: jīmūta sūktasya vidhim yathā liṅgam avekṣya vai | ṛgbhiḥ karmāṇi kurvīta ratha aṅgānām yathā vidhi ||
meaning: जीमूत सूक्तस्य विधिम् यथा लिङ्गम् अवेक्ष्य वै | ऋग्भिः कर्माणि कुर्वीत रथ अङ्गानाम् यथा विधि ||
text_mt: Observing the rule of the Cloud hymn (jīmūtasūkta) according to its characteristic marks, / he should perform the rites of the chariot parts with its verses according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmam tu prayātasya rājñaś ca etat prayojayet | sarvāṇy aṅgāni rathyāṃś ca sadaśvāṃś ca anumantrayet ||
meaning: संग्रामम् तु प्रयातस्य राज्ञश् च एतत् प्रयोजयेत् | सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि रथ्यांश् च सदश्वांश् च अनुमन्त्रयेत् ||
text_mt: And he should apply this for a king setting out for battle; / he should consecrate with mantras all parts [of the chariot], the charioteers, and the noble steeds.

sanskrit_iast: yam eva deśam gaccheta śatrum vā apy anumantritaḥ | na ajitvā vinivarteta param hi brahmaṇo balam ||
meaning: यम् एव देशम् गच्छेत शत्रुम् वा अप्य् अनुमन्त्रितः | न अजित्वा विनिवर्तेत परम् हि ब्रह्मणो बलम् ||
text_mt: Whatever region he goes to or whatever enemy, consecrated with mantras, / he would not return without conquering; for supreme is the power of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: putrān āyur atha ārogyam ya icched avyayam sukham | so agnim nara iti sūktena juhuyād ājyam anvaham ||
meaning: पुत्रान् आयुर् अथ आरोग्यम् य इच्छेद् अव्ययम् सुखम् | सो अग्निम् नर इति सूक्तेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् ||
text_mt: He who desires sons, long life, freedom from disease, and imperishable happiness / should offer clarified butter every day with the hymn "Agni the men..." (agnim naraḥ).

sanskrit_iast: pra agnaye atha tribhiḥ sūktaiḥ saṃdhyayor japam ārabhet | na rakṣobhyo bhayam vetti dhanam prāpnoti ca akṣayam ||
meaning: प्र अग्नये अथ त्रिभिः सूक्तैः संध्ययोर् जपम् आरभेत् | न रक्षोभ्यो भयम् वेत्ति धनम् प्राप्नोति च अक्षयम् ||
text_mt: With the three hymns beginning with "Forth to Agni" (prāgnaye), he should undertake recitation at both twilights; / he knows no fear of demons and obtains imperishable wealth.

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā yaḥ pragāthena nityam arcati vrajiṇam | sa śriyam vipulām bhuṅkte prāpnoti ca dhana āyuṣī ||
meaning: अभि त्वा यः प्रगाथेन नित्यम् अर्चति व्रजिणम् | स श्रियम् विपुलाम् भुङ्क्ते प्राप्नोति च धन आयुषी ||
text_mt: Whoever constantly worships the wielder of the thunderbolt with the pragātha "Unto thee" (abhi tvā), / he enjoys abundant fortune and obtains wealth and long life.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃvatīḥ śam na indra agnī ity ete satatam japet | na rakṣobhyo na bhūtebhyo vyādhibhyo vā bhayam bhavet ||
meaning: शंवतीः शम् न इन्द्र अग्नी इत्य् एते सततम् जपेत् | न रक्षोभ्यो न भूतेभ्यो व्याधिभ्यो वा भयम् भवेत् ||
text_mt: He should constantly recite the verses containing the word śam: "May Indra and Agni be auspicious to us" (śaṃ na indrāgnī); / there will be no fear for him from demons, spirits, or diseases.

sanskrit_iast: niveṣṭu kāmo roga ārto bhaga sūktam sadā abhyaset | niveśam vindate kṣipram rogebhyaś ca pramucyate ||
meaning: निवेष्टु कामो रोग आर्तो भग सूक्तम् सदा अभ्यसेत् | निवेशम् विन्दते क्षिप्रम् रोगेभ्यश् च प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Desiring to establish a household, or afflicted with disease, he should constantly repeat the Bhaga hymn; / he quickly finds a home and is freed from diseases.

sanskrit_iast: imā iti japen nityam raudram sūktam dvijaḥ śuciḥ | taj japan prajayā vittaiḥ svayam caiva na riṣyati ||
meaning: इमा इति जपेन् नित्यम् रौद्रम् सूक्तम् द्विजः शुचिः | तज् जपन् प्रजया वित्तैः स्वयम् चैव न रिष्यति ||
text_mt: A pure twice-born should constantly recite the hymn to Rudra, "These" (imāḥ); / reciting it, he does not suffer harm in his progeny, in his wealth, or in himself.

sanskrit_iast: uttitīrṣur apo yas tu śaṅket srotyā samāgame | samudra jyeṣṭhā iti japet sūktam etad bhaya apaham ||
meaning: उत्तितीर्षुर् अपो यस् तु शङ्केत् स्रोत्या समागमे | समुद्र ज्येष्ठा इति जपेत् सूक्तम् एतद् भय अपहम् ||
text_mt: He who desires to cross waters, or fears at the confluence of torrents, / should recite the hymn "Whose eldest is the ocean" (samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ); it removes danger.

sanskrit_iast: āditya daivate sūkte ripughne roga nāśane | japet prātaḥ śucir bhūtvā ripu rogaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: आदित्य दैवते सूक्ते रिपुघ्ने रोग नाशने | जपेत् प्रातः शुचिर् भूत्वा रिपु रोगैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Having become pure in the morning, he should recite the two hymns dedicated to the Ādityas, which destroy enemies and eliminate disease; / he is freed from enemies and diseases.

sanskrit_iast: vāstoṣpate prati ity etat sūktam vāstoṣpatam japet | snātaḥ kṛtvā vaiśvadevam param brahma idam ucyate ||
meaning: वास्तोष्पते प्रति इत्य् एतत् सूक्तम् वास्तोष्पतम् जपेत् | स्नातः कृत्वा वैश्वदेवम् परम् ब्रह्म इदम् उच्यते ||
text_mt: Having bathed and performed the Vaiśvadeva rite, he should recite this hymn to Vāstoṣpati, "O Vāstoṣpati, accept" (vāstoṣpate prati); / this is declared to be the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: amīvahā iti sūktena bhūtāni svāpayen niśi | na hi prasvāpanam kiṃcid īdṛśam vidyate kvacit ||
meaning: अमीवहा इति सूक्तेन भूतानि स्वापयेन् निशि | न हि प्रस्वापनम् किंचिद् ईदृशम् विद्यते क्वचित् ||
text_mt: With the hymn beginning "Amīvahā" one should put beings to sleep at night; / for no such sleep-inducing [mantra] exists anywhere.

sanskrit_iast: sambādhe viṣame durge baddho vā nirgataḥ kvacit | palāyan vā gṛhīto vā taskaraiḥ sa japed idam ||
meaning: सम्बाधे विषमे दुर्गे बद्धो वा निर्गतः क्वचित् | पलायन् वा गृहीतो वा तस्करैः स जपेद् इदम् ||
text_mt: In a narrow passage, rough terrain, or a fortress, whether bound or having set out anywhere, / or fleeing, or captured by robbers, he should mutter this:

sanskrit_iast: amīvahā viśvavatīm uddhṛtya anyāḥ prayojayet | sūktam etaj japet sarvam iti manyeta śaunakaḥ ||
meaning: अमीवहा विश्ववतीम् उद्धृत्य अन्याः प्रयोजयेत् | सूक्तम् एतज् जपेत् सर्वम् इति मन्येत शौनकः ||
text_mt: "The slayer of disease" (RV 7.55); setting aside the verse containing viśva, he should employ the others. / "One should mutter this entire hymn," so thinks Śaunaka.

sanskrit_iast: tri rātrim niyato anaśnan śrapayet pāyasam carum | tena āhuti śatam pūrṇam juhuyāt sarpiṣā dvijaḥ ||
meaning: त्रि रात्रिम् नियतो अनश्नन् श्रपयेत् पायसम् चरुम् | तेन आहुति शतम् पूर्णम् जुहुयात् सर्पिषा द्विजः ||
text_mt: Restrained, eating nothing for three nights, he should cook a rice-milk caru. / With it, the twice-born should offer a full hundred oblations with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast: samuddiśya mahā devam tryambakam tryambaka ity ṛcā | etat parva śatam kṛtvā jīved abda śatam sukhī ||
meaning: समुद्दिश्य महा देवम् त्र्यम्बकम् त्र्यम्बक इत्य् ऋचा | एतत् पर्व शतम् कृत्वा जीवेद् अब्द शतम् सुखी ||
text_mt: addressing the Great God Tryambaka with the verse "Tryambaka" (RV 7.59.12). / Having performed this on a hundred parvan days, he will live happily for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast: tat cakśur ity ṛcā snāta upatiṣṭhed divākaram | udyantam madhyagam caiva dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ ||
meaning: तत् चक्शुर् इत्य् ऋचा स्नात उपतिष्ठेद् दिवाकरम् | उद्यन्तम् मध्यगम् चैव दीर्घम् आयुर् जिजीविषुः ||
text_mt: Bathed, he should attend upon the Sun with the verse "That eye" (RV 7.66.16), / both as it rises and reaches midday, desiring to live a long life.

sanskrit_iast: rātryā apara kāle ya utthāya prayataḥ śuciḥ |
meaning: रात्र्या अपर काले य उत्थाय प्रयतः शुचिः |
text_mt: He who, having risen in the latter part of the night, restrained and pure,

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣā ity upatiṣṭheta ṣaḍbhiḥ sūktaiḥ kṛta añjaliḥ ||
meaning: व्युषा इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत षड्भिः सूक्तैः कृत अञ्जलिः ||
text_mt: should attend upon [Uṣas] with the six hymns beginning "At daybreak" (RV 7.75–80) with folded hands,

sanskrit_iast: prāpnuyāt sa hiraṇya ādi nānā rūpam dhanam bahu | gā aśvān puruṣān dhānyam striyo vāsāṃsy aja avikam ||
meaning: प्राप्नुयात् स हिरण्य आदि नाना रूपम् धनम् बहु | गा अश्वान् पुरुषान् धान्यम् स्त्रियो वासांस्य् अज अविकम् ||
text_mt: would obtain much wealth of various kinds, beginning with gold: / cattle, horses, men, grain, women, garments, goats, and sheep.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsu tv āsu kṣitiṣu japan baddhaḥ pramucyate | tiṣṭhan rātrau japed enām vipāśaḥ samprapadyate ||
meaning: ध्रुवासु त्व् आसु क्षितिषु जपन् बद्धः प्रमुच्यते | तिष्ठन् रात्रौ जपेद् एनाम् विपाशः सम्प्रपद्यते ||
text_mt: Muttering [the verse] "In these firm [abodes]" (RV 7.88.7), one who is bound is freed. / Standing at night, he should mutter this; he becomes free of fetters.

sanskrit_iast: aho rātram sthitaś caivam anaśnant syād viceṣṭitaḥ | ayaḥ pāśaḥ sphuṭanty asya dāru pāśās tathaiva ca ||
meaning: अहो रात्रम् स्थितश् चैवम् अनश्नन्त् स्याद् विचेष्टितः | अयः पाशः स्फुटन्त्य् अस्य दारु पाशास् तथैव च ||
text_mt: And standing thus for a day and night, not eating, active, / his iron bonds break, and likewise his wooden fetters.

sanskrit_iast: syonā iti pṛthivīm devīm prapadyen niyataḥ sadā | japed enām ca tatra api bhūmi pāśāt pramucyate ||
meaning: स्योना इति पृथिवीम् देवीम् प्रपद्येन् नियतः सदा | जपेद् एनाम् च तत्र अपि भूमि पाशात् प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: He should always take refuge in the goddess Earth with [the verse] "Be pleasant" (RV 7.89.5), / and should also mutter this there; he is released from the bondage of the earth.

sanskrit_iast: yat kiṃcit pātakam kuryāt karmaṇā manasā girā | yat kiṃca idam varuṇa iti ṛcam japtvā pramucyate ||
meaning: यत् किंचित् पातकम् कुर्यात् कर्मणा मनसा गिरा | यत् किंच इदम् वरुण इति ऋचम् जप्त्वा प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Whatever major sin he may commit by deed, thought, or word, / having muttered the verse "Whatever this be, O Varuṇa" (RV 7.89.5), he is released [from it].

sanskrit_iast: agamyā gamane ca etat prāyaścittam vidhīyate | anyatra guru talpāc ca tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate ||
meaning: अगम्या गमने च एतत् प्रायश्चित्तम् विधीयते | अन्यत्र गुरु तल्पाच् च तस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: This expiation is also prescribed for intercourse with an unapproachable woman, / except for violating a guru's bed; he is released from that sin.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa aham abhuñjānaḥ sva gotra āgamane japet | ardha māsam abhuñjānaḥ sakhi dāreṣu saṃvasan ||
meaning: द्वादश अहम् अभुञ्जानः स्व गोत्र आगमने जपेत् | अर्ध मासम् अभुञ्जानः सखि दारेषु संवसन् ||
text_mt: Not eating for twelve days, he should mutter it after intercourse with a woman of his own gotra; / not eating for half a month, after cohabiting with a friend's wife.

sanskrit_iast: idam āpaḥ pravahata yat kim ca idam ṛcam punaḥ | iti ca etā japed apaḥ praviśya eteṣu karmasu ||
meaning: इदम् आपः प्रवहत यत् किम् च इदम् ऋचम् पुनः | इति च एता जपेद् अपः प्रविश्य एतेषु कर्मसु ||
text_mt: He should enter the waters and further mutter these verses, / "O Waters, carry away this" (RV 1.23.22) and "Whatever this be" (RV 7.89.5), in [expiation of] these deeds.

sanskrit_iast: indrā viṣṇū namas kṛtya juhuyād ājyam anvaham | sūktābhyām para etābhyām ya icched bhūtim ātmanaḥ ||
meaning: इन्द्रा विष्णू नमस् कृत्य जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् | सूक्ताभ्याम् पर एताभ्याम् य इच्छेद् भूतिम् आत्मनः ||
text_mt: Having bowed to Indra and Viṣṇu, he should daily offer clarified butter / with the next two hymns (RV 7.99–100), if he desires prosperity for himself.

sanskrit_iast: āsya daghnam vigāhya ambhaḥ prān mukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ | sūktābhyām tisra etābhyām upatiṣṭhed divākaram ||
meaning: आस्य दघ्नम् विगाह्य अम्भः प्रान् मुखः प्रयतः शुचिः | सूक्ताभ्याम् तिस्र एताभ्याम् उपतिष्ठेद् दिवाकरम् ||
text_mt: Having plunged into water up to his mouth, facing east, restrained and pure, / he should attend upon the Sun with these two hymns [and] three [verses] (RV 7.101–102; 103.1–3).

sanskrit_iast: anaśnatā tu japtavyam vṛṣṭi kāmena yatnataḥ | pañca rātre vyatīte tu mahad varṣam avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: अनश्नता तु जप्तव्यम् वृष्टि कामेन यत्नतः | पञ्च रात्रे व्यतीते तु महद् वर्षम् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: It should be muttered with effort by one eating nothing, desiring rain; / when five nights have passed, he will obtain heavy rain.

sanskrit_iast: yo aribhiḥ pratipadyeta abhiśasyeta vā mṛṣā | upoṣya ekam tri rātram sa juhuyād ājyam anvaham ||
meaning: यो अरिभिः प्रतिपद्येत अभिशस्येत वा मृषा | उपोष्य एकम् त्रि रात्रम् स जुहुयाद् आज्यम् अन्वहम् ||
text_mt: He who is attacked by enemies or falsely accused, / having fasted for one three-night period, should daily offer clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast: indrā soma iti sūktam tu japec ca etat śata avaram | kiṃcid dadyād dvijebhyo ante stṛṇute sarva śātravān ||
meaning: इन्द्रा सोम इति सूक्तम् तु जपेच् च एतत् शत अवरम् | किंचिद् दद्याद् द्विजेभ्यो अन्ते स्तृणुते सर्व शात्रवान् ||
text_mt: and he should mutter this hymn, "O Indra and Soma" (RV 7.104), at least a hundred times. / At the end, he should give something to brahmins; he overcomes all his enemies.

sanskrit_iast: yasya lupyed vratam mohād vrātyair vā saṃspṛśed dvijaḥ | upoṣya ājyam ca juhuyāt tvam agne vratapā iti ||
meaning: यस्य लुप्येद् व्रतम् मोहाद् व्रात्यैर् वा संस्पृशेद् द्विजः | उपोष्य आज्यम् च जुहुयात् त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा इति ||
text_mt: A twice-born whose vow is broken through delusion, or who comes into contact with outcasts, / having fasted, should offer clarified butter with [the verse] "You, O Agni, are guardian of the vow" (RV 8.11.1).

sanskrit_iast: pra saṃrājam iti tv etaj japann īkṣed divākaram | udyantam upatiṣṭheta snātvā snātvā dine dine ||
meaning: प्र संराजम् इति त्व् एतज् जपन्न् ईक्षेद् दिवाकरम् | उद्यन्तम् उपतिष्ठेत स्नात्वा स्नात्वा दिने दिने ||
text_mt: Muttering [the hymn] "The universal sovereign" (RV 8.19), he should look at the Sun; / bathing day after day, he should attend upon it as it rises.

sanskrit_iast: abhiyukto bhaved yas tu vivaded vā api kenacit | nirjitya sagaṇān śatrūn kṣipram vādam parājayet ||
meaning: अभियुक्तो भवेद् यस् तु विवदेद् वा अपि केनचित् | निर्जित्य सगणान् शत्रून् क्षिप्रम् वादम् पराजयेत् ||
text_mt: He who is accused or enters into a dispute with someone, / having conquered his enemies along with their troops, will quickly defeat [them in] debate.

sanskrit_iast: śam agir agnibhiś ca iti prapadyed vāyu bhāskarau | agnim prathamataḥ stutvā mahat kṛcchrāt pramucyate ||
meaning: शम् अगिर् अग्निभिश् च इति प्रपद्येद् वायु भास्करौ | अग्निम् प्रथमतः स्तुत्वा महत् कृच्छ्रात् प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: With [the verses] "Auspicious fire" and "With fires" (RV 8.44.17ab), he should take refuge in Vāyu and the Sun. / Having first praised Agni, he is released from great distress.

sanskrit_iast: na hi iti yaś catuṣkeṇa snātvā vai prātar utthitaḥ | dvau māsāv upatiṣṭheta sa trāyati bhayāt svayam ||
meaning: न हि इति यश् चतुष्केण स्नात्वा वै प्रातर् उत्थितः | द्वौ मासाव् उपतिष्ठेत स त्रायति भयात् स्वयम् ||
text_mt: He who, having bathed upon rising in the morning, attends [upon the gods] / with the four-verse hymn "For not..." (RV 8.45.1–4) for two months, is himself saved from danger.

sanskrit_iast: tṛcam japtvā āyad ity etat snātvā abhyarcya puraṃdaram | prāpnuyān mānasān kāmān sampūjya vasu rociṣaḥ ||
meaning: तृचम् जप्त्वा आयद् इत्य् एतत् स्नात्वा अभ्यर्च्य पुरंदरम् | प्राप्नुयान् मानसान् कामान् सम्पूज्य वसु रोचिषः ||
text_mt: Having bathed, worshipped Puraṃdara, and muttered the triplet "As he came" (RV 8.45.31–33), / and having worshipped the Vasu-radiant ones, he will obtain his heart's desires.

sanskrit_iast: ādyāni trīṇi sūktāni pañca ca agre bṛhann iti | ṣaṭ tathā antyāni sūktāni agnim nara ito iti ca ||
meaning: आद्यानि त्रीणि सूक्तानि पञ्च च अग्रे बृहन्न् इति | षट् तथा अन्त्यानि सूक्तानि अग्निम् नर इतो इति च ||
text_mt: The first three hymns (RV 8.46–48) and the five beginning with "Great" (RV 8.49–53), / as well as the six final hymns beginning with "Agni, the men from here" (RV 8.74; 8.87–91)—

sanskrit_iast: prakṛtāni iti ca adhyāyam bhojanāt prāk paṭhed idam | sarvān kāmān avāpnoti mucyeta sarva kilbiṣaiḥ ||
meaning: प्रकृतानि इति च अध्यायम् भोजनात् प्राक् पठेद् इदम् | सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति मुच्येत सर्व किल्बिषैः ||
text_mt: he should recite this chapter as set forth before eating; / he attains all desires and is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast: prāg bhojanam idam brahma mānavānām maharṣiṇām | pūrva ahṇe japato nityam artha siddhiḥ parā bhavet ||
meaning: प्राग् भोजनम् इदम् ब्रह्म मानवानाम् महर्षिणाम् | पूर्व अह्णे जपतो नित्यम् अर्थ सिद्धिः परा भवेत् ||
text_mt: This is the pre-meal recitation of sacred texts of the human great ṛṣis. / For one constantly muttering it in the morning, supreme achievement of goals will occur.

sanskrit_iast: agninā ity āśvinam sūktam catur viṃśakam anvaham | japet prātaḥ śucir bhūtvā nāsatyāv arcya suvrataḥ ||
meaning: अग्निना इत्य् आश्विनम् सूक्तम् चतुर् विंशकम् अन्वहम् | जपेत् प्रातः शुचिर् भूत्वा नासत्याव् अर्च्य सुव्रतः ||
text_mt: A man of good vows, having become pure in the morning and worshipped the two Nāsatyas, / should daily mutter the twenty-fourth hymn to the Aśvins, "By Agni" (RV 8.24).

sanskrit_iast: sa prāpnuyāt parām ṛddhim draviṇam ca ūrjam eva ca | samidhā iti juhoty agnau sūktena pratyṛcam ghṛtam ||
meaning: स प्राप्नुयात् पराम् ऋद्धिम् द्रविणम् च ऊर्जम् एव च | समिधा इति जुहोत्य् अग्नौ सूक्तेन प्रत्यृचम् घृतम् ||
text_mt: He will obtain supreme prosperity, wealth, and vigorous strength. / He offers clarified butter verse by verse into the fire with the hymn "With kindling wood" (RV 8.44).

sanskrit_iast: sa siddhim atulām prāpya samānām jīvate śatam | dvi catvāriṃśakena iha sūktena agha iti vajriṇam ||
meaning: स सिद्धिम् अतुलाम् प्राप्य समानाम् जीवते शतम् | द्वि चत्वारिंशकेन इह सूक्तेन अघ इति वज्रिणम् ||
text_mt: Having attained incomparable magical accomplishment, he lives for a hundred years. / Here, with the forty-second hymn [and] with "Sin...", [praising] the wielder of the vajra,

sanskrit_iast: sakhyam labdhvā mahā indreṇa sapatnānt stṛṇute bahūn | prāśnīyāj japato atra asti praśnam kṛtvā pramāṇataḥ ||
meaning: सख्यम् लब्ध्वा महा इन्द्रेण सपत्नान्त् स्तृणुते बहून् | प्राश्नीयाज् जपतो अत्र अस्ति प्रश्नम् कृत्वा प्रमाणतः ||
text_mt: having gained friendship with great Indra, he lays low many rivals. / While muttering [it] he should eat; here is a questioned matter properly examined according to authority.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt pūrva āhṇiko adhyāyaḥ smṛto ayam ripu nāśanaḥ | vāśam mahī iti ca japtvā prāpnoty ārogyam eva ca ||
meaning: तस्मात् पूर्व आह्णिको अध्यायः स्मृतो अयम् रिपु नाशनः | वाशम् मही इति च जप्त्वा प्राप्नोत्य् आरोग्यम् एव च ||
text_mt: Therefore, this morning chapter is handed down as the destroyer of enemies. / And having muttered "The great desire" (RV 8.67), he attains sound health.

sanskrit_iast: duhsvapnaghnīḥ parā japtvā prātaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate | śam no bhava iti dvābhyām tu bhuktvā annam prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: दुह्स्वप्नघ्नीः परा जप्त्वा प्रातः पापैः प्रमुच्यते | शम् नो भव इति द्वाभ्याम् तु भुक्त्वा अन्नम् प्रयतः शुचिः ||
text_mt: Having muttered the subsequent bad-dream-destroying verses, he is freed from sins in the morning. / But after eating food, restrained and pure, with the two verses "Be auspicious to us" (RV 8.48.4–5),

sanskrit_iast: hṛdayam pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā jyog jīved agadaḥ sukhī | yato bhayam vijānīyāt tasyām diśi yata vrataḥ ||
meaning: हृदयम् पाणिना स्पृष्ट्वा ज्योग् जीवेद् अगदः सुखी | यतो भयम् विजानीयात् तस्याम् दिशि यत व्रतः ||
text_mt: having touched his heart with his hand, he will live long, healthy and happy. / In whatever direction he perceives danger, holding to his vows,

sanskrit_iast: śucau deśe agnim ādhāya juhuyād indram arcya ca | yata ity ājyam utpūtam ṣaḍbhir gandhān nivedya ca ||
meaning: शुचौ देशे अग्निम् आधाय जुहुयाद् इन्द्रम् अर्च्य च | यत इत्य् आज्यम् उत्पूतम् षड्भिर् गन्धान् निवेद्य च ||
text_mt: having placed the fire in a clean place and worshipped Indra, / he should offer clarified butter purified with the six verses beginning with "Whence" (RV 8.61.13–18), having presented scents,

sanskrit_iast: pāyasam dadhi mantham vā apūpān vā apy upahārayet | aho rātram upoṣya ekam tilān vā ghṛtam eva vā ||
meaning: पायसम् दधि मन्थम् वा अपूपान् वा अप्य् उपहारयेत् | अहो रात्रम् उपोष्य एकम् तिलान् वा घृतम् एव वा ||
text_mt: or he should offer rice-milk, curd mixed with parched grain, or barley cakes, / having fasted for one day and night, or sesame seeds, or clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: ut tvā mandantv iti snāto hutvā śatrūn pramāpayet | baddho vā apy abaddho vā vāg yataḥ prayato japet ||
meaning: उत् त्वा मन्दन्त्व् इति स्नातो हुत्वा शत्रून् प्रमापयेत् | बद्धो वा अप्य् अबद्धो वा वाग् यतः प्रयतो जपेत् ||
text_mt: Having bathed and offered oblations with "Let them exhilarate you" (RV 8.92.17), he destroys his enemies. / Whether bound or unbound, restrained in speech and focused, he should mutter:

sanskrit_iast: tyā nv ity āditya daivatyam sadyo mucyeta bandhanāt | yad dyāvā iti japen nityam pragātham niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: त्या न्व् इत्य् आदित्य दैवत्यम् सद्यो मुच्येत बन्धनात् | यद् द्यावा इति जपेन् नित्यम् प्रगाथम् नियतः शुचिः ||
text_mt: With the hymn dedicated to the Ādityas, "Those indeed" (RV 8.67), he is immediately freed from fetters. / Restrained and pure, he should daily mutter the pragātha "If the two worlds" (RV 8.59.1–2).

sanskrit_iast: sa kīrtim atulām prāpya sarvān kāmānt samaśnute | tvam no agna iti sūktena hutvā arcya agnim ghṛtena tu ||
meaning: स कीर्तिम् अतुलाम् प्राप्य सर्वान् कामान्त् समश्नुते | त्वम् नो अग्न इति सूक्तेन हुत्वा अर्च्य अग्निम् घृतेन तु ||
text_mt: Having gained incomparable fame, he attains all desires. / Having worshipped Agni and offered with clarified butter with the hymn "You, O Agni, to us" (RV 8.71),

sanskrit_iast: pālito viśvato dīptyā prāpnuyād vahninā rayim | ā tu sūktena satatam dhanam yāvat puraṃdaram ||
meaning: पालितो विश्वतो दीप्त्या प्राप्नुयाद् वह्निना रयिम् | आ तु सूक्तेन सततम् धनम् यावत् पुरंदरम् ||
text_mt: protected on all sides by brightness, he will obtain wealth through the fire. / With the hymn "Come now" (RV 8.80) [he should praise] Puraṃdara until [he obtains] wealth;

sanskrit_iast: prasamit pāṇaye tasmai dhanam yacchati vṛtrahā |
meaning: प्रसमित् पाणये तस्मै धनम् यच्छति वृत्रहा |
text_mt: the slayer of Vṛtra bestows wealth upon him whose hands hold kindling.

sanskrit_iast: kanyā vār iti sūktam tu satatam niyato japet ||
meaning: कन्या वार् इति सूक्तम् तु सततम् नियतो जपेत् ||
text_mt: Restrained, he should constantly mutter the hymn "A maiden, [going for] water" (RV 8.91).

sanskrit_iast: tvag doṣiṇīm tathā alomnīm kṣipram tasmāt pramocayet | yad adya kac ca ity udite ravau stutvā puraṃdaram ||
meaning: त्वग् दोषिणीम् तथा अलोम्नीम् क्षिप्रम् तस्मात् प्रमोचयेत् | यद् अद्य कच् च इत्य् उदिते रवौ स्तुत्वा पुरंदरम् ||
text_mt: He quickly frees [a woman] afflicted with skin disease or hairlessness from that [affliction]. / Having praised Puraṃdara at sunrise with [the verse] "Whatever today" (RV 8.91.7),

sanskrit_iast: gṛṇann apohate ripram vaśyam vā kurute jagat | yad vāg iti dvṛcena etya gaurīm yo arcati suvrataḥ ||
meaning: गृणन्न् अपोहते रिप्रम् वश्यम् वा कुरुते जगत् | यद् वाग् इति द्वृचेन एत्य गौरीम् यो अर्चति सुव्रतः ||
text_mt: reciting it, he wipes away taint or brings the world under his control. / A man of good vows who, having approached, worships Gaurī with the two-verse hymn "Whatever speech" (RV 8.100.10–11)—

sanskrit_iast: tasya na asaṃskṛtā vāṇī mukhād uccarate kvacit | baṇ mahām iti dṛṣṭvā arkam upatiṣṭhed dvṛcam paṭhan ||
meaning: तस्य न असंस्कृता वाणी मुखाद् उच्चरते क्वचित् | बण् महाम् इति दृष्ट्वा अर्कम् उपतिष्ठेद् द्वृचम् पठन् ||
text_mt: Unrefined speech never issues from his mouth. / Having looked at the sun, he should worship it reciting the two-verse hymn, “baṇ mahām”.

sanskrit_iast: bruvann apy anṛtām vāṇīm lipyate na anṛtena saḥ | pūrṇe candramasi jyotsnām iyam yā ity anusevayet ||
meaning: ब्रुवन्न् अप्य् अनृताम् वाणीम् लिप्यते न अनृतेन सः | पूर्णे चन्द्रमसि ज्योत्स्नाम् इयम् या इत्य् अनुसेवयेत् ||
text_mt: Even when speaking untrue speech, he is not tainted by falsehood. / When the moon is full, he should attend upon the moonlight with [the verse], “iyam yā”.

sanskrit_iast: candra dṛṣṭis tv animiṣo varcasvī dṛṣṭimān bhavet | prajā ha iti japant snātvā na yonim pratijāyate ||
meaning: चन्द्र दृष्टिस् त्व् अनिमिषो वर्चस्वी दृष्टिमान् भवेत् | प्रजा ह इति जपन्त् स्नात्वा न योनिम् प्रतिजायते ||
text_mt: He will have moon-like sight, unblinking, radiant, and possessed of good vision. / Reciting “prajā ha” after bathing, he is not born into a womb again.

sanskrit_iast: mātā iti gām upaspṛśya japan gās tu samaśnute | vacovidam iti tv etām japan vācam samaśnute ||
meaning: माता इति गाम् उपस्पृश्य जपन् गास् तु समश्नुते | वचोविदम् इति त्व् एताम् जपन् वाचम् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: Touching a cow and reciting “mātā”, he obtains cows. / Reciting this [verse], “vacovidam”, he obtains speech.

sanskrit_iast: pāvamānam param hy etan navamam maṇḍalam japet | snātvā śuciḥ śucau deśe sapavitraḥ sakāñcanaḥ || E
meaning: पावमानम् परम् ह्य् एतन् नवमम् मण्डलम् जपेत् | स्नात्वा शुचिः शुचौ देशे सपवित्रः सकाञ्चनः || ए
text_mt: He should recite this supreme Pāvamāna ninth maṇḍala. / Having bathed, pure, in a pure place, wearing a strainer and wearing gold,

sanskrit_iast: svādiṣṭhayā iti gāyatrīḥ pāvamānīr japed dvijaḥ | pavitrāṇām pavitram tu pāvamānīr ṛco japet ||
meaning: स्वादिष्ठया इति गायत्रीः पावमानीर् जपेद् द्विजः | पवित्राणाम् पवित्रम् तु पावमानीर् ऋचो जपेत् ||
text_mt: a twice-born should recite the Pāvamānī Gāyatrī verses [beginning with] “svādiṣṭhayā”. / He should recite the Pāvamānī verses, the purifier of purifiers.

sanskrit_iast: prayato apsu nimajya āśu sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyate | etāsām kīrtanam puṇyam smaraṇam dhāraṇam tathā ||
meaning: प्रयतो अप्सु निमज्य आशु सर्व पापैः प्रमुच्यते | एतासाम् कीर्तनम् पुण्यम् स्मरणम् धारणम् तथा ||
text_mt: Submerging himself quickly in water with a focused mind, he is released from all sins. / The praise, the remembrance, and the retention of these [verses] is meritorious.

sanskrit_iast: yāthāyathyena ca jñātvā brahma lokam samaśnute | eteṣām tu yathā uktānām guṇavad yad yad uttaram ||
meaning: याथायथ्येन च ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्म लोकम् समश्नुते | एतेषाम् तु यथा उक्तानाम् गुणवद् यद् यद् उत्तरम् ||
text_mt: Knowing them in their true nature, he attains the world of Brahman. / Among these [three] as mentioned, each subsequent one has more virtue.

sanskrit_iast: kīrtanāt tu bhavet pūtaḥ smaraṇāt smarate param | dhāraṇād brahmatām eti pūta ātmā vijita indriyaḥ ||
meaning: कीर्तनात् तु भवेत् पूतः स्मरणात् स्मरते परम् | धारणाद् ब्रह्मताम् एति पूत आत्मा विजित इन्द्रियः ||
text_mt: From praise he becomes purified; from remembrance he remembers the Supreme; / from retention he attains the nature of Brahman, purified in soul, having conquered his senses.

sanskrit_iast: yāthātathyena ca jñātvā brahmaṇo vindate padam | śrāvayed devatā kṛtye brāhmaṇān bhuñjato agrataḥ ||
meaning: याथातथ्येन च ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मणो विन्दते पदम् | श्रावयेद् देवता कृत्ये ब्राह्मणान् भुञ्जतो अग्रतः ||
text_mt: And knowing them in their true nature, he finds the state of Brahman. / In a rite to the deities, he should have brahmins hear them before eating.

sanskrit_iast: prīṇāti devatām tac ca samardhayati karma ca | pitrye pitrīn prīṇayanti śrāvitāḥ prayata ātmanā ||
meaning: प्रीणाति देवताम् तच् च समर्धयति कर्म च | पित्र्ये पित्रीन् प्रीणयन्ति श्राविताः प्रयत आत्मना ||
text_mt: That gratifies the deity and makes the ritual prosper. / In an ancestral rite, recited by one of restrained mind, they gratify the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā doṣānt sumahato apy apeya ādīn prapīya ca | japtvā tarat samandīyam praviśya apaḥ tryahāt śuciḥ ||
meaning: कृत्वा दोषान्त् सुमहतो अप्य् अपेय आदीन् प्रपीय च | जप्त्वा तरत् समन्दीयम् प्रविश्य अपः त्र्यहात् शुचिः ||
text_mt: Even after committing very great faults and drinking undrinkable liquids, / having recited the Taratsamandīya [hymn] and entered the water, he is pure after three days.

sanskrit_iast: akṣayyam ca bhaved dattam pitṛbhyaḥ paramam madhu | yaḥ pāvamānīr adhyeti pūta ātmā vijita indriyaḥ ||
meaning: अक्षय्यम् च भवेद् दत्तम् पितृभ्यः परमम् मधु | यः पावमानीर् अध्येति पूत आत्मा विजित इन्द्रियः ||
text_mt: And the supreme honey given to the ancestors becomes inexhaustible. / He who studies the Pāvamānī verses, purified in soul, having conquered his senses,

sanskrit_iast: tasya kāma dughā bhūtvā upatiṣṭhanti dhenavaḥ | āyur balam yaśo vittam prajām kīrtim anāmayam ||
meaning: तस्य काम दुघा भूत्वा उपतिष्ठन्ति धेनवः | आयुर् बलम् यशो वित्तम् प्रजाम् कीर्तिम् अनामयम् ||
text_mt: cows stand before him, becoming wish-granting [cows]. / [He obtains] long life, strength, fame, wealth, offspring, renown, and freedom from disease,

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāya puṇyam atulam pūtaḥ prāpnoti ca akṣayam | aśaktas tu japed yuktāḥ pavitrasya ca yāḥ parāḥ ||
meaning: स्वाध्याय पुण्यम् अतुलम् पूतः प्राप्नोति च अक्षयम् | अशक्तस् तु जपेद् युक्ताः पवित्रस्य च याः पराः ||
text_mt: and, purified, he attains peerless, inexhaustible merit of daily Vedic recitation. / If unable, he should recite with focus the verses following the Pavītra hymn,

sanskrit_iast: sapta ṛṣibhiś ca yāḥ proktāḥ pavitrasya ca yāḥ parāḥ | ṛcām dviṣaṣṭiḥ proktā iyam pavasva ity ṛṣi sattamaiḥ ||
meaning: सप्त ऋषिभिश् च याः प्रोक्ताः पवित्रस्य च याः पराः | ऋचाम् द्विषष्टिः प्रोक्ता इयम् पवस्व इत्य् ऋषि सत्तमैः ||
text_mt: and those spoken by the seven ṛṣis, and those following the Pavitra hymn. / Sixty-two verses [beginning with] “pavasva” have been proclaimed by the best of ṛṣis

sanskrit_iast: sarva kalmaṣa nāśāya pāvanāya śivāya ca | svādiṣṭhayā iti sūktānām sapta ṣaṣṭir iha uditā ||
meaning: सर्व कल्मष नाशाय पावनाय शिवाय च | स्वादिष्ठया इति सूक्तानाम् सप्त षष्टिर् इह उदिता ||
text_mt: for the destruction of all defilement, for purification, and for auspiciousness. / Sixty-seven hymns [beginning with] “svādiṣṭhayā” are declared here,

sanskrit_iast: daśa uttarāṇy ṛcām caiva pāvamānīḥ śatāni ṣaṭ | etaj juhvan japaṃś caiva ghoram mṛtyu bhayam jayet ||
meaning: दश उत्तराण्य् ऋचाम् चैव पावमानीः शतानि षट् | एतज् जुह्वन् जपंश् चैव घोरम् मृत्यु भयम् जयेत् ||
text_mt: and six hundred and ten Pāvamānī verses. / Offering this in fire and reciting it, he conquers the terrible fear of death,

sanskrit_iast: vyādhibhyaḥ parimokṣam ca labhate na atra saṃśayaḥ | pratigṛhya apratigrāhyam bhuktvā ca annam vigarhitam ||
meaning: व्याधिभ्यः परिमोक्षम् च लभते न अत्र संशयः | प्रतिगृह्य अप्रतिग्राह्यम् भुक्त्वा च अन्नम् विगर्हितम् ||
text_mt: and he obtains release from diseases; there is no doubt about this. / Having accepted what should not be accepted, and having eaten censured food,

sanskrit_iast: japaṃs taratsamandīyam praviśya apaḥ tryahāt śuciḥ | pāvamānam param hy etad rapasām apanodanam ||
meaning: जपंस् तरत्समन्दीयम् प्रविश्य अपः त्र्यहात् शुचिः | पावमानम् परम् ह्य् एतद् रपसाम् अपनोदनम् ||
text_mt: reciting the Taratsamandīya [hymn] and entering water, he is pure after three days. / For this Pāvamāna is the supreme banisher of defilements.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇān āyamya ca dhyāyed ante devān pitṝn ṛṣīn | upoṣya ājyam ca juhuyād agnim somam ca pūjayet ||
meaning: प्राणान् आयम्य च ध्यायेद् अन्ते देवान् पितॄन् ऋषीन् | उपोष्य आज्यम् च जुहुयाद् अग्निम् सोमम् च पूजयेत् ||
text_mt: Having restrained the breaths, he should meditate at the end upon the gods, ancestors, and ṛṣis. / Having fasted, he should offer clarified butter and worship Agni and Soma,

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatīm ca arcayeta payo ambu madhu sarpiṣā | ādhyātmikam pavitram te sūktam japtvā āplutaḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: सरस्वतीम् च अर्चयेत पयो अम्बु मधु सर्पिषा | आध्यात्मिकम् पवित्रम् ते सूक्तम् जप्त्वा आप्लुतः शुचिः ||
text_mt: and he should worship Sarasvatī with milk, water, honey, and clarified butter. / Having bathed and become pure, having recited the spiritual hymn “pavitram te”,

sanskrit_iast: gatim iṣṭām avāpnoti vindate ca iha vṛddayaḥ | nānānam iti sūktāni anta kāle japet sakṛt ||
meaning: गतिम् इष्टाम् अवाप्नोति विन्दते च इह वृद्दयः | नानानम् इति सूक्तानि अन्त काले जपेत् सकृत् ||
text_mt: he attains the desired course and finds prosperities here. / Having fasted, he should recite the Pāvamāna maṇḍala a hundred thousand times; / he destroys even brahmin-slaying, according to the word of Vasiṣṭha. / At the time of death, he should recite once the hymns [beginning with] “nānānam”.

sanskrit_iast: japtvā caiva param sthānam amṛtatvam ca gacchati | āpo hi ṣṭha iti niyataḥ prayuñjīta sadā dvijaḥ ||
meaning: जप्त्वा चैव परम् स्थानम् अमृतत्वम् च गच्छति | आपो हि ष्ठ इति नियतः प्रयुञ्जीत सदा द्विजः ||
text_mt: Having recited them, he goes to the supreme abode and to immortality. / A twice-born, restrained, should always employ [the verses beginning with] “āpo hi ṣṭha”.

sanskrit_iast: snāna artham śuddhi kāmas tu japeta triḥ samāhitaḥ | apsu caiva nimajjitvā triḥ paṭhet susamāhitaḥ ||
meaning: स्नान अर्थम् शुद्धि कामस् तु जपेत त्रिः समाहितः | अप्सु चैव निमज्जित्वा त्रिः पठेत् सुसमाहितः ||
text_mt: Desiring purity for the purpose of bathing, he should recite them three times with concentrated mind. / Having submerged himself in water, he should recite them three times, fully concentrated.

sanskrit_iast: brahmahā tu kapālena khaṭva aṅgī cīra saṃvṛtaḥ | cared dvādaśa varṣāṇi sva karma parikīrtayan ||
meaning: ब्रह्महा तु कपालेन खट्व अङ्गी चीर संवृतः | चरेद् द्वादश वर्षाणि स्व कर्म परिकीर्तयन् ||
text_mt: A slayer of a brahmin, bearing a skull, carrying a staff topped with a skull, clad in rags, / should practice [penance] for twelve years, proclaiming his own deed.

sanskrit_iast: ajapan manasā eva etad āpo hi ṣṭha iti saṃsmaret | ūrdhvam tu pañcamād varṣāj japed eva sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning: अजपन् मनसा एव एतद् आपो हि ष्ठ इति संस्मरेत् | ऊर्ध्वम् तु पञ्चमाद् वर्षाज् जपेद् एव सहस्रशः ||
text_mt: Without uttering it, he should remember this [hymn] “āpo hi ṣṭha” in his mind alone. / But after the fifth year, he should recite it thousands of times.

sanskrit_iast: aparas tu tri sāhasro japaḥ syāt pratyaham sadā | pūrṇe tu dvādaśe varṣe brahmahā vipramucyate ||
meaning: अपरस् तु त्रि साहस्रो जपः स्यात् प्रत्यहम् सदा | पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्षे ब्रह्महा विप्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Another recitation should be three thousand times every day, constantly. / When the twelfth year is completed, the slayer of a brahmin is completely released.

sanskrit_iast: sametya brāhmaṇā brūyur atha tam carita vratam |
meaning: समेत्य ब्राह्मणा ब्रूयुर् अथ तम् चरित व्रतम् |
text_mt: Then the brahmins, having assembled, should say to him who has performed the observance:

sanskrit_iast: acaritam bhavet kiṃcid mithyā vādī pateḥ punaḥ ||
meaning: अचरितम् भवेत् किंचिद् मिथ्या वादी पतेः पुनः ||
text_mt: “If anything was unperformed, speaking falsely, you would fall again.

sanskrit_iast: daśa avarān daśa parān hanyās tvam anṛtam vadan | om bho iti vaded viprair anujñātaḥ śucir japet ||
meaning: दश अवरान् दश परान् हन्यास् त्वम् अनृतम् वदन् | ओम् भो इति वदेद् विप्रैर् अनुज्ञातः शुचिर् जपेत् ||
text_mt: Speaking a falsehood, you would destroy ten generations before and ten after.” / He should say, “Om, sir.” Permitted by the brahmins, he should recite, pure.

sanskrit_iast: sthālī pākam ca kurvīta so agnaya vrata cāriṇe | evam sa mucyate pāpāt sāvitrīm pratipadya ca ||
meaning: स्थाली पाकम् च कुर्वीत सो अग्नय व्रत चारिणे | एवम् स मुच्यते पापात् सावित्रीम् प्रतिपद्य च ||
text_mt: And he should prepare a cooked mess of grain for Agni the performer of vows. / Thus he is released from the sin, and taking up the Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast: brahmahā sa purā śakras tvāṣṭram hatvā tv ṛṣim prabham | sindhu dvīpas tam etābhir abhiṣicya vyamocayat ||
meaning: ब्रह्महा स पुरा शक्रस् त्वाष्ट्रम् हत्वा त्व् ऋषिम् प्रभम् | सिन्धु द्वीपस् तम् एताभिर् अभिषिच्य व्यमोचयत् ||
text_mt: Formerly Śakra, having slain the lustrous ṛṣi the son of Tvaṣṭṛ, became a slayer of a brahmin. / Sindhudvīpa, sprinkling him with these [verses], released him.

sanskrit_iast: brahmasvam ca guror dravyam steyam kṛtvā japann imāḥ | anena eva vidhānena ṣaḍbhir varṣaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: ब्रह्मस्वम् च गुरोर् द्रव्यम् स्तेयम् कृत्वा जपन्न् इमाः | अनेन एव विधानेन षड्भिर् वर्षैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: Having committed the theft of property belonging to a brahmin or belonging to a guru, reciting these / by this very rule, he is released in six years.

sanskrit_iast: brahmahā ca surāpaś ca niyamena japann imāḥ | anena eva upacāreṇa brahmaghna iva mucyate ||
meaning: ब्रह्महा च सुरापश् च नियमेन जपन्न् इमाः | अनेन एव उपचारेण ब्रह्मघ्न इव मुच्यते ||
text_mt: A slayer of a brahmin and a liquor drinker, reciting these with restraint / by this very rite, is released just like the slayer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasya ruṣā udyamya japed etā nipātya ca | tryaham nipātya upavased eka aham avagūrya ca ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्य रुषा उद्यम्य जपेद् एता निपात्य च | त्र्यहम् निपात्य उपवसेद् एक अहम् अवगूर्य च ||
text_mt: Having raised [a weapon] against a brahmin in anger, or having struck him down, he should recite these. / Having struck him down, he should fast for three days; having raised [a weapon], for one day.

sanskrit_iast: śoṇitam tu prahāreṇa utpādya sa kathaṃcana | tri rātram eva upavasej japed etāḥ prasādya tam ||
meaning: शोणितम् तु प्रहारेण उत्पाद्य स कथंचन | त्रि रात्रम् एव उपवसेज् जपेद् एताः प्रसाद्य तम् ||
text_mt: If by any means he causes blood to flow by a blow, / he should fast for three nights and recite these, propitiating him.

sanskrit_iast: prātar utthāya satatam kuryād mārjanam ātmanaḥ | rātrau kṛtasya pāpasya avijñātasya niṣkṛtiḥ ||
meaning: प्रातर् उत्थाय सततम् कुर्याद् मार्जनम् आत्मनः | रात्रौ कृतस्य पापस्य अविज्ञातस्य निष्कृतिः ||
text_mt: Having risen in the morning, he should always perform ritual sprinkling on himself. / It is the expiation of an unknown sin committed at night.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam ca nityam etābhiḥ kuryād mārjanam ātmanaḥ | divā kṛtasya pāpasya avijñātasya niṣkṛtiḥ ||
meaning: सायम् च नित्यम् एताभिः कुर्याद् मार्जनम् आत्मनः | दिवा कृतस्य पापस्य अविज्ञातस्य निष्कृतिः ||
text_mt: In the evening too, he should constantly perform ritual sprinkling on himself with these [verses]. / It is the expiation of an unknown sin committed by day.

sanskrit_iast: upatiṣṭheta rājānam yamam sūktena vai dvijaḥ | sthālī pākam ca kurvīta pakṣayor yama daivatam ||
meaning: उपतिष्ठेत राजानम् यमम् सूक्तेन वै द्विजः | स्थाली पाकम् च कुर्वीत पक्षयोर् यम दैवतम् ||
text_mt: A twice-born should attend upon King Yama with the hymn [to him], / and he should prepare a cooked mess of grain dedicated to Yama on both fortnights.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭamyām ca caturdaśyām yajeta haviṣā yamam | pareyivāṃsam ity etat sūktam atra prayojayet ||
meaning: अष्टम्याम् च चतुर्दश्याम् यजेत हविषा यमम् | परेयिवांसम् इत्य् एतत् सूक्तम् अत्र प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: On the eighth and the fourteenth [lunar day], he should worship Yama with sacrificial food. / He should employ here this hymn, “pareyivāṃsam”.

sanskrit_iast: purā āyuṣaḥ pramīyeta na jātu sa kathaṃcana | prīyate asya yamo rājā smṛtim ca ante prayacchati ||
meaning: पुरा आयुषः प्रमीयेत न जातु स कथंचन | प्रीयते अस्य यमो राजा स्मृतिम् च अन्ते प्रयच्छति ||
text_mt: He will never die before his full lifespan. / King Yama is pleased with him and grants him remembrance at the end.

sanskrit_iast: dharma rājāya svāhā iti mantra ante juhuyādd haviḥ | vaiśākhyām paurṇamāsyām tu karma nityam prayojayet ||
meaning: धर्म राजाय स्वाहा इति मन्त्र अन्ते जुहुयाद्द् हविः | वैशाख्याम् पौर्णमास्याम् तु कर्म नित्यम् प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: He should offer sacrificial food at the end of the mantra, saying: “To Dharmarāja, svāhā.” / On the full moon day of the month of Vaiśākha, he should constantly employ this rite.

sanskrit_iast: anaye parvasu snātvā yaḥ pradadyāt tila udakam | yamāya sagaṇāya eva tad bhayam na sa vindati ||
meaning: अनये पर्वसु स्नात्वा यः प्रदद्यात् तिल उदकम् | यमाय सगणाय एव तद् भयम् न स विन्दति ||
text_mt: He who, having bathed on the new and full moon days, offers water with sesame seeds / to Yama along with his retinue, does not experience fear of him.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyum eva prapadyeta param mṛtyo japan dvijaḥ | nakta bhojī mita āhāraḥ parisaṃvatsaram sadā ||
meaning: मृत्युम् एव प्रपद्येत परम् मृत्यो जपन् द्विजः | नक्त भोजी मित आहारः परिसंवत्सरम् सदा ||
text_mt: A twice-born, reciting “param mṛtyo”, should resort to Death alone, / eating at night, eating moderately, continuously for a full year.

sanskrit_iast: na enam purā āyuṣo mṛtyur nayate sasuta prajam | phala āhāro jayen mṛtyum tribhir varṣair mita aśanaḥ ||
meaning: न एनम् पुरा आयुषो मृत्युर् नयते ससुत प्रजम् | फल आहारो जयेन् मृत्युम् त्रिभिर् वर्षैर् मित अशनः ||
text_mt: Death does not carry him off, together with his children and offspring, before his full life span. / Subsisting on fruit, eating moderately, he would conquer death in three years.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhe kāle tu bhuñjīta phalam mūlam atha api vā | sthāna āsanābhyām vihared udake śiśire vaset ||
meaning: षष्ठे काले तु भुञ्जीत फलम् मूलम् अथ अपि वा | स्थान आसनाभ्याम् विहरेद् उदके शिशिरे वसेत् ||
text_mt: He should eat at the sixth mealtime fruit or even roots; / he should spend his time standing and sitting, and he should stay in water during the cold season.

sanskrit_iast: grīṣme pañca tapās tu syād varṣāsv abhra avakāśakaḥ | evam yukto jayen mṛtyum rogebhyaś ca pramucyate ||
meaning: ग्रीष्मे पञ्च तपास् तु स्याद् वर्षास्व् अभ्र अवकाशकः | एवम् युक्तो जयेन् मृत्युम् रोगेभ्यश् च प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: In the hot season he should undergo the penance of the five fires, and in the rainy season he should expose himself to the clouds. / Devoted in this way, he would conquer death and is freed from diseases.

sanskrit_iast: bhrātur bhāryām aputrasya santāna artham mṛte patau | devaro anvārurukṣantīm udīrṣva iti nivartayet ||
meaning: भ्रातुर् भार्याम् अपुत्रस्य सन्तान अर्थम् मृते पतौ | देवरो अन्वारुरुक्षन्तीम् उदीर्ष्व इति निवर्तयेत् ||
text_mt: When the husband of a childless woman has died, the brother-in-law, for the sake of lineage, / should turn back the woman wishing to ascend [the funeral pyre] after [him], with the verse: “Arise!”

sanskrit_iast: ṛtu kāle tu samprāpte ghṛta abhyakto atha vāg yataḥ | ekam utpādayet putram na dvitīyam kathaṃcana ||
meaning: ऋतु काले तु सम्प्राप्ते घृत अभ्यक्तो अथ वाग् यतः | एकम् उत्पादयेत् पुत्रम् न द्वितीयम् कथंचन ||
text_mt: When her fertile season has arrived, anointed with ghee, restraining his speech, / he should generate one son, under no circumstances a second.

sanskrit_iast: daśa akṣaram tu śānty artham bhadram na iti saṃsmaret | nityam japet śucir bhūtvā mānasam vindate sukham ||
meaning: दश अक्षरम् तु शान्त्य् अर्थम् भद्रम् न इति संस्मरेत् | नित्यम् जपेत् शुचिर् भूत्वा मानसम् विन्दते सुखम् ||
text_mt: For the sake of pacification, he should remember the ten-syllable [mantra]: “May what is auspicious [happen] to us!” / Having become pure, he should recite it constantly; he finds mental happiness.

sanskrit_iast: phala āhāro bhaven māsam māsam ca apaḥ pibet tataḥ | vāyu bhakṣo bhaven māsam japann etat sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning: फल आहारो भवेन् मासम् मासम् च अपः पिबेत् ततः | वायु भक्षो भवेन् मासम् जपन्न् एतत् सहस्रशः ||
text_mt: He should subsist on fruit for a month, and then for a month drink water; / he should feed on wind for a month, muttering this thousands of times.

sanskrit_iast: manasā eva asya sidhyanti sarve kāmāḥ samīhitāḥ | divyān paśyati gandharvānt siddhān paśyati cāraṇān ||
meaning: मनसा एव अस्य सिध्यन्ति सर्वे कामाः समीहिताः | दिव्यान् पश्यति गन्धर्वान्त् सिद्धान् पश्यति चारणान् ||
text_mt: All his desired wishes are accomplished by his mere thought. / He sees the celestial Gandharvas, he sees the Siddhas and Cāraṇas.

sanskrit_iast: antardhānam vrajaty asmāl lokād ākāśago bhavet | dūrāt paśyati dūrāc ca śṛṇoti parameṣṭhivat ||
meaning: अन्तर्धानम् व्रजत्य् अस्माल् लोकाद् आकाशगो भवेत् | दूरात् पश्यति दूराच् च शृणोति परमेष्ठिवत् ||
text_mt: He vanishes from this world; he can move through the sky; / he sees from afar and hears from afar, like Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast: pra devatra iti niyato japeta maru dhanvasu | prāṇa antike bhaye prāpte kṣipram ambhaḥ sa vindati ||
meaning: प्र देवत्र इति नियतो जपेत मरु धन्वसु | प्राण अन्तिके भये प्राप्ते क्षिप्रम् अम्भः स विन्दति ||
text_mt: Controlled, he should recite: “Toward the gods…” in sandy deserts; / when danger to his life has arisen, he swiftly finds water.

sanskrit_iast: vaibhītakāṃs tu trīn akṣān gandhaiḥ samabhivāsayet | puṣpair avakirec ca enānt sthāpayitvā vihāyasi ||
meaning: वैभीतकांस् तु त्रीन् अक्षान् गन्धैः समभिवासयेत् | पुष्पैर् अवकिरेच् च एनान्त् स्थापयित्वा विहायसि ||
