text_mt: He should perfume three dice made of vibhītaka wood with fragrances; / and having placed them in the open air, he should scatter flowers over them.

sanskrit_iast: saṃhatya pādau tām rātrīm tiṣṭhann akṣa stutim japet | prā vepā mā ṛcam tv etām manasā eva japen niśi ||
meaning: संहत्य पादौ ताम् रात्रीम् तिष्ठन्न् अक्ष स्तुतिम् जपेत् | प्रा वेपा मा ऋचम् त्व् एताम् मनसा एव जपेन् निशि ||
text_mt: Joining his feet together, standing that whole night, he should mutter the praise of the dice; / and at night he should mutter only in his mind this verse: “Dangling from…”

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭāyām udite sūrye japann ādevanam vrajet | etām eva japen nityam jayaty anyair na jīyate ||
meaning: व्युष्टायाम् उदिते सूर्ये जपन्न् आदेवनम् व्रजेत् | एताम् एव जपेन् नित्यम् जयत्य् अन्यैर् न जीयते ||
text_mt: At dawn, when the sun has risen, muttering [it], he should go to the gambling place. / He should constantly mutter this very [verse]; he conquers others and is not conquered.

sanskrit_iast: yam eva jetum iccheta spṛṣṭvā mūrdhani tam japet | sūkta śeṣam jayaty anyān jīyate na sa kenacit ||
meaning: यम् एव जेतुम् इच्छेत स्पृष्ट्वा मूर्धनि तम् जपेत् | सूक्त शेषम् जयत्य् अन्यान् जीयते न स केनचित् ||
text_mt: Whomever he wishes to conquer, having touched him on the head, he should mutter that; / [or muttering] the rest of the hymn, he conquers others and is not conquered by anyone.

sanskrit_iast: abudhram uṣāsā naktā ity ete svastyayane japet | namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣasa iti nityaśaḥ ||
meaning: अबुध्रम् उषासा नक्ता इत्य् एते स्वस्त्ययने जपेत् | नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षस इति नित्यशः ||
text_mt: He should mutter: “They have awakened…” and “Dawn and Night…” constantly as rites for well-being, / [and]: “Homage to the eye of Mitra and Varuṇa…”

sanskrit_iast: asya eva ca uttama ṛg ekā yayā enobhyaḥ pramucyate | tayā ājyam juhuyān nityam enobhyo vipramucyate ||
meaning: अस्य एव च उत्तम ऋग् एका यया एनोभ्यः प्रमुच्यते | तया आज्यम् जुहुयान् नित्यम् एनोभ्यो विप्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: And there is one final verse of this [hymn], by which one is freed from sins; / with it he should offer ghee constantly; he is completely freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast: divas pari iti sūktam tu japen śraddhā samanvitaḥ | sarvatra labhate śraddhām śraddhā kāmaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: दिवस् परि इति सूक्तम् तु जपेन् श्रद्धा समन्वितः | सर्वत्र लभते श्रद्धाम् श्रद्धा कामः समाहितः ||
text_mt: Full of faith, he should mutter the hymn: “From heaven…”; / concentrated, desirous of faith, he gains faith everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: mā pra gāma iti ca japet sa mūḍho gahane pathi | svastimān eti panthānam vindate ca param sukham ||
meaning: मा प्र गाम इति च जपेत् स मूढो गहने पथि | स्वस्तिमान् एति पन्थानम् विन्दते च परम् सुखम् ||
text_mt: Lost on a difficult path, he should also mutter: “May we not go astray…”; / he safely reaches his path and finds supreme happiness.

sanskrit_iast: kṣīṇa āyur iti manyeta yam kaṃcit suhṛdam priyam | yat te yamam iti snātas tasya mūrdhānam ālabhet ||
meaning: क्षीण आयुर् इति मन्येत यम् कंचित् सुहृदम् प्रियम् | यत् ते यमम् इति स्नातस् तस्य मूर्धानम् आलभेत् ||
text_mt: If he should consider any dear friend to have his life span exhausted, / having bathed, he should touch his head with: “That of thine which Yama…”

sanskrit_iast: sahasrakṛtvaḥ pañca aham japed āyur labheta saḥ | ghṛtena sindhu dvīpasya sūktena enam pralepayet ||
meaning: सहस्रकृत्वः पञ्च अहम् जपेद् आयुर् लभेत सः | घृतेन सिन्धु द्वीपस्य सूक्तेन एनम् प्रलेपयेत् ||
text_mt: He should mutter it a thousand times for five days; he will obtain life. / He should anoint him with ghee [accompanied by] the hymn of Sindhudvīpa.

sanskrit_iast: saṃviśan śayane nityam etam mantram japeta vai | putrān bhāryām priyam ca anyam ātmānam saṃspṛśet tataḥ ||
meaning: संविशन् शयने नित्यम् एतम् मन्त्रम् जपेत वै | पुत्रान् भार्याम् प्रियम् च अन्यम् आत्मानम् संस्पृशेत् ततः ||
text_mt: Entering his bed, he should indeed mutter this mantra constantly; / then he should touch his sons, wife, any other dear person, and himself.

sanskrit_iast: jīva āvṛttim prayuñjīta nityam etām ghṛtena tu | śrotāṃsy abhyajya sarvāṇi sukhī bhavati vijvaraḥ ||
meaning: जीव आवृत्तिम् प्रयुञ्जीत नित्यम् एताम् घृतेन तु | श्रोतांस्य् अभ्यज्य सर्वाणि सुखी भवति विज्वरः ||
text_mt: He should always employ this recitation for life with ghee; / having anointed all the sense channels, he becomes happy and free from fever.

sanskrit_iast: idam itthā iti mantro ayam sahasra sanir ucyate | ardha māsam haviṣya annam ardha māsam payaḥ pibet ||
meaning: इदम् इत्था इति मन्त्रो अयम् सहस्र सनिर् उच्यते | अर्ध मासम् हविष्य अन्नम् अर्ध मासम् पयः पिबेत् ||
text_mt: This mantra: “Thus here…” is said to grant a thousandfold. / For half a month he should eat sacrificial food, and for half a month drink milk.

sanskrit_iast: upoṣya ca aparam pakṣam araṇye sthaṇḍile śucau | audumbara idhmam prajvālya juhuyāt pāvake ghṛtam ||
meaning: उपोष्य च अपरम् पक्षम् अरण्ये स्थण्डिले शुचौ | औदुम्बर इध्मम् प्रज्वाल्य जुहुयात् पावके घृतम् ||
text_mt: And having fasted for another fortnight, in the wilderness, on a clean, bare patch of ground, / having kindled kindling wood of udumbara, he should offer ghee into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: sruk sruvau camasaś caiva sarvam audumbaram bhavet | hutvā āhuti sahasram tu tena kāmena yujyate ||
meaning: स्रुक् स्रुवौ चमसश् चैव सर्वम् औदुम्बरम् भवेत् | हुत्वा आहुति सहस्रम् तु तेन कामेन युज्यते ||
text_mt: The large ladle, the small ladle, and the drinking vessel should all be of udumbara wood. / Having offered a thousand oblations, he becomes united with that desire.

sanskrit_iast: amogham eva karma etaj jānīyāt siddhim eva tu | vyartham apy ardham eva etat phalasya asya prayacchati ||
meaning: अमोघम् एव कर्म एतज् जानीयात् सिद्धिम् एव तु | व्यर्थम् अप्य् अर्धम् एव एतत् फलस्य अस्य प्रयच्छति ||
text_mt: He should know this ritual action to be infallible, [leading] only to magical accomplishment; / even if unsuccessful, it still grants half of this fruit.

sanskrit_iast: catuṣ pathe ca anna kāma āditya abhimukho ghṛtam | juhuyād dhana kāmas tu sahasram bhojayed dvijān ||
meaning: चतुष् पथे च अन्न काम आदित्य अभिमुखो घृतम् | जुहुयाद् धन कामस् तु सहस्रम् भोजयेद् द्विजान् ||
text_mt: One desirous of food [should offer] ghee at a crossroads facing the sun; / but one desirous of wealth should feed a thousand twice-born.

sanskrit_iast: paśu kāmo japed goṣṭhe juhuyād vā apy upoṣitaḥ | vidhinā anena niyataḥ sahasram vindate paśūn ||
meaning: पशु कामो जपेद् गोष्ठे जुहुयाद् वा अप्य् उपोषितः | विधिना अनेन नियतः सहस्रम् विन्दते पशून् ||
text_mt: One desirous of cattle should recite in a cattle pen, or, having fasted, should make offerings; / restrained, by this rule he obtains a thousand cattle.

sanskrit_iast: loha lohita hemānām kārayet trivṛtam maṇim | sahasram samidhām caiva sampāta abhihut tu bhavet ||
meaning: लोह लोहित हेमानाम् कारयेत् त्रिवृतम् मणिम् | सहस्रम् समिधाम् चैव सम्पात अभिहुत् तु भवेत् ||
text_mt: He should have an amulet made threefold of iron, copper, and gold; / and there should be a thousand fuel sticks over which the remainder [of ghee] has been offered.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā sahasra sampātam śirasā dhārayet tu tam | pāṇinā vā śucir bhūtvā sahasra anucaro bhavet ||
meaning: कृत्वा सहस्र सम्पातम् शिरसा धारयेत् तु तम् | पाणिना वा शुचिर् भूत्वा सहस्र अनुचरो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having made a thousand offerings of remnants, having become pure, he should wear it on his head / or on his hand; he becomes one accompanied by a thousand [followers].

sanskrit_iast: parāvataḥ svastyayanam snātakasya vidhīyate | svarga kāmaś ca tam nityam japeta niyata vrataḥ ||
meaning: परावतः स्वस्त्ययनम् स्नातकस्य विधीयते | स्वर्ग कामश् च तम् नित्यम् जपेत नियत व्रतः ||
text_mt: “From afar…” is prescribed as a rite for well-being for a snātaka; / and one desirous of heaven should mutter it constantly, firm in his vows.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate prathamam iti nityam jñāna stutim japet | jñānavān bhavati śrīmān anantām vindate śriyam ||
meaning: बृहस्पते प्रथमम् इति नित्यम् ज्ञान स्तुतिम् जपेत् | ज्ञानवान् भवति श्रीमान् अनन्ताम् विन्दते श्रियम् ||
text_mt: He should constantly mutter the praise of knowledge: “O Bṛhaspati, the first…”; / he becomes possessed of knowledge, radiant, and obtains endless prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: alakṣmī nāśana artham tu payo bhakṣo bhaved dvijaḥ | vayaḥ suparṇā ity etām japan vai vindate śriyam ||
meaning: अलक्ष्मी नाशन अर्थम् तु पयो भक्षो भवेद् द्विजः | वयः सुपर्णा इत्य् एताम् जपन् वै विन्दते श्रियम् ||
text_mt: For the purpose of destroying misfortune, a twice-born should subsist on milk; / muttering this verse: “The beautiful-winged birds…”, he indeed obtains prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: tamasā prāvṛto yas tu manyeta ātmānam ātmani | aśriyā vā apy atha āviṣṭo japann etām pramucyate ||
meaning: तमसा प्रावृतो यस् तु मन्येत आत्मानम् आत्मनि | अश्रिया वा अप्य् अथ आविष्टो जपन्न् एताम् प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: One who considers himself within himself covered by darkness, / or possessed by misfortune, is freed by muttering this.

sanskrit_iast: akṣiṇī prātar utthāya vimṛjīta etayā sadā | cakṣuṣmān bhavati śrīmān alakṣmīm ca prabādhate ||
meaning: अक्षिणी प्रातर् उत्थाय विमृजीत एतया सदा | चक्षुष्मान् भवति श्रीमान् अलक्ष्मीम् च प्रबाधते ||
text_mt: Having risen in the morning, he should always wipe his eyes with this [verse]; / he becomes sharp-sighted, radiant, and repels misfortune.

sanskrit_iast: na tam vidātha ity etām tu japan vipraḥ samāhitaḥ | vihāya kalmaṣam sarvam brahma abhyeti sanātanam ||
meaning: न तम् विदाथ इत्य् एताम् तु जपन् विप्रः समाहितः | विहाय कल्मषम् सर्वम् ब्रह्म अभ्येति सनातनम् ||
text_mt: A concentrated brahmin, muttering this [verse]: “You do not know him…”, / leaving behind all taint, reaches the eternal Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: anayā parvasu snātvā yaḥ pradadyāt tila udakam | yamāya sagaṇāya eva tad bhayam na sa vindati ||
meaning: अनया पर्वसु स्नात्वा यः प्रदद्यात् तिल उदकम् | यमाय सगणाय एव तद् भयम् न स विन्दति ||
text_mt: Having bathed on the new and full moon days, whoever offers sesame-water with this [verse] / to Yama and his troop does not experience fear of him.

sanskrit_iast: yas te manyo iti sadā sapatnaghne tv ime japet | ghṛtena abhihutam dvābhyām dhārayed āyasam maṇim ||
meaning: यस् ते मन्यो इति सदा सपत्नघ्ने त्व् इमे जपेत् | घृतेन अभिहुतम् द्वाभ्याम् धारयेद् आयसम् मणिम् ||
text_mt: He should always mutter these two [hymns] that destroy rivals: “Which [wrath] of thine, O Manyu…”; / he should wear an iron amulet over which oblations have been poured with ghee using the two [hymns].

sanskrit_iast: juhuyād āyasam śaṅkum ābhyām eva caturdaśīm | khādira idhma samiddhe agnau sapatnān pratibādhate ||
meaning: जुहुयाद् आयसम् शङ्कुम् आभ्याम् एव चतुर्दशीम् | खादिर इध्म समिद्धे अग्नौ सपत्नान् प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: On the fourteenth day he should offer an iron spike with these two [hymns] / into a fire kindled with kindling wood of khadira; he repels rivals.

sanskrit_iast: yathā hi paramam brahma guhyam pāvanam adbhutam | tathā saṃvananam hṛdyam na hy asmād vidyate param ||
meaning: यथा हि परमम् ब्रह्म गुह्यम् पावनम् अद्भुतम् | तथा संवननम् हृद्यम् न ह्य् अस्माद् विद्यते परम् ||
text_mt: Just as the supreme Brahman is secret, purifying, and wondrous, / so is this subjugation charming to the heart; for there is nothing higher than this.

sanskrit_iast: upoṣya dvādaśa ahāni japann etam ṛṣim sadā | tan manāḥ prayataḥ sa syāt trir ahno abhyupayann apaḥ ||
meaning: उपोष्य द्वादश अहानि जपन्न् एतम् ऋषिम् सदा | तन् मनाः प्रयतः स स्यात् त्रिर् अह्नो अभ्युपयन्न् अपः ||
text_mt: Having fasted for twelve days, muttering this ṛṣi constantly, / with mind fixed on that, he should be restrained, entering water three times a day.

sanskrit_iast: ante tu dvādaśa ahasya śucau deśe samāhitaḥ | puṃsaḥ pratikṛtim kuryād bhūmau pāṃsumayīm tathā ||
meaning: अन्ते तु द्वादश अहस्य शुचौ देशे समाहितः | पुंसः प्रतिकृतिम् कुर्याद् भूमौ पांसुमयीम् तथा ||
text_mt: At the end of the twelve days, concentrated, in a clean place, / he should make an effigy of a man out of dust on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā hṛdaya deśam tu samākramya japed ṛṣim | amogham karma jānīyād aho rātre gate sati ||
meaning: तस्या हृदय देशम् तु समाक्रम्य जपेद् ऋषिम् | अमोघम् कर्म जानीयाद् अहो रात्रे गते सति ||
text_mt: Stepping onto its heart area, he should mutter the [hymn of the] ṛṣi. / When a day and a night have passed, he should know the action to be infallible:

sanskrit_iast: tryaheṇa dhaninām vaiśyam catū rātreṇa kṣatriyam | rājānam pañca rātreṇa ṣaḍ rātreṇa dvija uttamam ||
meaning: त्र्यहेण धनिनाम् वैश्यम् चतू रात्रेण क्षत्रियम् | राजानम् पञ्च रात्रेण षड् रात्रेण द्विज उत्तमम् ||
text_mt: [He subjugates] a wealthy vaiśya in three days, a kṣatriya in four nights, / a king in five nights, and the best of the twice-born in six nights.

sanskrit_iast: tapasvinam sapta rātrāj jayed bhuñjīta ca eva tam | api vā upoṣitaḥ snāto japed etat sadā sthitaḥ ||
meaning: तपस्विनम् सप्त रात्राज् जयेद् भुञ्जीत च एव तम् | अपि वा उपोषितः स्नातो जपेद् एतत् सदा स्थितः ||
text_mt: He would conquer an ascetic after seven nights and enjoy him. / Or else, fasting, bathed, standing constantly, he should mutter this.

sanskrit_iast: ya icched ātmanaḥ kartum hīnam tu parivarjayet | sahasra sampāta hutam bilvānām cūrṇam āvayet ||
meaning: य इच्छेद् आत्मनः कर्तुम् हीनम् तु परिवर्जयेत् | सहस्र सम्पात हुतम् बिल्वानाम् चूर्णम् आवयेत् ||
text_mt: If he wishes to make [someone] his own, he should omit what is inferior. / He should pour out powder of bilva [fruits], offered with a thousand residual drops,

sanskrit_iast: uda pāne vaśam netum tam janam kṣipram ānayet | mātary ātmani putreṣu pitṛ bhrātṛ suhṛtsu ca ||
meaning: उद पाने वशम् नेतुम् तम् जनम् क्षिप्रम् आनयेत् | मातर्य् आत्मनि पुत्रेषु पितृ भ्रातृ सुहृत्सु च ||
text_mt: into a water reservoir to bring [them] into subjugation; he quickly leads that person [to him]. / Concerning mother, oneself, sons, and father, brothers, and friends,

sanskrit_iast: hṛdyam etat prayujñīta śirasā dhārayed gurum | sumitram tu pariṣvajya mūrdhany āghrāya ca ātmajam ||
meaning: हृद्यम् एतत् प्रयुज्ञीत शिरसा धारयेद् गुरुम् | सुमित्रम् तु परिष्वज्य मूर्धन्य् आघ्राय च आत्मजम् ||
text_mt: he should employ this Hṛdya [hymn], and hold the teacher upon his head. / Having embraced a good friend and smelled a son on the head,

sanskrit_iast: hṛdyam etat prayuñjīta śānty arthāya sukhāya ca | asaṃsiddhe saṃvanane pāṃsu pratikṛtim pathi ||
meaning: हृद्यम् एतत् प्रयुञ्जीत शान्त्य् अर्थाय सुखाय च | असंसिद्धे संवनने पांसु प्रतिकृतिम् पथि ||
text_mt: he should employ this Hṛdya [hymn] for the sake of pacification and happiness. / When the subjugation has not succeeded, [he should make] an effigy of dust on the road;

sanskrit_iast: prajvālya juhuyād agnim ghṛtena brāhmaṇo yadi | kṣatriyasya tu tailena sārṣapeṇa viśām api ||
meaning: प्रज्वाल्य जुहुयाद् अग्निम् घृतेन ब्राह्मणो यदि | क्षत्रियस्य तु तैलेन सार्षपेण विशाम् अपि ||
text_mt: having kindled a fire, he should offer with ghee if [the person] is a brahmin, / but with oil for a kṣatriya, and with mustard-seed [oil] for vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast: āyasīm vā pratikṛtim agni madhye nidhāpayet | tām ca prajvalitām matvā juhuyāt tanmanāḥ śuciḥ ||
meaning: आयसीम् वा प्रतिकृतिम् अग्नि मध्ये निधापयेत् | ताम् च प्रज्वलिताम् मत्वा जुहुयात् तन्मनाः शुचिः ||
text_mt: Or he should place an iron effigy in the middle of the fire, / and considering it blazing, pure, with intent mind, he should make offerings.

sanskrit_iast: ugreṇa manasā hanyāt kruddhaś ca juhuyād ghṛtam | yathā yathā prajvalite hūyate jāta vedasi ||
meaning: उग्रेण मनसा हन्यात् क्रुद्धश् च जुहुयाद् घृतम् | यथा यथा प्रज्वलिते हूयते जात वेदसि ||
text_mt: With a fierce mind he should slay [the enemy], and angered, he should offer ghee. / In proportion as [the effigy] is offered into the kindled Jātavedas,

sanskrit_iast: dīptā pratikṛti vipras tathā sa vaśam eṣyati | śmaśāna dagdha pāṃsūnām kuryād vedim vilakṣaṇām ||
meaning: दीप्ता प्रतिकृति विप्रस् तथा स वशम् एष्यति | श्मशान दग्ध पांसूनाम् कुर्याद् वेदिम् विलक्षणाम् ||
text_mt: and the effigy is blazing, O brahmin, so will he come into subjugation. / From the dust burned at a cremation ground he should make a distinguished altar;

sanskrit_iast: vaibhītaka idhme jvalite loha pratikṛtim nyaset | ardha rātre sthite taile sārṣapam lavaṇa anvitam ||
meaning: वैभीतक इध्मे ज्वलिते लोह प्रतिकृतिम् न्यसेत् | अर्ध रात्रे स्थिते तैले सार्षपम् लवण अन्वितम् ||
text_mt: when the vaibhītaka kindling-wood is blazing, he should place an iron effigy [thereon]. / At midnight, with oil standing [in a vessel], [he should offer] mustard-seed [oil] mixed with salt.

sanskrit_iast: tatra śaramayam kuryāt prastaram pratilomataḥ | triṣu śaṅkuṣu ca āsīno juhuyād ugra darśanaḥ ||
meaning: तत्र शरमयम् कुर्यात् प्रस्तरम् प्रतिलोमतः | त्रिषु शङ्कुषु च आसीनो जुहुयाद् उग्र दर्शनः ||
text_mt: There he should make a strew of reed-grass in reverse order; / seated on three pegs, fierce of appearance, he should make offerings.

sanskrit_iast: mukta keśo vadham prepsur acireṇa prasādhayet | athavā abhicared evam juhuyād ātma śoṇitam ||
meaning: मुक्त केशो वधम् प्रेप्सुर् अचिरेण प्रसाधयेत् | अथवा अभिचरेद् एवम् जुहुयाद् आत्म शोणितम् ||
text_mt: With hair disheveled, seeking to attain slaughter, he accomplishes it without delay. / Or else he should practice sorcery thus: he should offer his own blood;

sanskrit_iast: vaśam nayati rājānam kṣipram jana padam puram | puṣṭi karma api kartavyam hṛdyena uktam yata ātmanā ||
meaning: वशम् नयति राजानम् क्षिप्रम् जन पदम् पुरम् | पुष्टि कर्म अपि कर्तव्यम् हृद्येन उक्तम् यत आत्मना ||
text_mt: he quickly brings the king, the countryside, and the town into subjugation. / A rite of prosperity is also to be performed, declared with the Hṛdya [hymn] by a self-controlled man.

sanskrit_iast: anāgasi na kurvīta brāhmaṇo vadha samyutam | sarūpa vatsāyāś ca goḥ payasā sādhayet carum ||
meaning: अनागसि न कुर्वीत ब्राह्मणो वध सम्युतम् | सरूप वत्सायाश् च गोः पयसा साधयेत् चरुम् ||
text_mt: Against one without sin, a brahmin should not perform [a rite] connected with slaughter. / With the milk of a cow that has a calf of identical appearance, he should prepare a caru;

sanskrit_iast: sahasra sampāta hutam pāyayed vatsam agrajam | sahasra anucaro vatsaḥ sa syād rāgair vivarjitaḥ ||
meaning: सहस्र सम्पात हुतम् पाययेद् वत्सम् अग्रजम् | सहस्र अनुचरो वत्सः स स्याद् रागैर् विवर्जितः ||
text_mt: offered with a thousand residual drops, he should make the first-born calf drink it. / That calf will become the leader of a thousand, free from diseases.

sanskrit_iast: gāś caiva pāyayet tāś ca bhavanti vigata jvarāḥ | putrāṃś ca prāśayen nityam priyān anyāṃś ca sajjanān ||
meaning: गाश् चैव पाययेत् ताश् च भवन्ति विगत ज्वराः | पुत्रांश् च प्राशयेन् नित्यम् प्रियान् अन्यांश् च सज्जनान् ||
text_mt: He should also make the cows drink, and they become free from fevers. / And he should constantly cause sons, other loved ones, and virtuous people to eat [it];

sanskrit_iast: nirāmayāś ca snigdhāś ca bhavanti vigata jvarāḥ | striyam ced abhimanyeta tasyāḥ saṃvananam mahat ||
meaning: निरामयाश् च स्निग्धाश् च भवन्ति विगत ज्वराः | स्त्रियम् चेद् अभिमन्येत तस्याः संवननम् महत् ||
text_mt: and they become free from sickness, affectionate, and free from fevers. / If he desires a woman, there is a great subjugation for her:

sanskrit_iast: vrīhīṇām nakha bhinnānām taṇḍulānt sūkṣma cūrṇitān | sahasra sampāta hutānt svedayet kuśalo agninā ||
meaning: व्रीहीणाम् नख भिन्नानाम् तण्डुलान्त् सूक्ष्म चूर्णितान् | सहस्र सम्पात हुतान्त् स्वेदयेत् कुशलो अग्निना ||
text_mt: grains of rice broken with fingernails, ground into fine powder, / offered with a thousand residual drops, a skilled person should steam with fire.

sanskrit_iast: tena pratikṛtim kuryāt tām dhyātvā manasā striyam | aktām sarṣapa tailena juhuyād aṅgaśaś ca tām ||
meaning: तेन प्रतिकृतिम् कुर्यात् ताम् ध्यात्वा मनसा स्त्रियम् | अक्ताम् सर्षप तैलेन जुहुयाद् अङ्गशश् च ताम् ||
text_mt: With that he should make an effigy, meditating on that woman with his mind; / anointed with mustard oil, he should offer it limb by limb.

sanskrit_iast: pādau prathamataś chindyāt phaḍ ity agnau nidhāpayet | atha jaṅghe jānuni ca ūrū bāhū tataḥ śiraḥ ||
meaning: पादौ प्रथमतश् छिन्द्यात् फड् इत्य् अग्नौ निधापयेत् | अथ जङ्घे जानुनि च ऊरू बाहू ततः शिरः ||
text_mt: First he should cut off the two feet and place them in the fire with 'Phaṭ!'; / then the two shanks, the two knees, the two thighs, the two arms, and then the head.

sanskrit_iast: chittvā hṛdaya deśam tu hṛdaye sve niveśayet | japann etam ṛṣim vipraḥ strī vaśam sā adhigacchati ||
meaning: छित्त्वा हृदय देशम् तु हृदये स्वे निवेशयेत् | जपन्न् एतम् ऋषिम् विप्रः स्त्री वशम् सा अधिगच्छति ||
text_mt: Having cut out the heart region, he should place it upon his own heart; / muttering this ṛṣi, O brahmin, that woman comes into his power.

sanskrit_iast: na etat parigṛhītāsu na sādhvīṣu kathaṃcana | na dharma vrata śīlāsu kurvīta dvija sattamaḥ ||
meaning: न एतत् परिगृहीतासु न साध्वीषु कथंचन | न धर्म व्रत शीलासु कुर्वीत द्विज सत्तमः ||
text_mt: A best of twice-borns should never do this toward women who have been taken [in marriage], / nor toward virtuous women, nor toward women devoted to religious vows.

sanskrit_iast: kāmam parigṛhītāsu hīna varṇāsu yaś caret | patim asyā guṇī kuryāt pūrvam paścāt tu tām striyam ||
meaning: कामम् परिगृहीतासु हीन वर्णासु यश् चरेत् | पतिम् अस्या गुणी कुर्यात् पूर्वम् पश्चात् तु ताम् स्त्रियम् ||
text_mt: Whoever acts according to desire with women of lower class who have been taken [in marriage], / he should first make her husband virtuous, and afterwards that woman.

sanskrit_iast: bhuktvā vā pāyasam sadyaḥ chardayitvā nidhāpayet | tat cūrṇam kṛṣṇa jāyāyai deyam saṃvananam smṛtam ||
meaning: भुक्त्वा वा पायसम् सद्यः छर्दयित्वा निधापयेत् | तत् चूर्णम् कृष्ण जायायै देयम् संवननम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: Or having eaten milk-rice, having vomited it immediately, he should preserve it; / that powder should be given to a dark wife; it is remembered as a subjugation.

sanskrit_iast: mahā vṛkṣa phalāny evam ayugmāny abhimantrayet | teṣām yugmāni bhuñjīta svayam ardhāni śeṣayet ||
meaning: महा वृक्ष फलान्य् एवम् अयुग्मान्य् अभिमन्त्रयेत् | तेषाम् युग्मानि भुञ्जीत स्वयम् अर्धानि शेषयेत् ||
text_mt: Thus he should consecrate an odd number of fruits of large trees; / of them he should himself eat the pairs, leaving half remaining.

sanskrit_iast: tāni dadyād yam icchet tu vaśī kartum japann ṛṣim | suhṛd bhūtvā asuhṛd yasya deyam saṃvananam smṛtam ||
meaning: तानि दद्याद् यम् इच्छेत् तु वशी कर्तुम् जपन्न् ऋषिम् | सुहृद् भूत्वा असुहृद् यस्य देयम् संवननम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: Those he should give to whom he wishes to bring into subjugation, muttering the ṛṣi; / having become a friend of one who is not a friend, [this] given is remembered as a subjugation.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekam abhirūpam tu hṛdya sūkta ādy ataḥ punaḥ | karmāṇi tv abhirūpāṇi kuryād yas tu yathā icchati ||
meaning: एक एकम् अभिरूपम् तु हृद्य सूक्त आद्य् अतः पुनः | कर्माणि त्व् अभिरूपाणि कुर्याद् यस् तु यथा इच्छति ||
text_mt: Each matching [verse] begins from the Hṛdya hymn; / one should perform matching rites according as one wishes.

sanskrit_iast: parāka dāsasya vidhim hṛdyena uktam vidur budhāḥ | strīṇām saṃvananam ca etat puṃsām api vidhīyate ||
meaning: पराक दासस्य विधिम् हृद्येन उक्तम् विदुर् बुधाः | स्त्रीणाम् संवननम् च एतत् पुंसाम् अपि विधीयते ||
text_mt: The wise know the rule of Parākadāsa to be declared with the Hṛdya [hymn]; / and this subjugation of women is prescribed for men as well.

sanskrit_iast: dveṣyam tu jñātinām eva japec caiva sadā yudhi | khādiram kārayet śaṅkum hṛdi tam samniveśayet ||
meaning: द्वेष्यम् तु ज्ञातिनाम् एव जपेच् चैव सदा युधि | खादिरम् कारयेत् शङ्कुम् हृदि तम् सम्निवेशयेत् ||
text_mt: He should constantly mutter [it] against one hated by kinsmen and in battle; / he should have a khadira peg made and insert it in the heart,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā pratikṛtim pūrvam pāṃsubhir vā athavā tuṣaiḥ | iṣum apy anumantrya eva saṃgrāmam samprakalpayet ||
meaning: कृत्वा प्रतिकृतिम् पूर्वम् पांसुभिर् वा अथवा तुषैः | इषुम् अप्य् अनुमन्त्र्य एव संग्रामम् सम्प्रकल्पयेत् ||
text_mt: having first made an effigy with dust or with chaff. / Having consecrated an arrow, he should prepare for battle;

sanskrit_iast: ripughnam etaj jānīyāt prayuktam aparājitam | parāka dāsa dveṣya artham hṛdyam saṃvananam smṛtam ||
meaning: रिपुघ्नम् एतज् जानीयात् प्रयुक्तम् अपराजितम् | पराक दास द्वेष्य अर्थम् हृद्यम् संवननम् स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: one should know this, when employed, to be enemy-slaying and unconquered. / For the purpose of the foe of Parākadāsa, the Hṛdya [hymn] is remembered as a subjugation.

sanskrit_iast: cintayann manasā apy ete sūkte siddhim niyacchati | sūryāyai bhāva vṛttam tu śrāvayet kanyakām pitā ||
meaning: चिन्तयन्न् मनसा अप्य् एते सूक्ते सिद्धिम् नियच्छति | सूर्यायै भाव वृत्तम् तु श्रावयेत् कन्यकाम् पिता ||
text_mt: Even while contemplating with the mind, these two hymns bestow magical accomplishment. / A father should recite the account of the condition of Sūryā to his maiden daughter;

sanskrit_iast: anurūpam susadṛśam bhartāram tena vindati | imām iti japet kanyā nābhim ālabhya nityaśaḥ ||
meaning: अनुरूपम् सुसदृशम् भर्तारम् तेन विन्दति | इमाम् इति जपेत् कन्या नाभिम् आलभ्य नित्यशः ||
text_mt: by means of that she finds a suitable and well-matched husband. / 'Her...'—touching her navel, the maiden should constantly mutter this;

sanskrit_iast: evam eva japed bhartā tato dīrgha āyuṣau tu tau | snāpayed abhirūpaiś ca bhrātā kanyām pitā api vā ||
meaning: एवम् एव जपेद् भर्ता ततो दीर्घ आयुषौ तु तौ | स्नापयेद् अभिरूपैश् च भ्राता कन्याम् पिता अपि वा ||
text_mt: just so should the husband mutter; then both of them become long-lived. / A brother or a father should bathe the maiden with matching [verses];

sanskrit_iast: daśa putravatī bhaven na ca bhartrā viyujyate | saṃrājñī iti japen mūrdhni kanyām ālabhya nityaśaḥ ||
meaning: दश पुत्रवती भवेन् न च भर्त्रा वियुज्यते | संराज्ञी इति जपेन् मूर्ध्नि कन्याम् आलभ्य नित्यशः ||
text_mt: she becomes the mother of ten sons and is not separated from her husband. / Touching the maiden's head, he should constantly mutter: 'A queen...'

sanskrit_iast: śvaśrū śvaśura devarair nanāndrā ca api pūjyate | indrāṇyā kṛta saṃvādam snāne sūktam prayojayet ||
meaning: श्वश्रू श्वशुर देवरैर् ननान्द्रा च अपि पूज्यते | इन्द्राण्या कृत संवादम् स्नाने सूक्तम् प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: She is honored by mother-in-law, father-in-law, husband's brothers, and husband's sister. / He should employ the hymn that forms the dialogue with Indrāṇī in a bath,

sanskrit_iast: nava varga uttama yutam pati saubhāgya putradam | jala puṣpa utkara yute citra kumbha samāvṛte ||
meaning: नव वर्ग उत्तम युतम् पति सौभाग्य पुत्रदम् | जल पुष्प उत्कर युते चित्र कुम्भ समावृते ||
text_mt: endowed with the best of nine groups, bestowing good fortune of a husband and sons, / [in a place] filled with a heap of water and flowers, surrounded by bright pots.

sanskrit_iast: kartavyo atra tathā yāgaḥ soma gandharva vahninām | bhagāya apsarasām caiva yakṣa adhipataye api ca ||
meaning: कर्तव्यो अत्र तथा यागः सोम गन्धर्व वह्निनाम् | भगाय अप्सरसाम् चैव यक्ष अधिपतये अपि च ||
text_mt: A sacrifice should be performed here for Soma, the Gandharvas, and Agni; / to Bhaga, to the Apsarases, and to the lord of the Yakṣas;

sanskrit_iast: indrāṇyai deva patnīnām rati pradyumnayos tathā | nadī salika sampūrṇaiḥ pañca gavya samāvṛtaiḥ ||
meaning: इन्द्राण्यै देव पत्नीनाम् रति प्रद्युम्नयोस् तथा | नदी सलिक सम्पूर्णैः पञ्च गव्य समावृतैः ||
text_mt: to Indrāṇī, to the wives of the gods, and to Rati and Pradyumna; / with [jars] filled with river water and enveloped with the five products of the cow,

sanskrit_iast: hutvā agnim snāpayet kanyām sthitām deśe tu dakṣiṇe | priyaṅgu vaṭa nāgānām kaṣāya udghṛṣṭa kesaram ||
meaning: हुत्वा अग्निम् स्नापयेत् कन्याम् स्थिताम् देशे तु दक्षिणे | प्रियङ्गु वट नागानाम् कषाय उद्घृष्ट केसरम् ||
text_mt: having offered into the fire, he should bathe the maiden who stands in the southern region. / [Having prepared] filaments rubbed with an astringent decoction of priyaṅgu, banyan, and nāga [blossoms],

sanskrit_iast: sampāta abhihutam kṛtvā sarva oṣadhi samanvitam | abhimantrya hi sūkta ante navabhis tu vi hi iti vai ||
meaning: सम्पात अभिहुतम् कृत्वा सर्व ओषधि समन्वितम् | अभिमन्त्र्य हि सूक्त अन्ते नवभिस् तु वि हि इति वै ||
text_mt: offered over with residual drops, combined with all herbs, / and having consecrated them at the end of the hymn with the nine [verses] beginning 'vi hi',

sanskrit_iast: stheyābhir adbhiḥ pūrṇena abhiṣiñced upoṣitām | yaḥ patighnyaḥ striyas tanvaḥ śāmyante tās tv anena vai ||
meaning: स्थेयाभिर् अद्भिः पूर्णेन अभिषिञ्चेद् उपोषिताम् | यः पतिघ्न्यः स्त्रियस् तन्वः शाम्यन्ते तास् त्व् अनेन वै ||
text_mt: he should sprinkle the fasting girl with a [vessel] filled with stagnant water. / Those forms of a woman that are husband-slaying are pacified indeed by this.

sanskrit_iast: snāpayed āhanasyābhir vidyād yām vipravrājinīm | sūktād upoddhared enam na seśa iti tu dvṛcam ||
meaning: स्नापयेद् आहनस्याभिर् विद्याद् याम् विप्रव्राजिनीम् | सूक्ताद् उपोद्धरेद् एनम् न सेश इति तु द्वृचम् ||
text_mt: He should bathe with the Āhanasyā [verses] one whom he knows to wander away. / From the hymn he should extract this couplet: 'He does not rule...'

sanskrit_iast: upadiṣṭo ayam ekeṣām puṃsaḥ karmaṇi pauruṣe | rakṣohaṇam vājinam ity etad rakṣohaṇam japet ||
meaning: उपदिष्टो अयम् एकेषाम् पुंसः कर्मणि पौरुषे | रक्षोहणम् वाजिनम् इत्य् एतद् रक्षोहणम् जपेत् ||
text_mt: This is taught according to some in a virile rite for a man. / He should mutter this demon-slaying [verse]: 'The demon-slaying courser...'

sanskrit_iast: agnim prajvālya ca etena upatiṣṭheta nityaśaḥ | ājya āhutīś ca juhuyāt tena rakṣāṃsi bādhate ||
meaning: अग्निम् प्रज्वाल्य च एतेन उपतिष्ठेत नित्यशः | आज्य आहुतीश् च जुहुयात् तेन रक्षांसि बाधते ||
text_mt: Having kindled the fire, he should constantly revere it with this, / and he should offer oblations of clarified butter; by this he wards off the demons.

sanskrit_iast: etad rakṣohaṇam śāntiḥ paramā eṣā prakīrtitā | haviṣpāntīyam ity etat sūktam atra prayojayet ||
meaning: एतद् रक्षोहणम् शान्तिः परमा एषा प्रकीर्तिता | हविष्पान्तीयम् इत्य् एतत् सूक्तम् अत्र प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: This is a demon-slaying [rite]; it is proclaimed as the supreme pacification. / Here one should employ this hymn: 'Drinking the sacrificial offering' (haviṣpāntīyam).

sanskrit_iast: garhita anna agha yoge ca haviṣpāntīyam abhyaset | pavitram paramam hy etad dhyātavyam ca abhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||
meaning: गर्हित अन्न अघ योगे च हविष्पान्तीयम् अभ्यसेत् | पवित्रम् परमम् ह्य् एतद् ध्यातव्यम् च अभीक्ष्णशः ||
text_mt: And upon contact with the sin of condemned food, one should repeat the Haviṣpāntīya hymn. / For this is the supreme purifier, and it should be meditated upon constantly.

sanskrit_iast: āditye dṛṣṭim āsthāya ṣaṇ māsān niyato abhyaset | deva yānam sa panthānam paśyaty āditya maṇḍale ||
meaning: आदित्ये दृष्टिम् आस्थाय षण् मासान् नियतो अभ्यसेत् | देव यानम् स पन्थानम् पश्यत्य् आदित्य मण्डले ||
text_mt: Fixing his gaze upon the sun, restrained, he should repeat it for six months; / he sees the path of the gods in the solar orb.

sanskrit_iast: vidyā vaiśvānarī ca asya sva kāyasthā prakāśate | haviṣpāntīyam abhyasya sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: विद्या वैश्वानरी च अस्य स्व कायस्था प्रकाशते | हविष्पान्तीयम् अभ्यस्य सर्व पापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
text_mt: And knowledge pertaining to Vaiśvānara shines forth situated within his own body. / Having repeated the Haviṣpāntīya hymn, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast: indram stava iti sūktam tu japet śatru nibarhaṇam | pavitrāṇām pavitram tu guhyam pāvanam adbhutam ||
meaning: इन्द्रम् स्तव इति सूक्तम् तु जपेत् शत्रु निबर्हणम् | पवित्राणाम् पवित्रम् तु गुह्यम् पावनम् अद्भुतम् ||
text_mt: However, one should mutter the hymn 'Praise Indra' (indram stava)—which destroys enemies, / is the purifier of purifiers, secret, purifying, and wonderful.

sanskrit_iast: śukla pakṣe śubhe vāre sunakṣatre sugocare | dvādaśyām putra kāmāya carum kurvīta vaiṣṇavam ||
meaning: शुक्ल पक्षे शुभे वारे सुनक्षत्रे सुगोचरे | द्वादश्याम् पुत्र कामाय चरुम् कुर्वीत वैष्णवम् ||
text_mt: During the bright fortnight, on an auspicious day, under an auspicious lunar mansion, in an auspicious planetary position, / on the twelfth day, for the desire of a son, one should prepare a cooked mess of grain for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: dampatyor upavāsaḥ syād ekādaśyām sula ālaye | ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ samyag arcayitvā janārdanam ||
meaning: दम्पत्योर् उपवासः स्याद् एकादश्याम् सुल आलये | ऋग्भिः षोडशभिः सम्यग् अर्चयित्वा जनार्दनम् ||
text_mt: There should be fasting for the husband and wife on the eleventh day in a clean house. / Having worshipped Janārdana properly with the sixteen verses,

sanskrit_iast: carum puruṣa sūktena śrapayet putra kāmyayā | prāpnuyād vaiṣṇavam putram acirāt santati kṣamam ||
meaning: चरुम् पुरुष सूक्तेन श्रपयेत् पुत्र काम्यया | प्राप्नुयाद् वैष्णवम् पुत्रम् अचिरात् सन्तति क्षमम् ||
text_mt: he should cook the cooked mess of grain with the Puruṣa hymn with the desire for a son. / He will soon obtain a son devoted to Viṣṇu, capable of continuing the lineage.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa dvādaśīḥ samyak payasā nirvapet carum | yaḥ karoti sahasram syād yāti viṣṇoḥ param padam ||
meaning: द्वादश द्वादशीः सम्यक् पयसा निर्वपेत् चरुम् | यः करोति सहस्रम् स्याद् याति विष्णोः परम् पदम् ||
text_mt: One who properly prepares the cooked mess of grain with milk on twelve twelfth days, / if he performs it a thousand times, he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā agnim vidhivat samyag ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir budhaḥ | kṛta añjalipuṭo bhūtvā stavam tābhiḥ prayojayet ||
meaning: हुत्वा अग्निम् विधिवत् सम्यग् ऋग्भिः षोडशभिर् बुधः | कृत अञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा स्तवम् ताभिः प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: Having offered into the fire according to rule properly with the sixteen verses, the wise man, / having joined his hands in reverence, should employ praise with them.

sanskrit_iast: keśavam mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe nārāyaṇam smṛtam | mādhavam māghamāse tu govindam phālgune tathā ||
meaning: केशवम् मार्गशीर्षे तु पौषे नारायणम् स्मृतम् | माधवम् माघमासे तु गोविन्दम् फाल्गुने तथा ||
text_mt: Keśava is remembered in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, but Nārāyaṇa in Pauṣa, / Mādhava in the month of Māgha, and likewise Govinda in Phālguna;

sanskrit_iast: caitre caiva tathā viṣṇum vaiśākhe madhu sūdanam | jyeṣṭhe trivikramam vidyād āṣāḍhe vāmanam viduḥ ||
meaning: चैत्रे चैव तथा विष्णुम् वैशाखे मधु सूदनम् | ज्येष्ठे त्रिविक्रमम् विद्याद् आषाढे वामनम् विदुः ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu in Caitra, and Madhusūdana in Vaiśākha; / in Jyeṣṭha one should know Trivikrama, [and] in Āṣāḍha they know Vāmana;

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇe śrīdharam vidyādd hṛṣīkeśam tataḥ pare | āśvine padmanābham tu dāmodaram ca kārttike ||
meaning: श्रावणे श्रीधरम् विद्याद्द् हृषीकेशम् ततः परे | आश्विने पद्मनाभम् तु दामोदरम् च कार्त्तिके ||
text_mt: in Śrāvaṇa one should know Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa in the one after that, / Padmanābha in Āśvina, and Dāmodara in Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa etāni nāmāni ṛṣyaśṛṅgo abravīn muniḥ | pūjayen māsa nāmabhiḥ sarvān kāmānt samaśnute ||
meaning: द्वादश एतानि नामानि ऋष्यशृङ्गो अब्रवीन् मुनिः | पूजयेन् मास नामभिः सर्वान् कामान्त् समश्नुते ||
text_mt: These twelve names the sage Ṛṣyaśṛṅga stated. / One should worship with the names of the months; he attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣmantam sutam sūte yaśo medhā samanvitam | dhanavantam prajāvantam dhārmikam sāttvikam tathā ||
meaning: आयुष्मन्तम् सुतम् सूते यशो मेधा समन्वितम् | धनवन्तम् प्रजावन्तम् धार्मिकम् सात्त्विकम् तथा ||
text_mt: She gives birth to a long-lived son, endowed with fame and intelligence, / wealthy, having offspring, righteous, and virtuous.

sanskrit_iast: samidho aśvattha vṛkṣasya hutvā agnim juhuyāt punaḥ | upasthānam hutāśasya dhyātvā arcya madhu sūdanam ||
meaning: समिधो अश्वत्थ वृक्षस्य हुत्वा अग्निम् जुहुयात् पुनः | उपस्थानम् हुताशस्य ध्यात्वा अर्च्य मधु सूदनम् ||
text_mt: Having offered firewood sticks of the Aśvattha tree, he should offer into the fire again; / having meditated upon and worshipped Madhusūdana, [there is] the attendance upon the consumer of offerings (fire).

sanskrit_iast: havir hoam tataḥ kuryāt pratyṛcam vāg yataḥ śuciḥ | sūktena juhuyād ājyam ādāv ante ca pūrvavat ||
meaning: हविर् होअम् ततः कुर्यात् प्रत्यृचम् वाग् यतः शुचिः | सूक्तेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् आदाव् अन्ते च पूर्ववत् ||
text_mt: Restraining his speech and pure, he should then perform the offering of oblations verse by verse. / With the hymn, he should offer clarified butter at the beginning and at the end as before.

sanskrit_iast: haviḥ śeṣam namas kṛtvā nārī nārāyaṇam patim | bhakṣayitvā haviḥ śeṣam labdha āśīḥ saṃviśet kṣapām ||
meaning: हविः शेषम् नमस् कृत्वा नारी नारायणम् पतिम् | भक्षयित्वा हविः शेषम् लब्ध आशीः संविशेत् क्षपाम् ||
text_mt: Having paid reverence to Nārāyaṇa and her husband, the woman, having eaten the remnant of the sacrificial food, / having received blessings, should lie down for the night.

sanskrit_iast: tatas tu karma kṛtvā idam kartavyam dvija tarpaṇam | dvitīyām striyām nivarteta yāvad garbham na vindati ||
meaning: ततस् तु कर्म कृत्वा इदम् कर्तव्यम् द्विज तर्पणम् | द्वितीयाम् स्त्रियाम् निवर्तेत यावद् गर्भम् न विन्दति ||
text_mt: Then, having performed this rite, the satisfaction of the twice-born must be done. / He should turn away from a second woman until she conceives a fetus.

sanskrit_iast: aputrā mṛta putrā vā yā ca kanyām prasūyate |
meaning: अपुत्रा मृत पुत्रा वा या च कन्याम् प्रसूयते |
text_mt: A woman without a son, or whose sons have died, or who gives birth [only] to a daughter—

sanskrit_iast: kṣipram sā janayet putram ṛṣyaśṛṅgo yathā abravīt ||
meaning: क्षिप्रम् सा जनयेत् पुत्रम् ऋष्यशृङ्गो यथा अब्रवीत् ||
text_mt: she will quickly bring forth a son, as Ṛṣyaśṛṅga stated.

sanskrit_iast: arcām sampravakṣyāmi viṣṇor amita tejasaḥ | yat kṛtvā munayaḥ sarve brahma nirvāṇam āpnuyuḥ ||
meaning: अर्चाम् सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि विष्णोर् अमित तेजसः | यत् कृत्वा मुनयः सर्वे ब्रह्म निर्वाणम् आप्नुयुः ||
text_mt: I shall fully declare the worship of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendor, / having performed which all sages would attain the extinguishing in Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: apsv agnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca | ṣaṭsv eteṣu hareḥ samyag arcanam munibhiḥ smṛtam ||
meaning: अप्स्व् अग्नौ हृदये सूर्ये स्थण्डिले प्रतिमासु च | षट्स्व् एतेषु हरेः सम्यग् अर्चनम् मुनिभिः स्मृतम् ||
text_mt: In water, in fire, in the heart, in the sun, on the bare ground, and in images— / the proper worship of Hari in these six [places] is remembered by the sages.

sanskrit_iast: agnau kriyāvatām devo divi devo manīṣiṇām | pratimāsv alpa buddhīnām yoginām hṛdaye hariḥ ||
meaning: अग्नौ क्रियावताम् देवो दिवि देवो मनीषिणाम् | प्रतिमास्व् अल्प बुद्धीनाम् योगिनाम् हृदये हरिः ||
text_mt: For ritualists, god is in the fire; for the wise, god is in heaven; / for those of slight intellect, in images; for yogins, Hari is in the heart.

sanskrit_iast: āpo hy āyatanam tasya tasmāt tāsu sadā hariḥ | tasya sarva gatatvāc ca sthaṇḍile bhāvita ātmanām ||
meaning: आपो ह्य् आयतनम् तस्य तस्मात् तासु सदा हरिः | तस्य सर्व गतत्वाच् च स्थण्डिले भावित आत्मनाम् ||
text_mt: For water is his abode; therefore Hari is always in them; / and because he is all-pervading, [he is] on the bare ground for those of purified mind.

sanskrit_iast: dadyāt puruṣa sūktena yaḥ puṣpāṇy apa eva vā | arcitam syāt jagad idam tena sarvam cara acaram ||
meaning: दद्यात् पुरुष सूक्तेन यः पुष्पाण्य् अप एव वा | अर्चितम् स्यात् जगद् इदम् तेन सर्वम् चर अचरम् ||
text_mt: Whoever should offer flowers or even water with the Puruṣa hymn, / by him this whole world, moving and unmoving, would be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast: ānuṣṭubhasya sūktasya triṣṭub antasya devatā | puruṣo yo jagad bījam ṛṣir nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: आनुष्टुभस्य सूक्तस्य त्रिष्टुब् अन्तस्य देवता | पुरुषो यो जगद् बीजम् ऋषिर् नारायणः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: The deity of the Anuṣṭubh hymn that ends in a Triṣṭubh / is the Puruṣa who is the seed of the world; the ṛṣi is remembered as Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: nārāyaṇa mahā bāho śṛṇuṣva eka manāḥ prabho | vakṣye puruṣa sūktasya vidhānam tv arcanam prati ||
meaning: नारायण महा बाहो शृणुष्व एक मनाः प्रभो | वक्ष्ये पुरुष सूक्तस्य विधानम् त्व् अर्चनम् प्रति ||
text_mt: O mighty-armed Nārāyaṇa, listen with a single mind, O Lord! / I shall tell the procedure for the worship regarding the Puruṣa hymn—

sanskrit_iast: agni kāryam japa vidhim stotram caiva sadātmakam | snātvā yathā ukta vidhinā prān mukhaḥ śuddha mānasaḥ ||
meaning: अग्नि कार्यम् जप विधिम् स्तोत्रम् चैव सदात्मकम् | स्नात्वा यथा उक्त विधिना प्रान् मुखः शुद्ध मानसः ||
text_mt: the rite of fire, the rule of muttered recitation, and the eulogy consisting of the True. / Having bathed according to the prescribed rule, facing east, with a purified mind:

sanskrit_iast: prathamām vinyased vāme dvitīyām dakṣiṇe kare | tṛtīyām vāma pāde tu caturthīm dakṣiṇe nyaset ||
meaning: प्रथमाम् विन्यसेद् वामे द्वितीयाम् दक्षिणे करे | तृतीयाम् वाम पादे तु चतुर्थीम् दक्षिणे न्यसेत् ||
text_mt: He should deposit the first [verse] on the left hand, and the second on the right; / the third on the left foot, and the fourth on the right.

sanskrit_iast: pañcamī vāma jānuni ṣaṣṭhim vai dakṣiṇe nyaset | saptamīm vāma kaṭyām tu aṣṭamīm dakṣiṇe kaṭau ||
meaning: पञ्चमी वाम जानुनि षष्ठिम् वै दक्षिणे न्यसेत् | सप्तमीम् वाम कट्याम् तु अष्टमीम् दक्षिणे कटौ ||
text_mt: The fifth on the left knee, and he should deposit the sixth on the right; / the seventh on the left hip, and the eighth on the right hip;

sanskrit_iast: navamīm nābhi madhye tu daśamīm hṛdaye nyaset | ekādaśīm kaṇṭha deśe dvādaśīm vāma bāhuke ||
meaning: नवमीम् नाभि मध्ये तु दशमीम् हृदये न्यसेत् | एकादशीम् कण्ठ देशे द्वादशीम् वाम बाहुके ||
text_mt: the ninth in the middle of the navel, and he should deposit the tenth on the heart; / the eleventh on the throat region, and the twelfth on the left arm;

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśīm dakṣiṇe ca āsye caiva caturdaśīm | akṣṇoḥ pañcadaśīm caiva ṣoḍaśīm mūrdhni vinyaset ||
meaning: त्रयोदशीम् दक्षिणे च आस्ये चैव चतुर्दशीम् | अक्ष्णोः पञ्चदशीम् चैव षोडशीम् मूर्ध्नि विन्यसेत् ||
text_mt: and the thirteenth on the right, and the fourteenth on the mouth; / and the fifteenth on the eyes, and he should deposit the sixteenth on the head.

sanskrit_iast: evam nyāsa vidhim kṛtvā paścāt pūjām samārabhet | yathā dehe tathā deve nyāsam kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
meaning: एवम् न्यास विधिम् कृत्वा पश्चात् पूजाम् समारभेत् | यथा देहे तथा देवे न्यासम् कृत्वा विधानतः ||
text_mt: Having thus performed the ritual deposit, he should then begin the worship. / Having performed the ritual deposit on the deity according to rule just as on the body,

sanskrit_iast: ādyayā āvāhayed devam ṛcā tu puruṣa uttamam | dvitīyayā āsanam dadyāt pādyam caiva tṛtīyayā ||
meaning: आद्यया आवाहयेद् देवम् ऋचा तु पुरुष उत्तमम् | द्वितीयया आसनम् दद्यात् पाद्यम् चैव तृतीयया ||
text_mt: with the first verse he should invoke the god, the Supreme Puruṣa; / with the second he should offer the seat, and with the third water for the feet;

sanskrit_iast: arghyam caturthyā dātavyam pañcamyā ācamanīyakam | ṣaṣṭhyā snānam prakurvīta saptamyā vastram eva ca ||
meaning: अर्घ्यम् चतुर्थ्या दातव्यम् पञ्चम्या आचमनीयकम् | षष्ठ्या स्नानम् प्रकुर्वीत सप्तम्या वस्त्रम् एव च ||
text_mt: the guest-water should be given with the fourth, water for sipping with the fifth; / he should perform the bath with the sixth, and [offer] a garment with the seventh;

sanskrit_iast: yajña upavītam aṣṭamyā navamyā ca anulepanam | puṣpam daśamyā dātavyam ekādaśyā tu dhūpakam ||
meaning: यज्ञ उपवीतम् अष्टम्या नवम्या च अनुलेपनम् | पुष्पम् दशम्या दातव्यम् एकादश्या तु धूपकम् ||
text_mt: the sacred thread with the eighth, and unguent with the ninth; / the flower should be given with the tenth, and incense with the eleventh;

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśyā dīpakam dadyāt trayodaśyā nivedanam | caturdaśyā namaskāram pañcadaśyā pradakṣiṇam ||
meaning: द्वादश्या दीपकम् दद्यात् त्रयोदश्या निवेदनम् | चतुर्दश्या नमस्कारम् पञ्चदश्या प्रदक्षिणम् ||
text_mt: he should give a lamp with the twelfth, an offering of food with the thirteenth, / a bow of reverence with the fourteenth, and circumambulation with the fifteenth.

sanskrit_iast: snāne vastre ca naivedye dadyād ācamanīyakam | dakṣiṇām tu yathā śaktyā ṣoḍaśyā tu pradāpayet ||
meaning: स्नाने वस्त्रे च नैवेद्ये दद्याद् आचमनीयकम् | दक्षिणाम् तु यथा शक्त्या षोडश्या तु प्रदापयेत् ||
text_mt: At the bath, the garment, and the food offering, he should offer water for sipping. / And he should give the priestly gift according to his ability with the sixteenth.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ pradakṣiṇām kṛtvā japam kuryāt samāhitaḥ | yathā śakti japitvā tu sūktam tasya nivedayet ||
meaning: ततः प्रदक्षिणाम् कृत्वा जपम् कुर्यात् समाहितः | यथा शक्ति जपित्वा तु सूक्तम् तस्य निवेदयेत् ||
text_mt: Then, having performed circumambulation, he should do muttered recitation, composed. / Having muttered [the hymn] according to his ability, he should offer the hymn to him.

sanskrit_iast: devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve kuṇḍam sthaṇḍilam eva vā | kārayet prathamena eva dvitīyena tu prokṣaṇam ||
meaning: देवस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे कुण्डम् स्थण्डिलम् एव वा | कारयेत् प्रथमेन एव द्वितीयेन तु प्रोक्षणम् ||
text_mt: On the southern side of the god, one should prepare a sacrificial pit or bare ground with the first [verse], / and the sprinkling with the second;

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyena agnim ādadhyāc caturthena samindhanam | pañcamena ājya śrapaṇam caroś ca śrapaṇam tathā ||
meaning: तृतीयेन अग्निम् आदध्याच् चतुर्थेन समिन्धनम् | पञ्चमेन आज्य श्रपणम् चरोश् च श्रपणम् तथा ||
text_mt: with the third he should set up the fire; with the fourth, the kindling; / with the fifth, the cooking of the clarified butter and the cooking of the cooked mess of grain;

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhena eva agni madhye tu kalpayet padmam āsanam | cintayed deva deva īśam kāla anala sama prabham ||
meaning: षष्ठेन एव अग्नि मध्ये तु कल्पयेत् पद्मम् आसनम् | चिन्तयेद् देव देव ईशम् काल अनल सम प्रभम् ||
text_mt: with the sixth, right in the middle of the fire, he should fashion a lotus-seat. / He should meditate upon the Lord of the god of gods, whose radiance is equal to the fire of time.

sanskrit_iast: tato gandham ca puṣpam ca dhūpa dīpa nivedanam | anujñāpya tataḥ kuryāt saptamy ādi yathā kramam ||
meaning: ततो गन्धम् च पुष्पम् च धूप दीप निवेदनम् | अनुज्ञाप्य ततः कुर्यात् सप्तम्य् आदि यथा क्रमम् ||
text_mt: Then perfume, flower, incense, lamp, and food offering— / having obtained permission, he should then perform [these] in order, beginning with the seventh.

sanskrit_iast: samidhas tāvatīḥ pūrvam juhuyād abhidhāritāḥ | tato ghṛtena juhuyāc caruṇā ca tataḥ punaḥ |
meaning: समिधस् तावतीः पूर्वम् जुहुयाद् अभिधारिताः | ततो घृतेन जुहुयाच् चरुणा च ततः पुनः |
text_mt: He should first offer that many firewood sticks that have been dedicated; / then he should offer with clarified butter, and then again with the cooked mess of grain.

sanskrit_iast: evam hutvā tataś caiva anujñāpya yathā kramam || agner bhagavatas tasya samīpe stotram uccaret |
meaning: एवम् हुत्वा ततश् चैव अनुज्ञाप्य यथा क्रमम् || अग्नेर् भगवतस् तस्य समीपे स्तोत्रम् उच्चरेत् |
text_mt: Having offered thus, and then having asked permission in order, / near that blessed fire he should utter the eulogy:

sanskrit_iast: jitam te puṇḍarīka akṣa namas te viśva bhāvana | namas te astu hṛṣīkeśa mahā puruṣa pūrvaja ||
meaning: जितम् ते पुण्डरीक अक्ष नमस् ते विश्व भावन | नमस् ते अस्तु हृषीकेश महा पुरुष पूर्वज ||
text_mt: 'Conquered [is the world] by you, O lotus-eyed one! Reverence to you, O creator of the universe! / May reverence be to you, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O Great Puruṣa, the first-born!'

sanskrit_iast: devānām dānavānām ca sāmānyam adhidaivatam | sarvadā caraṇa dvandvam vrajāmi śaraṇam tava ||
meaning: देवानाम् दानवानाम् च सामान्यम् अधिदैवतम् | सर्वदा चरण द्वन्द्वम् व्रजामि शरणम् तव ||
text_mt: The common supreme deity of both gods and Dānavas: / I forever go to your two feet for refuge.

sanskrit_iast: ekas tvam asi lokasya sraṣṭā saṃhārakas tathā | avyaktaś ca anumantā ca guṇa māyā samāvṛtaḥ ||
meaning: एकस् त्वम् असि लोकस्य स्रष्टा संहारकस् तथा | अव्यक्तश् च अनुमन्ता च गुण माया समावृतः ||
text_mt: You alone are the creator of the world, and likewise its destroyer; / both unmanifest and consenting witness, enveloped by the māyā of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsāra sāgaram ghoram anantam kleśa bhājanam | tvām eva śaraṇam prāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning: संसार सागरम् घोरम् अनन्तम् क्लेश भाजनम् | त्वाम् एव शरणम् प्राप्य निस्तरन्ति मनीषिणः ||
text_mt: Having attained refuge only in you, wise men cross over / the dreadful, endless ocean of saṃsāra, the vessel of afflictions.

sanskrit_iast: na te rūpam na ca ākāro na āyudhāni na ca āspadam | tathā api puruṣa ākāro bhaktānām tvam prakāśase ||
meaning: न ते रूपम् न च आकारो न आयुधानि न च आस्पदम् | तथा अपि पुरुष आकारो भक्तानाम् त्वम् प्रकाशसे ||
text_mt: You have neither form nor shape, neither weapons nor abode; / yet you manifest yourself to your devotees having the form of a puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: na eva kiṃcit parokṣam te pratyakṣo asi na kasyacit | na eva kiṃcid asādhyam te na ca sādhyo asi kasyacit ||
meaning: न एव किंचित् परोक्षम् ते प्रत्यक्षो असि न कस्यचित् | न एव किंचिद् असाध्यम् ते न च साध्यो असि कस्यचित् ||
text_mt: Nothing at all is unperceived by you, yet you are visible to no one; / nothing at all is unachievable for you, yet you cannot be mastered by anyone.

sanskrit_iast: kāryāṇām kāraṇam pūrvam vacasām vāyam uttamam | yoginām parama aiddhiḥ paramam te padam viduḥ ||
meaning: कार्याणाम् कारणम् पूर्वम् वचसाम् वायम् उत्तमम् | योगिनाम् परम ऐद्धिः परमम् ते पदम् विदुः ||
text_mt: You are the primal cause of effects, the supreme [object] of words; / the supreme siddhi of yogins; they know your supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast: aham bhīto asmi deva īśa saṃsāre asmin mahā bhaye | trāhi mām puṇḍarīka akṣa na jāne paramam padam ||
meaning: अहम् भीतो अस्मि देव ईश संसारे अस्मिन् महा भये | त्राहि माम् पुण्डरीक अक्ष न जाने परमम् पदम् ||
text_mt: I am terrified, O Lord of gods, in this saṃsāra of great fear; / protect me, O lotus-eyed one; I do not know the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast: kāleṣv api ca sarveṣu diṣku sarvāṣu ca acyuta | śarīre ca gataś ca asi vartate me mahad bhayam ||
meaning: कालेष्व् अपि च सर्वेषु दिष्कु सर्वाषु च अच्युत | शरीरे च गतश् च असि वर्तते मे महद् भयम् ||
text_mt: And in all times and in all directions, O Acyuta, / and entered into the body [of all] you are; yet great fear abides in me.

sanskrit_iast: tvat pāda kamalād anyan na me janma antareṣv api | vijñānam yad idam prāpya yad idam sthānam arjitam ||
meaning: त्वत् पाद कमलाद् अन्यन् न मे जन्म अन्तरेष्व् अपि | विज्ञानम् यद् इदम् प्राप्य यद् इदम् स्थानम् अर्जितम् ||
text_mt: Other than your lotus feet there is nothing for me even in other births; / this insight having been attained, this status has been acquired.

sanskrit_iast: janma antare api me deva mā bhūd asya parikṣayaḥ | durgatāv api jātavya tvad gato me mano rathaḥ ||
meaning: जन्म अन्तरे अपि मे देव मा भूद् अस्य परिक्षयः | दुर्गताव् अपि जातव्य त्वद् गतो मे मनो रथः ||
text_mt: Even in another birth, O God, let there not be the destruction of this; / even if born in misfortune, my heart's desire has gone to you.

sanskrit_iast: yadi nāśam na vindeta tāvatā asmi kṛtī sadā | kāmaye viṣṇu pādau tu sarva janmasu kevalam ||
meaning: यदि नाशम् न विन्देत तावता अस्मि कृती सदा | कामये विष्णु पादौ तु सर्व जन्मसु केवलम् ||
text_mt: If it should not meet destruction, by that much I am always fulfilled; / for I desire solely the two feet of Viṣṇu across all births.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣasya hareḥ sūktam svargyam dhanyam yaśaskaram | ātma jñānam idam puṇyam yoga jñānam idam param ||
meaning: पुरुषस्य हरेः सूक्तम् स्वर्ग्यम् धन्यम् यशस्करम् | आत्म ज्ञानम् इदम् पुण्यम् योग ज्ञानम् इदम् परम् ||
text_mt: The hymn to Puruṣa, to Hari, bestows heaven, brings fortune, and yields fame; / this is holy knowledge of the self, this is supreme knowledge of yoga.

sanskrit_iast: phala āhāro bhaven māsam paśyaty ātmānam ātmani | phalāni bhuktvā upavasen māsam adbhiś ca vartayet ||
meaning: फल आहारो भवेन् मासम् पश्यत्य् आत्मानम् आत्मनि | फलानि भुक्त्वा उपवसेन् मासम् अद्भिश् च वर्तयेत् ||
text_mt: One should subsist on fruit for a month; he sees the self in the self; / having eaten fruits, one should fast for a month and subsist on water.

sanskrit_iast: araṇye nivasen nityam japann etam ṛṣim sadā | tris triṣavaṇa kāleṣu snāyād apsu samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: अरण्ये निवसेन् नित्यम् जपन्न् एतम् ऋषिम् सदा | त्रिस् त्रिषवण कालेषु स्नायाद् अप्सु समाहितः ||
text_mt: One should dwell constantly in the forest, always muttering this ṛṣi; / one should bathe in water composed in mind at the three times of daily ablutions.

sanskrit_iast: ādityam upatiṣṭheta sūktena anena nityaśaḥ | ājya āhutor anena eva hutvā etam cintayed ṛṣim ||
meaning: आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत सूक्तेन अनेन नित्यशः | आज्य आहुतोर् अनेन एव हुत्वा एतम् चिन्तयेद् ऋषिम् ||
text_mt: One should attend upon the sun with this hymn constantly; / having offered oblations of ghee with this very [hymn], one should meditate on this ṛṣi.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam māsāt phala āhāras tribhir varṣair jayed divam | tadbhaktas tanmanā yukto daśa varṣāṇy ananya bhāk ||
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् मासात् फल आहारस् त्रिभिर् वर्षैर् जयेद् दिवम् | तद्भक्तस् तन्मना युक्तो दश वर्षाण्य् अनन्य भाक् ||
text_mt: Subsisting on fruit after a month, one would conquer heaven in three years; / devoted to him, with mind fixed on him, disciplined, focused on none other for ten years,

sanskrit_iast: sākṣāt paśyati tam devam nārāyaṇam anāmayam | grāhyam atyanta yatnena sraṣṭāram jagato avyayam ||
meaning: साक्षात् पश्यति तम् देवम् नारायणम् अनामयम् | ग्राह्यम् अत्यन्त यत्नेन स्रष्टारम् जगतो अव्ययम् ||
text_mt: he directly sees that god Nārāyaṇa, free from illness, / to be grasped with utmost exertion, the imperishable creator of the world.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhastha dharme varteta nyāya klṛptaḥ śuci vrataḥ | etam devam cintayeta nārāyaṇam anāmayam ||
meaning: गृहस्थ धर्मे वर्तेत न्याय क्लृप्तः शुचि व्रतः | एतम् देवम् चिन्तयेत नारायणम् अनामयम् ||
text_mt: One should abide by the duty of a householder, conforming to propriety, pure in vows; / he should meditate on this god Nārāyaṇa, free from illness.

sanskrit_iast: ardha rātre tyakta nidra utthāya śuci vāg yataḥ | samprasupteṣu bhūteṣu yogam yuñjīta yogavit ||
meaning: अर्ध रात्रे त्यक्त निद्र उत्थाय शुचि वाग् यतः | सम्प्रसुप्तेषु भूतेषु योगम् युञ्जीत योगवित् ||
text_mt: Having cast off sleep at midnight, having arisen, pure, restraining his speech, / while living beings are fast asleep, the knower of yoga should practice yoga.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjv āsīnaḥ same deśe nivāte śabda varjite | savyam pādam dakṣiṇasya jānuni śleṣayet tataḥ ||
meaning: ऋज्व् आसीनः समे देशे निवाते शब्द वर्जिते | सव्यम् पादम् दक्षिणस्य जानुनि श्लेषयेत् ततः ||
text_mt: Seated upright in a level place, sheltered from wind, free from noise, / one should then place the left foot on the right knee;

sanskrit_iast: saṃhṛtya dakṣiṇam pādam savye jānuni yacchati | brahma añjali kṛtaḥ svastho yoga sammīlita īkṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: संहृत्य दक्षिणम् पादम् सव्ये जानुनि यच्छति | ब्रह्म अञ्जलि कृतः स्वस्थो योग सम्मीलित ईक्षणः ||
text_mt: drawing in the right foot, he places it on the left knee; / making the brahmāñjali, healthy, his eyes closed in yoga,

sanskrit_iast: om ity uktvā svam hṛdayam cintayed aviśaṅkitaḥ | tatra ātmānam samādadhyād indriyāṇi manas tathā ||
meaning: ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा स्वम् हृदयम् चिन्तयेद् अविशङ्कितः | तत्र आत्मानम् समादध्याद् इन्द्रियाणि मनस् तथा ||
text_mt: having uttered "Om", without doubt one should meditate on one's own heart; / there one should concentrate the self, as well as the senses and the mind.

sanskrit_iast: na ced budhyeta kiṃca anyan na paśyec śṛṇuyān na ca | na manasyed yadā yogam tadā prāptaḥ sa ucyate ||
meaning: न चेद् बुध्येत किंच अन्यन् न पश्येच् शृणुयान् न च | न मनस्येद् यदा योगम् तदा प्राप्तः स उच्यते ||
text_mt: If one should not perceive anything else, nor see nor hear, / when one does not think [of external things], then he is said to have attained yoga.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdyam etam ṛṣim abhyasyet paśyann iva yathā śruti | prāṇān āyamya ca āsīno yāvat tam cintayed ṛṣim ||
meaning: हृद्यम् एतम् ऋषिम् अभ्यस्येत् पश्यन्न् इव यथा श्रुति | प्राणान् आयम्य च आसीनो यावत् तम् चिन्तयेद् ऋषिम् ||
text_mt: One should recite this ṛṣi pleasing to the heart, as if seeing [it] according to the sacred text; / and seated, restraining the breaths, as long as [he can] he should meditate on that ṛṣi.

sanskrit_iast: ucchvasiṣyann adho nābhi gamayitvā manas tathā | ucchvased evam asakṛt tanmanā yogam unnayet ||
meaning: उच्छ्वसिष्यन्न् अधो नाभि गमयित्वा मनस् तथा | उच्छ्वसेद् एवम् असकृत् तन्मना योगम् उन्नयेत् ||
text_mt: About to exhale, having directed the mind below the navel, / one should exhale in this way repeatedly; with mind fixed on that, he should elevate yoga.

sanskrit_iast: evam hi yuñjant sāmānyam na paśyet śṛṇuyān na ca | tadā śanair nayec ceto hṛdayād ūrdhvam eva tu ||
meaning: एवम् हि युञ्जन्त् सामान्यम् न पश्येत् शृणुयान् न च | तदा शनैर् नयेच् चेतो हृदयाद् ऊर्ध्वम् एव तु ||
text_mt: For when practicing thus in general, one should neither see nor hear; / then he should slowly lead the mind upward from the heart.

sanskrit_iast: samau tu jatrū ca āsyam ca nāsikā nayane bhruvau | bhruvor madhye param sthānam tatra etad dhārayet sthiram ||
meaning: समौ तु जत्रू च आस्यम् च नासिका नयने भ्रुवौ | भ्रुवोर् मध्ये परम् स्थानम् तत्र एतद् धारयेत् स्थिरम् ||
text_mt: The collarbones, the mouth, the nose, the eyes, and the eyebrows are aligned; / between the eyebrows is the supreme station: there one should hold this steadily.

sanskrit_iast: lalāṭa deśe dhārya atha mūrdhānam gamayet tataḥ | ucchvasaṃś ca yathā kālam nābhim gatvā ucchvaset punaḥ ||
meaning: ललाट देशे धार्य अथ मूर्धानम् गमयेत् ततः | उच्छ्वसंश् च यथा कालम् नाभिम् गत्वा उच्छ्वसेत् पुनः ||
text_mt: Having held it in the region of the forehead, he should then guide it to the crown of the head; / and exhaling in due course, having gone to the navel, he should exhale again.

sanskrit_iast: etat param sthānam uktam brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ | evam yukto mahātmānam ātmānam pratipadyate ||
meaning: एतत् परम् स्थानम् उक्तम् ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः | एवम् युक्तो महात्मानम् आत्मानम् प्रतिपद्यते ||
text_mt: This is said to be the supreme station of Brahman, the Supreme Self; / disciplined in this way, he attains the Great Self, the self.

sanskrit_iast: yadi syāt sukṛtī śuddho yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ | upalabhya param brahma gatim jñātvā bhavet śuciḥ ||
meaning: यदि स्यात् सुकृती शुद्धो यदि वा पापकृत्तमः | उपलभ्य परम् ब्रह्म गतिम् ज्ञात्वा भवेत् शुचिः ||
text_mt: Whether he be virtuous and pure, or the greatest of evildoers, / having attained the supreme Brahman and having known the goal, he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast: sarva pāpa anubaddhaś ced buddhvā etat prayato japet | api jijñāsanād eva gaccheta paramām gatim ||
meaning: सर्व पाप अनुबद्धश् चेद् बुद्ध्वा एतत् प्रयतो जपेत् | अपि जिज्ञासनाद् एव गच्छेत परमाम् गतिम् ||
text_mt: If bound to all sins, having understood this, restrained, he should mutter [it]; / even from the mere desire to know [it], he would go to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast: dhāraṇā tu pṛthak kāryā dharmeṇa anena nityaśaḥ | āditye agnau candramasi vṛkṣa agreṣu ca dhārayet ||
meaning: धारणा तु पृथक् कार्या धर्मेण अनेन नित्यशः | आदित्ये अग्नौ चन्द्रमसि वृक्ष अग्रेषु च धारयेत् ||
text_mt: Concentration, however, is to be performed separately according to this rule constantly; / one should fix it on the sun, on fire, on the moon, and on the tops of trees,

sanskrit_iast: parvata agre samudre vā yatra vā api mano rame | na tv eva viṣayān prāpya dhārayīta kathaṃcana ||
meaning: पर्वत अग्रे समुद्रे वा यत्र वा अपि मनो रमे | न त्व् एव विषयान् प्राप्य धारयीत कथंचन ||
text_mt: on a mountain top, or on the ocean, or wherever is pleasing to the mind; / but one must never fix it having approached sensory objects under any circumstance.

sanskrit_iast: bahv atra duhkham jānīyāt pradhvaṃse dhāraṇā kṛte | dhārmikāṇām kule śuddhe yoga bhraṣṭo abhijāyate ||
meaning: बह्व् अत्र दुह्खम् जानीयात् प्रध्वंसे धारणा कृते | धार्मिकाणाम् कुले शुद्धे योग भ्रष्टो अभिजायते ||
text_mt: One should know that there is much suffering here if destruction occurs in concentration; / one fallen from yoga is reborn into a pure family of righteous people.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhni brahma yadā vindet tam eva ṛṣi sattamam | tadā mūrdhnaḥ param jyotir nakṣatra patham unnayet ||
meaning: मूर्ध्नि ब्रह्म यदा विन्देत् तम् एव ऋषि सत्तमम् | तदा मूर्ध्नः परम् ज्योतिर् नक्षत्र पथम् उन्नयेत् ||
text_mt: When he finds Brahman in the crown of the head, that best of ṛṣis, / then he should raise the supreme light from the crown to the path of the stars.

sanskrit_iast: yogī yoga īśvaram prāpya nirdvandvaḥ parama ātmavit | sarvatra eva ātmanā ātmānam paśyed ṛṣi parāyaṇaḥ ||
meaning: योगी योग ईश्वरम् प्राप्य निर्द्वन्द्वः परम आत्मवित् | सर्वत्र एव आत्मना आत्मानम् पश्येद् ऋषि परायणः ||
text_mt: The yogin, having reached the Lord of yoga, free from pairs of opposites, knowing the Supreme Self, / devoted to the ṛṣi, would see the self everywhere through the self.

sanskrit_iast: japec caiva sadā snātaḥ pavitram idam uttamam | api pātaka samyuktaḥ kālena sukṛtī bhavet ||
meaning: जपेच् चैव सदा स्नातः पवित्रम् इदम् उत्तमम् | अपि पातक सम्युक्तः कालेन सुकृती भवेत् ||
text_mt: And having bathed, one should always mutter this supreme purifier; / even if united with a major sin, in time he becomes a virtuous person.

sanskrit_iast: tapaḥ parāyaṇo nityam satya vāg anasūyakaḥ | japann etam ṛṣim vipraḥ kālena sa vanī bhavet ||
meaning: तपः परायणो नित्यम् सत्य वाग् अनसूयकः | जपन्न् एतम् ऋषिम् विप्रः कालेन स वनी भवेत् ||
text_mt: Constantly devoted to ascetic heat, speaking truth, free from envy, / muttering this ṛṣi, that brahmin would in time become an owner of forests.

sanskrit_iast: yena yena ca kāmena japed imam ṛṣim sadā | sa sa kāmaḥ samṛddhaḥ syāt śraddadhānasya kurvataḥ ||
meaning: येन येन च कामेन जपेद् इमम् ऋषिम् सदा | स स कामः समृद्धः स्यात् श्रद्दधानस्य कुर्वतः ||
text_mt: Whatever desire one may have when constantly muttering this ṛṣi, / that very desire would be fulfilled for the faithful one who performs it.

sanskrit_iast: homam vā apy athavā jāpyam upahāram atho carum | kurvīta yena kāmena tat siddhim avadhārayet ||
meaning: होमम् वा अप्य् अथवा जाप्यम् उपहारम् अथो चरुम् | कुर्वीत येन कामेन तत् सिद्धिम् अवधारयेत् ||
text_mt: Whether a fire offering or a muttered recitation, an offering or a mess of cooked grain, / with whatever desire one performs it, he should ascertain the accomplishment of that.

sanskrit_iast: jñāti śraiṣṭhyam mahad vittam yaśo loke parām gatim | pāpena vipramokṣas tu tat siddhim avadhārayet ||
meaning: ज्ञाति श्रैष्ठ्यम् महद् वित्तम् यशो लोके पराम् गतिम् | पापेन विप्रमोक्षस् तु तत् सिद्धिम् अवधारयेत् ||
text_mt: Pre-eminence among kin, great wealth, fame in the world, the supreme state, / and liberation from sin: he should ascertain the accomplishment of that.

sanskrit_iast: jñāna gamyam param sūkṣmam vyāpya sarvam avasthitam | grāhyam atyanta yatnena brahma abhyety sanātanam ||
meaning: ज्ञान गम्यम् परम् सूक्ष्मम् व्याप्य सर्वम् अवस्थितम् | ग्राह्यम् अत्यन्त यत्नेन ब्रह्म अभ्येत्य् सनातनम् ||
text_mt: Attainable by knowledge, supreme, subtle, abiding pervading all things, / to be grasped with utmost exertion: he approaches the eternal Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: sahasra śīrṣā iti sūktam sarva kāma phala pradam | veda garbha śarīreṇa sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: सहस्र शीर्षा इति सूक्तम् सर्व काम फल प्रदम् | वेद गर्भ शरीरेण स वै नारायणः स्मृतः ||
text_mt: "A Thousand-Headed" is the hymn that grants the fruit of all desires; / with a body containing the Veda in its womb, he indeed is commemorated as Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: brahma indu rudra parjanyā atra sūkte vyavasthitāḥ | atrastham etad draṣṭavyam jagat sthāvara jaṅgamam ||
meaning: ब्रह्म इन्दु रुद्र पर्जन्या अत्र सूक्ते व्यवस्थिताः | अत्रस्थम् एतद् द्रष्टव्यम् जगत् स्थावर जङ्गमम् ||
text_mt: Brahman, the moon, Rudra, and Parjanya are established in this hymn; / this world, moving and stationary, is to be seen as situated herein.

sanskrit_iast: anāsādayāmo api bhaktim na parihāpayet | bhakta anukampī bhagavān śrūyate puruṣa uttamaḥ ||
meaning: अनासादयामो अपि भक्तिम् न परिहापयेत् | भक्त अनुकम्पी भगवान् श्रूयते पुरुष उत्तमः ||
text_mt: Even if we do not obtain [him], one should not abandon devotion; / the Lord, the Supreme Puruṣa, is renowned as compassionate to devotees.

sanskrit_iast: pūjā artham tasya devasya vanyānt svayam upārjitān | āraṇyaka vidhānena nirvapet pratyaham carum |
meaning: पूजा अर्थम् तस्य देवस्य वन्यान्त् स्वयम् उपार्जितान् | आरण्यक विधानेन निर्वपेत् प्रत्यहम् चरुम् |
text_mt: For the worship of that god, with wild [grains] gathered by himself, / he should apportion daily an oblation of boiled rice according to the rule of the forest-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast: nārāyaṇāya svāhā iti mantra ante juhuyādd haviḥ || āsahasrāt tataś cakṣur divyam hotur dadāti saḥ |
meaning: नारायणाय स्वाहा इति मन्त्र अन्ते जुहुयाद्द् हविः || आसहस्रात् ततश् चक्षुर् दिव्यम् होतुर् ददाति सः |
text_mt: He should offer the oblation into the fire at the end of the mantra: “To Nārāyaṇa, svāhā.” / Up to a thousand times: then he gives divine vision to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: api vā caru sahasram tantreṇa ekena nirvapet || yāvanto vā api śakyante ahnā sarvānt samāpayet |
meaning: अपि वा चरु सहस्रम् तन्त्रेण एकेन निर्वपेत् || यावन्तो वा अपि शक्यन्ते अह्ना सर्वान्त् समापयेत् |
text_mt: Or rather, he may apportion a thousand oblations in a single performance, / or as many as possible, he should complete them all in a day.

sanskrit_iast: sahasrasya īpsitānām ca kāmānām labhate phalam || puruṣa āyuḥ samāyuktaḥ siddho vā api caren mahīm |
meaning: सहस्रस्य ईप्सितानाम् च कामानाम् लभते फलम् || पुरुष आयुः समायुक्तः सिद्धो वा अपि चरेन् महीम् |
text_mt: And he obtains the fruit of a thousand desired wishes. / Endowed with the full span of human life, or as an accomplished adept, he may roam the earth.

sanskrit_iast: dhyeyaḥ sadā savitṛ maṇḍala madhya vartī nārāyaṇaḥ sarasija āsana samniviṣṭaḥ | keyūravān makara kuṇḍalavān kirīṭī hārī hiraṇmaya vapur dhṛta śaṅkha cakraḥ ||
meaning: ध्येयः सदा सवितृ मण्डल मध्य वर्ती नारायणः सरसिज आसन सम्निविष्टः | केयूरवान् मकर कुण्डलवान् किरीटी हारी हिरण्मय वपुर् धृत शङ्ख चक्रः ||
text_mt: Always to be meditated upon is Nārāyaṇa, stationed in the center of the solar orb, seated upon a lotus seat, / wearing armlets, makara-shaped earrings, a diadem, a necklace, having a golden body, and holding the conch and discus.

sanskrit_iast: etat tu yaḥ paṭhati kevalam eva sūktam nārāyaṇasya caraṇāv abhivandya vandyau | pāṭhena tena paramena sanātanasya sthānam jarā maraṇa varjitam eti viṣṇoḥ ||
meaning: एतत् तु यः पठति केवलम् एव सूक्तम् नारायणस्य चरणाव् अभिवन्द्य वन्द्यौ | पाठेन तेन परमेन सनातनस्य स्थानम् जरा मरण वर्जितम् एति विष्णोः ||
text_mt: He who recites just this hymn, having bowed to the praiseworthy feet of Nārāyaṇa, / goes by that supreme recitation to the eternal abode of Viṣṇu, free from old age and death.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣā agnau jale puṣpair dhyānena hṛday harim | yajanti sūrayo nityam japena ravi maṇḍale ||
meaning: हविषा अग्नौ जले पुष्पैर् ध्यानेन हृदय् हरिम् | यजन्ति सूरयो नित्यम् जपेन रवि मण्डले ||
text_mt: With an oblation in fire, with flowers in water, with meditation in the heart, / the wise constantly worship Hari with muttered recitation in the solar orb.

sanskrit_iast: bilva patram śamī patram patram bhṛṅgārakasya ca | mālatī kuśa padmam ca sadyas tuṣṭi karam hareḥ ||
meaning: बिल्व पत्रम् शमी पत्रम् पत्रम् भृङ्गारकस्य च | मालती कुश पद्मम् च सद्यस् तुष्टि करम् हरेः ||
text_mt: A bilva leaf, a śamī leaf, and a leaf of bhṛṅgāraka, / and mālatī, kuśa grass, and a lotus instantly produce satisfaction for Hari.

sanskrit_iast: yan na upapadyate kiṃcit tam dhyāyen manasā eva tu | sampadyate prasādāt tu deva devasya cakriṇaḥ ||
meaning: यन् न उपपद्यते किंचित् तम् ध्यायेन् मनसा एव तु | सम्पद्यते प्रसादात् तु देव देवस्य चक्रिणः ||
text_mt: When nothing is available, he should meditate on him with his mind alone; / for everything is accomplished through the grace of the discus-bearer, the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast: patraiś ca puṣpaiś ca toyair akrīta labdhairś ca sadā eva satsu | bhaktyā eka labhye puruṣe purāṇe muktyai kim artham kriyate na yatnaḥ ||
meaning: पत्रैश् च पुष्पैश् च तोयैर् अक्रीत लब्धैर्श् च सदा एव सत्सु | भक्त्या एक लभ्ये पुरुषे पुराणे मुक्त्यै किम् अर्थम् क्रियते न यत्नः ||
text_mt: And when leaves, flowers, and water, obtained unbought, are always available, / why is no effort made for liberation towards the ancient Person, who is attainable by devotion alone?

sanskrit_iast: ity evam uktaḥ puruṣasya viṣṇor arcā vidhir viṣṇu kumāra nāmnā | muktyā eka mārga pratibodhanāya dṛṣṭvā vidhānam tv iha nārada uktam ||
meaning: इत्य् एवम् उक्तः पुरुषस्य विष्णोर् अर्चा विधिर् विष्णु कुमार नाम्ना | मुक्त्या एक मार्ग प्रतिबोधनाय दृष्ट्वा विधानम् त्व् इह नारद उक्तम् ||
text_mt: Thus the rule of worship of the Person Viṣṇu has been declared under the name of Viṣṇukumāra, / for the awakening to the sole path of liberation, having seen the rule declared here by Nārada.

sanskrit_iast: yā oṣadhīḥ svastyayanam japeta nitya vrataḥ | oṣadhīś ca jayen nityam ṣaṇ māsān eva nityaśaḥ || E
meaning: या ओषधीः स्वस्त्ययनम् जपेत नित्य व्रतः | ओषधीश् च जयेन् नित्यम् षण् मासान् एव नित्यशः || ए
text_mt: Constantly observant of his vow, he should mutter [the hymn] 'Yā oṣadhīḥ' as an auspicious prayer, / and he should constantly conquer the herbs for six months continuously.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭvā śaradi vai rudram oṣadhīś ca yajet tathā | tasya āmayā na bhavanti tathā jīrṇāni yāni ca ||
meaning: इष्ट्वा शरदि वै रुद्रम् ओषधीश् च यजेत् तथा | तस्य आमया न भवन्ति तथा जीर्णानि यानि च ||
text_mt: Having sacrificed to Rudra in autumn, and likewise worshiped the herbs, / he suffers no diseases, nor those [ailments] that are chronic.

sanskrit_iast: kriyām tu sapta rātreṇa saptakṛtvo abhyaset tataḥ | prapadyeta oṣadhīm vipraḥ sūktam etaj japant sadā ||
meaning: क्रियाम् तु सप्त रात्रेण सप्तकृत्वो अभ्यसेत् ततः | प्रपद्येत ओषधीम् विप्रः सूक्तम् एतज् जपन्त् सदा ||
text_mt: Then he should practice the rite seven times over seven nights; / constantly muttering this hymn, the wise man should approach the herbs.

sanskrit_iast: dviṣat kṣetrād iha āyadhvam iti vijñāpayeta ca | sva kṣetre varuṇam iṣṭvā vindate dviṣad oṣadhīḥ ||
meaning: द्विषत् क्षेत्राद् इह आयध्वम् इति विज्ञापयेत च | स्व क्षेत्रे वरुणम् इष्ट्वा विन्दते द्विषद् ओषधीः ||
text_mt: And he should pray: 'Come here from the enemy's field!' / Having sacrificed to Varuṇa in his own field, he obtains the herbs of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭi kāmo yata āhāraḥ prapadyeta bṛhaspatim | pāyasena upahāreṇa homena ca samanvitaḥ ||
meaning: वृष्टि कामो यत आहारः प्रपद्येत बृहस्पतिम् | पायसेन उपहारेण होमेन च समन्वितः ||
text_mt: Desiring rain, with controlled diet, he should take refuge in Bṛhaspati, / accompanied by an offering of milk-rice and by a fire offering.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate pati ity etad vṛṣṭi kāmaḥ prayojayet | parjanyam ca namas kṛtvā vṛṣṭim vindati śobhanām ||
meaning: बृहस्पते पति इत्य् एतद् वृष्टि कामः प्रयोजयेत् | पर्जन्यम् च नमस् कृत्वा वृष्टिम् विन्दति शोभनाम् ||
text_mt: Desiring rain, he should employ the [mantra] 'Bṛhaspate pati'; / and having bowed to Parjanya, he obtains fine rain.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra tu parā śāntir jñeyo apratirathas tv ṛṣiḥ | yam eva deśam gaccheta śatrum vā apy anumantritaḥ ||
meaning: सर्वत्र तु परा शान्तिर् ज्ञेयो अप्रतिरथस् त्व् ऋषिः | यम् एव देशम् गच्छेत शत्रुम् वा अप्य् अनुमन्त्रितः ||
text_mt: Everywhere supreme pacification is known [through it], and the ṛṣi is Apratiratha. / Whatever region he might go to, or [against whatever] enemy, being consecrated by mantra,

sanskrit_iast: na ajitvā vinivarteta param hi brahmaṇo balam | sarva kāmair japed etat sarva kāma samṛddhaye ||
meaning: न अजित्वा विनिवर्तेत परम् हि ब्रह्मणो बलम् | सर्व कामैर् जपेद् एतत् सर्व काम समृद्धये ||
text_mt: he would not turn back without conquering, for great is the power of the Brahman. / Accompanied by all desires, he should mutter this for the fulfillment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmam abhyudyatāya rājñe ca etat prayojayet | sarvān vijayate śatrūn na parājīyate paraiḥ ||
meaning: संग्रामम् अभ्युद्यताय राज्ञे च एतत् प्रयोजयेत् | सर्वान् विजयते शत्रून् न पराजीयते परैः ||
text_mt: And he should employ this for a king preparing for battle: / he conquers all enemies and is not defeated by foes.

sanskrit_iast: pathi svastyayanam ca etat taskarebhyaś caran pathi | bhūta uraga piśācebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ parirakṣati ||
meaning: पथि स्वस्त्ययनम् च एतत् तस्करेभ्यश् चरन् पथि | भूत उरग पिशाचेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः परिरक्षति ||
text_mt: And walking on a path, this is an auspicious prayer on the road against thieves; / it protects completely against all ghosts, serpents, and piśācas.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtāṃśam kāśyapam sūktam prajā kāmaḥ śucir japan | anurūpām prajām āśu labhate na atra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: भूतांशम् काश्यपम् सूक्तम् प्रजा कामः शुचिर् जपन् | अनुरूपाम् प्रजाम् आशु लभते न अत्र संशयः ||
text_mt: Desiring offspring, being pure, muttering the hymn of Bhūtāṃśa Kāśyapa, / he quickly obtains suitable offspring; there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast: sthālī pākena nāsatyāv aśvinau tu jayed dvijaḥ | anena eva tu sūktena hutvā aśvān anumantrayet ||
meaning: स्थाली पाकेन नासत्याव् अश्विनौ तु जयेद् द्विजः | अनेन एव तु सूक्तेन हुत्वा अश्वान् अनुमन्त्रयेत् ||
text_mt: A twice-born should win the two Aśvins, the Nāsatyas, with a cooked mess of grain; / having offered into the fire with this very hymn, he should consecrate the horses.

sanskrit_iast: pāyasam kṛsaram māṃsam odanam dadhi saktukān | kulmāṣāṃś ca karambhāṃś ca phalāni vividhāni ca ||
meaning: पायसम् कृसरम् मांसम् ओदनम् दधि सक्तुकान् | कुल्माषांश् च करम्भांश् च फलानि विविधानि च ||
text_mt: Milk-rice, kṛsara, meat, boiled rice, curd, roasted grain meal, / and boiled pulses, mixed groats, and various kinds of fruits,

sanskrit_iast: citram mātryam śubhān gandhān anna pānāni yāni ca | bhakṣyam bhojyam ca peyam ca samāhṛtya udite ravau ||
meaning: चित्रम् मात्र्यम् शुभान् गन्धान् अन्न पानानि यानि च | भक्ष्यम् भोज्यम् च पेयम् च समाहृत्य उदिते रवौ ||
text_mt: various garlands, auspicious perfumes, whatever foods and drinks there are, / food to be chewed, food to be eaten, and drinks: having collected them at sunrise,

sanskrit_iast: bhūtāṃśam abhyaset tāvad yāvad astamito raviḥ | ardha rātre tv atikrānte tato aśvibhyām nivedayet ||
meaning: भूतांशम् अभ्यसेत् तावद् यावद् अस्तमितो रविः | अर्ध रात्रे त्व् अतिक्रान्ते ततो अश्विभ्याम् निवेदयेत् ||
text_mt: he should recite the hymn of Bhūtāṃśa until the sun has set. / When midnight has passed, he should then offer it to the two Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: dīrgha āyuṣam surūpam ca labhet putram suvarcasam | rūpavāṃś ca bhaven nityam bhūtāṃśam yo abhyaset sadā ||
meaning: दीर्घ आयुषम् सुरूपम् च लभेत् पुत्रम् सुवर्चसम् | रूपवांश् च भवेन् नित्यम् भूतांशम् यो अभ्यसेत् सदा ||
text_mt: He would obtain a son who is long-lived, handsome, and full of splendor; / and he who constantly recites the hymn of Bhūtāṃśa will always become handsome.

sanskrit_iast: sārvakāmim ity etam ṛṣim vidyād vicakṣaṇaḥ | na vā u devā ity etaj japeta niyata vrataḥ ||
meaning: सार्वकामिम् इत्य् एतम् ऋषिम् विद्याद् विचक्षणः | न वा उ देवा इत्य् एतज् जपेत नियत व्रतः ||
text_mt: The wise man should know this ṛṣi as Sārvakāmi; / with restrained vow, he should mutter [the hymn] 'Na vā u devāḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: annam vindati sarvatra yatra yatra upatiṣṭhati | pāpmā upahatam ātmānam yo manyeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: अन्नम् विन्दति सर्वत्र यत्र यत्र उपतिष्ठति | पाप्मा उपहतम् आत्मानम् यो मन्येत विचक्षणः ||
text_mt: He finds food everywhere, wherever he presents himself. / The discerning man who considers himself afflicted by sin,

sanskrit_iast: sa japen niyato bhūtvā laghu manyeta pāpmanā | vācam prapadyed vāk kāmo juhvad āśu japann imāḥ ||
meaning: स जपेन् नियतो भूत्वा लघु मन्येत पाप्मना | वाचम् प्रपद्येद् वाक् कामो जुह्वद् आशु जपन्न् इमाः ||
text_mt: having become restrained, should mutter it; he will consider himself lightened of sin. / Desiring speech, he should take refuge in Speech, offering into the fire and muttering these quickly:

sanskrit_iast: aham rudrebhir ity etad vāgmī bhavati pūjitaḥ | natam ity aṣṭakam sūktam vaiśvadevam japan muniḥ ||
meaning: अहम् रुद्रेभिर् इत्य् एतद् वाग्मी भवति पूजितः | नतम् इत्य् अष्टकम् सूक्तम् वैश्वदेवम् जपन् मुनिः ||
text_mt: [muttering] 'Aham rudrebhiḥ', he becomes an honored orator. / The sage muttering the eight-verse hymn 'Natam', addressed to the All-gods,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtsnam tu kalmaṣam hatvā viśvair devaiḥ saha āsate | rātrīm prapadyeta sadā śuciś cīrṇa vrato niśi ||
meaning: कृत्स्नम् तु कल्मषम् हत्वा विश्वैर् देवैः सह आसते | रात्रीम् प्रपद्येत सदा शुचिश् चीर्ण व्रतो निशि ||
text_mt: having destroyed all taint, dwells together with the All-gods. / Pure, having performed his vow, he should always take refuge in Rātrī at night.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta na punar jāyeyam iti yoniṣu | sahasrakṛtvo manasā japed rātrī iti rātri su ||
meaning: यः कामयेत न पुनर् जायेयम् इति योनिषु | सहस्रकृत्वो मनसा जपेद् रात्री इति रात्रि सु ||
text_mt: He who might desire: 'May I not be born again into wombs,' / should mutter mentally a thousand times 'Rātrī' during the nights.

sanskrit_iast: sthālī pākena rātrīm ca yajeta ahar ahar niśi | tanmanā niśi ca āsīnas tiṣṭhed ahani dhārmikaḥ ||
meaning: स्थाली पाकेन रात्रीम् च यजेत अहर् अहर् निशि | तन्मना निशि च आसीनस् तिष्ठेद् अहनि धार्मिकः ||
text_mt: And with a cooked mess of grain he should sacrifice to Rātrī day by day at night; / focused on her, the righteous man should sit at night and stand by day.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam saṃvatsarāc caiva carum payasi saṃskṛtam | sahasrakṛtvas tv etena divā homo vidhīyate ||
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् संवत्सराच् चैव चरुम् पयसि संस्कृतम् | सहस्रकृत्वस् त्व् एतेन दिवा होमो विधीयते ||
text_mt: And after a year, an oblation prepared in milk / is prescribed as a fire offering with this [hymn] a thousand times by day.

sanskrit_iast: juhuyān niśi pūrvasmin bhāge rātri samāhitaḥ | divā ca āvaśyakam kāryam chāyāyām aṃśu tejasā ||
meaning: जुहुयान् निशि पूर्वस्मिन् भागे रात्रि समाहितः | दिवा च आवश्यकम् कार्यम् छायायाम् अंशु तेजसा ||
text_mt: Focused on Rātrī, he should offer into the fire at night in the first part [of the night]; / and during the day his obligatory duties must be done in the shade on account of the brilliance of the sun's rays.

sanskrit_iast: iti prayata ātmavānt sūktam tu manasā japet | saṃvatsare tṛtīye tu sarpiṣā sādhayet carum ||
meaning: इति प्रयत आत्मवान्त् सूक्तम् तु मनसा जपेत् | संवत्सरे तृतीये तु सर्पिषा साधयेत् चरुम् ||
text_mt: Thus restrained and self-possessed, he should mutter the hymn mentally; / in the third year, however, he should prepare the oblation with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: atha asya varadā devī rātrir bhavati śarvarī | vijñāpayati tām devīm varadām svayam āgatām ||
meaning: अथ अस्य वरदा देवी रात्रिर् भवति शर्वरी | विज्ञापयति ताम् देवीम् वरदाम् स्वयम् आगताम् ||
text_mt: Then the goddess Night becomes a granter of boons to him; / he makes his request to that boon-granting goddess who has come in person.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsara ṛtau māsi divase asmin kṣaṇe api vā | prayāṇa kālo bhavitā tava vatsa iti vatsalā ||
meaning: संवत्सर ऋतौ मासि दिवसे अस्मिन् क्षणे अपि वा | प्रयाण कालो भविता तव वत्स इति वत्सला ||
text_mt: The affectionate [goddess says]: 'In such a year, season, month, day, or even moment, / my child, your time of departure will take place.'

sanskrit_iast: rātrī sūktam japann eva tam kālam pratipadyate | na yonim punar āyāti sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: रात्री सूक्तम् जपन्न् एव तम् कालम् प्रतिपद्यते | न योनिम् पुनर् आयाति सर्व पापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
