text_mt: Muttering the Rātrīsūkta, he attains that time; / he does not come to a womb again and is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast: mama agne varca ity etat sarva kāmair japed dvijaḥ | juhvad ājyam anena eva sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: मम अग्ने वर्च इत्य् एतत् सर्व कामैर् जपेद् द्विजः | जुह्वद् आज्यम् अनेन एव सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् ||
text_mt: A twice-born should mutter [the hymn] 'Mama agne varcaḥ' with all desires; / offering clarified butter into the fire with this very [hymn], he would obtain all desires.

sanskrit_iast: yām kalpayanti iti sadā japeta niyata vrataḥ | na enam kṛtyā nihiṃsanti kruddha abhicaritāni ca ||
meaning: याम् कल्पयन्ति इति सदा जपेत नियत व्रतः | न एनम् कृत्या निहिंसन्ति क्रुद्ध अभिचरितानि च ||
text_mt: With restrained vow, he should constantly mutter [the hymn] 'Yāṃ kalpayanti'; / sorceries do not injure him, nor sorcery-practices performed in anger.

sanskrit_iast: yamm aṅgirasa kalpais tu tadvido abhicaranti saḥ | pratyaṅgirasa kalpena sarvāṃs tān pratibādhate ||
meaning: यम्म् अङ्गिरस कल्पैस् तु तद्विदो अभिचरन्ति सः | प्रत्यङ्गिरस कल्पेन सर्वांस् तान् प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: Against those who, knowing them, employ sorceries with rites of the Aṅgirases against him, / he repels all of them by means of the counter-Aṅgiras rite.

sanskrit_iast: pratyaṅgirasa vidvāṃs tu na riṣyeta kadācana | na enam kṛtyā nihiṃsanti jñāta ajñātāni vā kvacit ||
meaning: प्रत्यङ्गिरस विद्वांस् तु न रिष्येत कदाचन | न एनम् कृत्या निहिंसन्ति ज्ञात अज्ञातानि वा क्वचित् ||
text_mt: He who knows the counter-Aṅgiras rite will never come to harm; / sorceries, whether known or unknown, do not injure him anywhere.

sanskrit_iast: ajānatā jānatā vā kruddhena amarṣitena vā | ākruṣṭam vā duruktam vā na eno liṇpati tadvidam ||
meaning: अजानता जानता वा क्रुद्धेन अमर्षितेन वा | आक्रुष्टम् वा दुरुक्तम् वा न एनो लिण्पति तद्विदम् ||
text_mt: Whether [spoken] unknowingly or knowingly, by one angry or impatient, / reviling words or abusive speech do not taint the one who knows it.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva japen nityam ṛṣim svastyayanāya vai | sarva prāyaścittam etad abhāṣata ṛṣiḥ svayam ||
meaning: एवम् एव जपेन् नित्यम् ऋषिम् स्वस्त्ययनाय वै | सर्व प्रायश्चित्तम् एतद् अभाषत ऋषिः स्वयम् ||
text_mt: Just so, one should constantly mutter [the hymn of this] ṛṣi for well-being. / The ṛṣi himself proclaimed this as a universal expiation.

sanskrit_iast: sthāvarāṇām niveśe tu nagarāṇām tathaiva ca | grāmāṇām ca gṛhāṇām ca japed imam ṛṣim sadā ||
meaning: स्थावराणाम् निवेशे तु नगराणाम् तथैव च | ग्रामाणाम् च गृहाणाम् च जपेद् इमम् ऋषिम् सदा ||
text_mt: When establishing permanent settlements, cities, / villages, and houses, one should always mutter [the hymn of] this ṛṣi.

sanskrit_iast: jāta rūpamayam vidvān kārayet trivṛtam maṇim | sahasra sampāta hutam ṛṣiṇā tena tam tataḥ ||
meaning: जात रूपमयम् विद्वान् कारयेत् त्रिवृतम् मणिम् | सहस्र सम्पात हुतम् ऋषिणा तेन तम् ततः ||
text_mt: The wise man should have a three-coiled amulet made of gold, / upon which a thousand offerings of drops have been made by means of that [hymn of the] ṛṣi; then that [amulet],

sanskrit_iast: pratimuñceta śirasi grīvāyām athavā urasi | na enam kṛtyā nihiṃsanti jñāta ajñātāni yāni ca ||
meaning: प्रतिमुञ्चेत शिरसि ग्रीवायाम् अथवा उरसि | न एनम् कृत्या निहिंसन्ति ज्ञात अज्ञातानि यानि च ||
text_mt: he should fasten on the head, on the neck, or on the chest. / Black magic does not harm him, whether [the causes are] known or unknown.

sanskrit_iast: anena eva tu sūktena rājñām ca samalohitam | kārayeta maṇim vidvāṃs tāvad eva anumantraṇam ||
meaning: अनेन एव तु सूक्तेन राज्ञाम् च समलोहितम् | कारयेत मणिम् विद्वांस् तावद् एव अनुमन्त्रणम् ||
text_mt: With this very hymn, the wise man should have [an amulet] made of copper for kings, / consecrated with the same number of muttered recitations.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmeṣu dhvaja agrāṇi vāditrāṇy anumantrayet | āsanāni ca śayyāś ca yānāni vividhāni ca ||
meaning: संग्रामेषु ध्वज अग्राणि वादित्राण्य् अनुमन्त्रयेत् | आसनानि च शय्याश् च यानानि विविधानि च ||
text_mt: In battles, he should consecrate the tips of banners and musical instruments, / seats, beds, and various kinds of vehicles.

sanskrit_iast: tasya abhicarataḥ sākṣād āṅgirasa ṛṣeḥ svayam | pratyaṅgirasa kalpena sarvam tat pratibādhate ||
meaning: तस्य अभिचरतः साक्षाद् आङ्गिरस ऋषेः स्वयम् | प्रत्यङ्गिरस कल्पेन सर्वम् तत् प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: When the Āṅgirasa ṛṣi himself practises black magic directly against him, / he wards off all of it by the Pratyaṅgirasa procedure.

sanskrit_iast: amānuṣīr abhicaret kṛtyā sūktam japann idam | mucyate sarvato aniṣṭāt kim punar mānuṣād bhayam ||
meaning: अमानुषीर् अभिचरेत् कृत्या सूक्तम् जपन्न् इदम् | मुच्यते सर्वतो अनिष्टात् किम् पुनर् मानुषाद् भयम् ||
text_mt: Muttering this hymn, he can counter non-human black magic; / he is freed from all misfortune—what fear, then, from a human?

sanskrit_iast: tapasvī niyato dāntaḥ prayoktā ced bhaved ṛṣiḥ | sarvam tarati śānta ātmā tapo hi sumahad balam ||
meaning: तपस्वी नियतो दान्तः प्रयोक्ता चेद् भवेद् ऋषिः | सर्वम् तरति शान्त आत्मा तपो हि सुमहद् बलम् ||
text_mt: If the practitioner is ascetic, restrained, self-controlled, and a ṛṣi, / having a calmed mind, he overcomes everything; for ascetic heat is a very great power.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣyam āyur varcasyam sūktam dākṣāyaṇam mahat | alaṃkāram hiraṇyam vā prāpya dākṣāyaṇam japet ||
meaning: आयुष्यम् आयुर् वर्चस्यम् सूक्तम् दाक्षायणम् महत् | अलंकारम् हिरण्यम् वा प्राप्य दाक्षायणम् जपेत् ||
text_mt: The Dākṣāyaṇa hymn is long-life-giving and confers vitality. / Having acquired an ornament or gold, one should mutter the Dākṣāyaṇa [hymn].

sanskrit_iast: prāptam ca śriyam ādatte bahu ca annam samaśnute | na asad āsīd iti japej juhuyād yoga tatparaḥ ||
meaning: प्राप्तम् च श्रियम् आदत्ते बहु च अन्नम् समश्नुते | न असद् आसीद् इति जपेज् जुहुयाद् योग तत्परः ||
text_mt: He takes hold of acquired fortune and enjoys abundant food. / Intent on yoga, he should mutter [the hymn beginning with] "nāsad āsīt" and offer oblations.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpates tu sāyojyam dvādaśa abdaiḥ samaśnute | uta devā iti japed āmayāvī yata vrataḥ ||
meaning: प्रजापतेस् तु सायोज्यम् द्वादश अब्दैः समश्नुते | उत देवा इति जपेद् आमयावी यत व्रतः ||
text_mt: He attains union with Prajāpati after twelve years. / One who is sick, observing his vows, should mutter [the hymn beginning with] "uta devāḥ".

sanskrit_iast: ghṛta kumbham nidhāya atha juhuyāj jāta vedasi | kumbhāt sampātam anyasmin kāṃsya pātre nidhāpayet ||
meaning: घृत कुम्भम् निधाय अथ जुहुयाज् जात वेदसि | कुम्भात् सम्पातम् अन्यस्मिन् कांस्य पात्रे निधापयेत् ||
text_mt: Having placed a pot of ghee, he should then sacrifice into the fire; / he should cause the drops [of ghee] from the pot to be placed in another bronze vessel.

sanskrit_iast: yo annāya alam na ca annam syāt sa idam samprakalpayet | tena ājyena aṅgam abhyajya śanakair anna bhāg bhavet ||
meaning: यो अन्नाय अलम् न च अन्नम् स्यात् स इदम् सम्प्रकल्पयेत् | तेन आज्येन अङ्गम् अभ्यज्य शनकैर् अन्न भाग् भवेत् ||
text_mt: One who is able to [eat] food, but has no food, should perform this rite: / anointing his limbs with that ghee, he will gradually become an enjoyer of food.

sanskrit_iast: roga ārtasya apy anena eva gātram aṅktvā japed idam | ajīrṇān no apy añjayīta sukham bhavati tena ha ||
meaning: रोग आर्तस्य अप्य् अनेन एव गात्रम् अङ्क्त्वा जपेद् इदम् | अजीर्णान् नो अप्य् अञ्जयीत सुखम् भवति तेन ह ||
text_mt: Also, having anointed the limb of one afflicted with disease with this very [ghee], one should mutter this [hymn]; / one whose food is undigested should also smear himself; through this, well-being arises.

sanskrit_iast: agne acchā vada ity etad dhana kāmaḥ prayojayet | niyataḥ sarpiṣā hutvā japed ayutaśaḥ punaḥ ||
meaning: अग्ने अच्छा वद इत्य् एतद् धन कामः प्रयोजयेत् | नियतः सर्पिषा हुत्वा जपेद् अयुतशः पुनः ||
text_mt: One desiring wealth should employ this [verse beginning with] "agne acchā vada". / Restrained, having offered oblations with ghee, he should mutter [it] again by ten thousands.

sanskrit_iast: khādirīṇām hi samidhām juhuyād daśatīr daśa | daśakṛtvaḥ sadāreṇa rāyas poṣeṇa puṣyati ||
meaning: खादिरीणाम् हि समिधाम् जुहुयाद् दशतीर् दश | दशकृत्वः सदारेण रायस् पोषेण पुष्यति ||
text_mt: He should offer ten decades of khadira kindling sticks / ten times; together with his wife, he thrives with an increase of wealth.

sanskrit_iast: bilva udumbara pālāśīs tathā rauhītakīś ca yāḥ | juhuyād dhana kāmas tu rāyas poṣeṇa puṣyati ||
meaning: बिल्व उदुम्बर पालाशीस् तथा रौहीतकीश् च याः | जुहुयाद् धन कामस् तु रायस् पोषेण पुष्यति ||
text_mt: One desiring wealth who offers [kindling sticks] of bilva, udumbara, palāśa, / and likewise of rohītaka, thrives with an increase of wealth.

sanskrit_iast: vaibhītaka idhmo bailvakīr juhuyād ardha māsabhuk | dviṣad dveṣeṇa tasya ante sūktam etat prayojayet ||
meaning: वैभीतक इध्मो बैल्वकीर् जुहुयाद् अर्ध मासभुक् | द्विषद् द्वेषेण तस्य अन्ते सूक्तम् एतत् प्रयोजयेत् ||
text_mt: With vibhītaka fuel, eating once every half-month, he should offer [sticks] of bilva; / out of hatred for an enemy, he should employ this hymn at the conclusion of that.

sanskrit_iast: dviṣantam dhaninam hatvā dviṣato vindate dhanam | athavā japyam eva syād rāyas poṣa dhana arthinā ||
meaning: द्विषन्तम् धनिनम् हत्वा द्विषतो विन्दते धनम् | अथवा जप्यम् एव स्याद् रायस् पोष धन अर्थिना ||
text_mt: Having slain a wealthy enemy, he finds the wealth of the enemy; / or else it may simply be muttered by one desiring increase of wealth and riches.

sanskrit_iast: ayam agne jaritā iti japed agni bhaye sati | vidhinā tarpayitvā agnim payo dadhi ghṛta ādibhiḥ ||
meaning: अयम् अग्ने जरिता इति जपेद् अग्नि भये सति | विधिना तर्पयित्वा अग्निम् पयो दधि घृत आदिभिः ||
text_mt: When there is danger from fire, one should mutter [the hymn beginning with] "ayam agne jaritā", / having propitiated the fire according to rule with milk, curds, ghee, and other [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: svayam pātum yāvad icchet tāvad gatvā catur diśam | apām idam pariṇayet saṃtata udaka dhārayā ||
meaning: स्वयम् पातुम् यावद् इच्छेत् तावद् गत्वा चतुर् दिशम् | अपाम् इदम् परिणयेत् संतत उदक धारया ||
text_mt: Going as far in the four directions as he himself wishes to protect, / he should encircle it with water in a continuous stream of water,

sanskrit_iast: uda hrada iva bhūtvā agner bheṣajam antikāt | araṇyam etya pāṭhām tu krīṇīyād yava muṣṭinā ||
meaning: उद ह्रद इव भूत्वा अग्नेर् भेषजम् अन्तिकात् | अरण्यम् एत्य पाठाम् तु क्रीणीयाद् यव मुष्टिना ||
text_mt: having become like a pool of water, the remedy for fire close at hand. / Entering the forest, he should buy pāṭhā with a fistful of barley:

sanskrit_iast: yadi saumy asi somāya tvā parikrīṇāmy oṣadhim | yadi vāruṇy asy varuṇāya tvā parikrīṇāmy aham tataḥ ||
meaning: यदि सौम्य् असि सोमाय त्वा परिक्रीणाम्य् ओषधिम् | यदि वारुण्य् अस्य् वरुणाय त्वा परिक्रीणाम्य् अहम् ततः ||
text_mt: "If you belong to Soma, I buy you, the herb, for Soma; / if you belong to Varuṇa, then I buy you for Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast: vasubhyo athavā rudrebhya ādityebhyo athavā punaḥ | vaiśvadevy asi viśvebhyaḥ parikrīṇāmy aham tataḥ ||
meaning: वसुभ्यो अथवा रुद्रेभ्य आदित्येभ्यो अथवा पुनः | वैश्वदेव्य् असि विश्वेभ्यः परिक्रीणाम्य् अहम् ततः ||
text_mt: or if for the Vasus, or for the Rudras, or again for the Ādityas; / if you belong to the Viśvedevas, then I buy [you] for the Viśvedevas."

sanskrit_iast: kṣiptvā sumanasaḥ pūrvam oṣadhyā saha vīrudhi | tasyā vīryam samādatte karma yatra kariṣyati ||
meaning: क्षिप्त्वा सुमनसः पूर्वम् ओषध्या सह वीरुधि | तस्या वीर्यम् समादत्ते कर्म यत्र करिष्यति ||
text_mt: Having previously thrown flowers along with the herb onto the plant, / he takes hold of its power where he will perform the rite.

sanskrit_iast: tām tu madhye nidadhīta oṣadhīnām vihāyasi | grahaṇe tv oṣadhīnām tu sarvatra eṣa vidhir bhavet ||
meaning: ताम् तु मध्ये निदधीत ओषधीनाम् विहायसि | ग्रहणे त्व् ओषधीनाम् तु सर्वत्र एष विधिर् भवेत् ||
text_mt: He should place it in the open air among herbs. / But this rule should apply everywhere in gathering herbs.

sanskrit_iast: utkhāpayīta tām pāṭhām imām iti japann iha | prātaś ca peṣayed enām saṃsadi brahma cāriṇā ||
meaning: उत्खापयीत ताम् पाठाम् इमाम् इति जपन्न् इह | प्रातश् च पेषयेद् एनाम् संसदि ब्रह्म चारिणा ||
text_mt: He should have that pāṭhā dug up while muttering [the verse beginning with] "imām" here, / and in the morning he should have it ground by a celibate student in an assembly.

sanskrit_iast: tad alābhe vratavatā kanyayā brāhmaṇena vā | prātaḥ śucis tām ghṛtena triḥ pibed anumantritām ||
meaning: तद् अलाभे व्रतवता कन्यया ब्राह्मणेन वा | प्रातः शुचिस् ताम् घृतेन त्रिः पिबेद् अनुमन्त्रिताम् ||
text_mt: In his absence, [it should be ground] by a girl keeping a vow or by a brahmin. / Pure in the morning, she should drink it three times with ghee, after it has been consecrated with mantras,

sanskrit_iast: imām iti tu sūktena śatakṛtvo daśa avaram | sapatnīm bādhate tena patiś ca atīva manyate ||
meaning: इमाम् इति तु सूक्तेन शतकृत्वो दश अवरम् | सपत्नीम् बाधते तेन पतिश् च अतीव मन्यते ||
text_mt: with the hymn [beginning with] "imām", a hundred times, [or] at least ten times; / by this she suppresses her co-wife, and her husband values her exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast: patis tu parijapya enām pāṭhām etena vai pibet | payasā sapta rātram tu sapatnān pratibādhate ||
meaning: पतिस् तु परिजप्य एनाम् पाठाम् एतेन वै पिबेत् | पयसा सप्त रात्रम् तु सपत्नान् प्रतिबाधते ||
text_mt: A husband, having muttered [the verses] over this pāṭhā, should drink [it] with this [hymn] / with milk for seven nights; he overcomes his rivals.

sanskrit_iast: mūla mantra japair anyair yā patim jetum icchati | alokā yama lokasthā majjate narake hi sā ||
meaning: मूल मन्त्र जपैर् अन्यैर् या पतिम् जेतुम् इच्छति | अलोका यम लोकस्था मज्जते नरके हि सा ||
text_mt: She who desires to conquer her husband by muttering other root mantras, / worldless, staying in the realm of Yama, indeed sinks into hell.

sanskrit_iast: anyathā ca upanītāni cūrṇa mūla auṣadhāny api | vināśayeyuḥ puruṣam tasmān na anyat samācaret ||
meaning: अन्यथा च उपनीतानि चूर्ण मूल औषधान्य् अपि | विनाशयेयुः पुरुषम् तस्मान् न अन्यत् समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: Moreover, powders, roots, and herbs brought about in another manner / would destroy the man; therefore, she should not perform anything else.

sanskrit_iast: priyam vadā bhartari yā bhartā yasyāḥ parāyaṇam | vāk caiva madhurā yasyāḥ patyuḥ saṃvananam mahat ||
meaning: प्रियम् वदा भर्तरि या भर्ता यस्याः परायणम् | वाक् चैव मधुरा यस्याः पत्युः संवननम् महत् ||
text_mt: She who speaks pleasantly to her husband, to whom the husband is the supreme resort, / and whose speech is sweet, [possesses] a great subjugation of her husband.

sanskrit_iast: priyam bhartāram āsādya pibed eva oṣadhīm imām | priyaṃvadām dharma parām dharma patnīm aninditām ||
meaning: प्रियम् भर्तारम् आसाद्य पिबेद् एव ओषधीम् इमाम् | प्रियंवदाम् धर्म पराम् धर्म पत्नीम् अनिन्दिताम् ||
text_mt: Having approached her beloved husband, she should indeed drink this herb. / If one through delusion should despise an unblamable lawful wife

sanskrit_iast: avamanyeta yo mohāt tam āhuḥ puruṣa adhamam | araṇyānī ity araṇyeṣu japet sūktam anekaśaḥ ||
meaning: अवमन्येत यो मोहात् तम् आहुः पुरुष अधमम् | अरण्यानी इत्य् अरण्येषु जपेत् सूक्तम् अनेकशः ||
text_mt: who speaks pleasantly and is devoted to duty, they call him the lowest of men. / In forests, one should mutter the hymn [beginning with] "araṇyānī" repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast: araṇyānīm namas kṛtvā so araṇyāt pramucyate | śraddhā sūktam japen nityam śraddhā kāmaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: अरण्यानीम् नमस् कृत्वा सो अरण्यात् प्रमुच्यते | श्रद्धा सूक्तम् जपेन् नित्यम् श्रद्धा कामः समाहितः ||
text_mt: Having paid homage to Araṇyānī, he is freed from the wilderness. / One desiring faith, concentrated in mind, should constantly mutter the Śraddhā hymn.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra labhate śraddhām medhā sūktam tathaiva ca | brāhmīm āsādya sūkte dve japeta niyata vrataḥ ||
meaning: सर्वत्र लभते श्रद्धाम् मेधा सूक्तम् तथैव च | ब्राह्मीम् आसाद्य सूक्ते द्वे जपेत नियत व्रतः ||
text_mt: He obtains faith everywhere, and likewise [with] the Medhā hymn. / Having obtained brāhmī, restrained in vows, he should mutter the two hymns.

sanskrit_iast: tām pibet tu yathā śaktyā tryahāt siddhim niyacchati | śaṅkha puṣpīm tu payasā brāhmī puṣpāṇi sarpiṣā ||
meaning: ताम् पिबेत् तु यथा शक्त्या त्र्यहात् सिद्धिम् नियच्छति | शङ्ख पुष्पीम् तु पयसा ब्राह्मी पुष्पाणि सर्पिषा ||
text_mt: He should drink it according to his capacity; after three days he attains magical accomplishment: / śaṅkhapuṣpī with milk, and brāhmī flowers with ghee;

sanskrit_iast: śata avarīm tu payasā varcām adbhir ghṛtena vā | sūktābhyām anumantrya ābhyām eka ekām tryaham pibet ||
meaning: शत अवरीम् तु पयसा वर्चाम् अद्भिर् घृतेन वा | सूक्ताभ्याम् अनुमन्त्र्य आभ्याम् एक एकाम् त्र्यहम् पिबेत् ||
text_mt: śatāvarī with milk, and varcā (?) with water or ghee. / Having consecrated each one with these two hymns, he should drink [it] for three days.

sanskrit_iast: śraddhām medhām smṛtim puṣṭim balam lakṣmīm ca vindati | siddhim prāpnoti ca parām dīrgham ca āyuḥ samaśnute ||
meaning: श्रद्धाम् मेधाम् स्मृतिम् पुष्टिम् बलम् लक्ष्मीम् च विन्दति | सिद्धिम् प्राप्नोति च पराम् दीर्घम् च आयुः समश्नुते ||
text_mt: He finds faith, intelligence, memory, prosperity, strength, and fortune; / he achieves supreme magical accomplishment and enjoys a long life.

sanskrit_iast: athavā manasā dhyāyet sūkte siddhim niyacchati | śāma itthā sapatnaghnam saṃgrāmam vijigīṣataḥ ||
meaning: अथवा मनसा ध्यायेत् सूक्ते सिद्धिम् नियच्छति | शाम इत्था सपत्नघ्नम् संग्रामम् विजिगीषतः ||
text_mt: Or he may meditate on the two hymns with his mind; he attains magical accomplishment. / The hymn [beginning with] "śām itthā" destroys rivals for one wishing to win a battle.

sanskrit_iast: prayoktavyam tu śucinā juhuyāt tatra siddhaye | athavā japyam eva syāt saṃgrāmam abhigacchataḥ ||
meaning: प्रयोक्तव्यम् तु शुचिना जुहुयात् तत्र सिद्धये | अथवा जप्यम् एव स्यात् संग्रामम् अभिगच्छतः ||
text_mt: It should be employed by a pure person; he should offer oblations there for success, / or it may simply be muttered by one marching to battle.

sanskrit_iast: śāma itthā iti yo hantum śatrūnt sarvān nivārayet | alakṣmī nāśana artham tu japen nityam śirimbiṭam ||
meaning: शाम इत्था इति यो हन्तुम् शत्रून्त् सर्वान् निवारयेत् | अलक्ष्मी नाशन अर्थम् तु जपेन् नित्यम् शिरिम्बिटम् ||
text_mt: With "śām itthā", he should ward off all enemies so as to slay [them]. / But for the purpose of destroying misfortune, one should constantly mutter the Śirimbiṭha hymn.

sanskrit_iast: apāmārgamayīm śākhām sadarbhām saha vīrudhām | gṛhītvā ātmānam pāvayed adhaś ca ūrdhvam ca nityaśaḥ ||
meaning: अपामार्गमयीम् शाखाम् सदर्भाम् सह वीरुधाम् | गृहीत्वा आत्मानम् पावयेद् अधश् च ऊर्ध्वम् च नित्यशः ||
text_mt: Taking an apāmārga bough together with darbha grass and the whole plant, / he should purify himself, downwards and upwards, constantly.

sanskrit_iast: ājyam ca anena juhuyāt sahasram daśatīr daśa | tryaheṇa nudate dehād alakṣmīm śatavārṣikīm ||
meaning: आज्यम् च अनेन जुहुयात् सहस्रम् दशतीर् दश | त्र्यहेण नुदते देहाद् अलक्ष्मीम् शतवार्षिकीम् ||
text_mt: And with this [hymn] one should offer clarified butter a thousand [times], ten decades [of offerings]; / in three days one drives out from the body misfortune lasting a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast: cāndrāyaṇam carann etat sūktam siddhikaram japet | alakṣmīm nudate dehād api varṣa sahasrakīm ||
meaning: चान्द्रायणम् चरन्न् एतत् सूक्तम् सिद्धिकरम् जपेत् | अलक्ष्मीम् नुदते देहाद् अपि वर्ष सहस्रकीम् ||
text_mt: Performing a Cāndrāyaṇa observance, one should recite this success-yielding hymn; / one drives out from the body misfortune even lasting a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhītam yakṣmaṇā darbhān gṛhītvā saṃspṛśan japet | muñcāmi tvā haviṣā iti yakṣmāṇam apakarṣati ||
meaning: गृहीतम् यक्ष्मणा दर्भान् गृहीत्वा संस्पृशन् जपेत् | मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा इति यक्ष्माणम् अपकर्षति ||
text_mt: Taking darbha grass and touching one seized by consumption, one should recite: / "With the oblation I release you"; [thus] one pulls out consumption.

sanskrit_iast: samiddham agim juhuyād ājyena eva yathā vidhi | sampātam ājye ninayet sampātaiś ca payaḥ pibet ||
meaning: समिद्धम् अगिम् जुहुयाद् आज्येन एव यथा विधि | सम्पातम् आज्ये निनयेत् सम्पातैश् च पयः पिबेत् ||
text_mt: One should offer into the kindled fire with clarified butter according to rule; / one should pour the residue into the clarified butter, and with the residues he should drink milk.

sanskrit_iast: sampāta bhājane sarpiś cūrṇam tatra nidhāpayet | tatra asya bhojanīyam syāt pānīyam ca anumantritam ||
meaning: सम्पात भाजने सर्पिश् चूर्णम् तत्र निधापयेत् | तत्र अस्य भोजनीयम् स्यात् पानीयम् च अनुमन्त्रितम् ||
text_mt: One should place clarified butter [and] powder in the residue-vessel; / therein should be his food, and his drink should be consecrated with mantras.

sanskrit_iast: khādirāṇi ca kāṣṭhāni cūrṇam kṛtvā saha ambubhiḥ | śodhayīta rasam ca iṣām madhv ājyābhyām pibet saha ||
meaning: खादिराणि च काष्ठानि चूर्णम् कृत्वा सह अम्बुभिः | शोधयीत रसम् च इषाम् मध्व् आज्याभ्याम् पिबेत् सह ||
text_mt: And having ground khadira pieces into powder with water, / one should extract their juice and drink it with honey and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā iti tatra tatra prayojayet | yakṣmāṇam apakarṣanti śarīrāt tena karmaṇā ||
meaning: मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा इति तत्र तत्र प्रयोजयेत् | यक्ष्माणम् अपकर्षन्ति शरीरात् तेन कर्मणा ||
text_mt: One should employ [the mantra] "With the oblation I release you" on every such occasion; / by that rite they pull consumption out of the body.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāḥ garbhaḥ pramīyeta tatra agnau juhuyādd haviḥ | brahmaṇā agniḥ saṃvidāna ity ājyena yathā vidhi ||
meaning: यस्याः गर्भः प्रमीयेत तत्र अग्नौ जुहुयाद्द् हविः | ब्रह्मणा अग्निः संविदान इत्य् आज्येन यथा विधि ||
text_mt: If a woman's fetus should die, one should offer sacrificial food into the fire there, / [reciting] "Agni agreeing with Brahman," with clarified butter according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: ājya śeṣeṇa ca abhyajya garbhiṇī prasavet tataḥ | pibed eva ājya śeṣam tu jīvaṃs tasyāḥ prajāyate ||
meaning: आज्य शेषेण च अभ्यज्य गर्भिणी प्रसवेत् ततः | पिबेद् एव आज्य शेषम् तु जीवंस् तस्याः प्रजायते ||
text_mt: And having anointed the pregnant woman with the remainder of the clarified butter, she will then give birth; / she should indeed drink the remainder of the clarified butter, and a living [child] is born to her.

sanskrit_iast: jātāni cet pramīyerann ājyam kṛtvā anumantritam | juhuyād brahmaṇā agnir iti sampātān ninayen maṇau ||
meaning: जातानि चेत् प्रमीयेरन्न् आज्यम् कृत्वा अनुमन्त्रितम् | जुहुयाद् ब्रह्मणा अग्निर् इति सम्पातान् निनयेन् मणौ ||
text_mt: If [children] born should die, having consecrated clarified butter with mantras, / one should offer [reciting] "Agni with Brahman," and pour the residues onto an amulet.

sanskrit_iast: maṇim tu trivṛti sūtre vāsayed vāsasā saha | nyagrodha śuṅgayā tatra śukla lohita veṣṭitam ||
meaning: मणिम् तु त्रिवृति सूत्रे वासयेद् वाससा सह | न्यग्रोध शुङ्गया तत्र शुक्ल लोहित वेष्टितम् ||
text_mt: One should set the amulet on a three-ply cord together with a cloth, / wrapped there with a fig-tree shoot [and with] white and red [cloth].

sanskrit_iast: tam sāvitry ayutena eva anumantrya yathā vidhi | sampātair ayutena eva brahmaṇā iti ca saṃstutam ||
meaning: तम् सावित्र्य् अयुतेन एव अनुमन्त्र्य यथा विधि | सम्पातैर् अयुतेन एव ब्रह्मणा इति च संस्तुतम् ||
text_mt: Having consecrated it according to rule with ten thousand [recitations] of the Sāvitrī, / and with ten thousand residues, and praised with [the verse beginning] "By Brahman";

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭāc ca sāvitryā tāvad eva anumantraṇam | sarvaiḥ svastyayanaiś ca etaj japed abhihutam maṇim ||
meaning: उपरिष्टाच् च सावित्र्या तावद् एव अनुमन्त्रणम् | सर्वैः स्वस्त्ययनैश् च एतज् जपेद् अभिहुतम् मणिम् ||
text_mt: and subsequently with the Sāvitrī there is just as much consecration with mantras; / and one should recite all the welfare-chants over this amulet offered into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: śirasā dhārayen nārī prayatā garbhiṇī satī | tṛtīye garbha māse tu maṇim etam samāsajet ||
meaning: शिरसा धारयेन् नारी प्रयता गर्भिणी सती | तृतीये गर्भ मासे तु मणिम् एतम् समासजेत् ||
text_mt: A woman should wear it on her head, being restrained and pregnant; / in the third month of pregnancy, indeed, she should fasten this amulet.

sanskrit_iast: puṣpavatī śaradam nārī gauḥ savatsā vased yathā | bahu pānīya yavasā vatsena pibatā saha ||
meaning: पुष्पवती शरदम् नारी गौः सवत्सा वसेद् यथा | बहु पानीय यवसा वत्सेन पिबता सह ||
text_mt: A woman having had her menses would dwell through autumn just as a cow with her calf, / having abundant drink and grass, together with the calf that drinks.

sanskrit_iast: jātasya tu kumārasya kaṇṭhe tam maṇim āsajet | ājya śeṣam puraskṛtya tam abhyajya kumārakam ||
meaning: जातस्य तु कुमारस्य कण्ठे तम् मणिम् आसजेत् | आज्य शेषम् पुरस्कृत्य तम् अभ्यज्य कुमारकम् ||
text_mt: And when the boy is born, one should fasten that amulet upon his neck, / having first taken the remainder of the clarified butter and anointed that boy.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā svastyayanair eva strī pumāṃsam prasūyate | ūrdhvam varṣāt svastyayanam punar eva vidhīyate ||
meaning: हुत्वा स्वस्त्ययनैर् एव स्त्री पुमांसम् प्रसूयते | ऊर्ध्वम् वर्षात् स्वस्त्ययनम् पुनर् एव विधीयते ||
text_mt: Having offered with welfare-chants, the woman bears a male child; / after a year, a welfare-rite is prescribed once again.

sanskrit_iast: puraḥ stana pradānāt tam śraddhā sūktena pāyayet | medhā sūktena caiva enam piṣṭam vrīhimayam carum ||
meaning: पुरः स्तन प्रदानात् तम् श्रद्धा सूक्तेन पाययेत् | मेधा सूक्तेन चैव एनम् पिष्टम् व्रीहिमयम् चरुम् ||
text_mt: Before giving the breast, one should have him drink with the Śraddhā hymn, / and with the Medhā hymn [feed] him ground caru made of rice,

sanskrit_iast: madhu miśram jāta rūpam medhāvī tena jāyate | śatam varṣāṇi jīvet ṃriyate na purā āyuṣaḥ ||
meaning: मधु मिश्रम् जात रूपम् मेधावी तेन जायते | शतम् वर्षाणि जीवेत् ंरियते न पुरा आयुषः ||
text_mt: mixed with honey and gold; by this he becomes intelligent; / he will live for a hundred years, [and] does not die before his full lifespan.

sanskrit_iast: smṛtam eva tasya syāt ṣaṇ māsāc ca tataḥ param | ājyam saṃskṛtya juhuyād akṣibhyām ta iti dvijaḥ ||
meaning: स्मृतम् एव तस्य स्यात् षण् मासाच् च ततः परम् | आज्यम् संस्कृत्य जुहुयाद् अक्षिभ्याम् त इति द्विजः ||
text_mt: He will possess good memory; and six months after that, / a twice-born should prepare clarified butter and offer [reciting] "From your eyes."

sanskrit_iast: pāṇinā tu ghṛta aktena mūrdhānam saṃspṛśet tataḥ | karṇau netre ca chubukam nāsike caiva saṃspṛśet ||
meaning: पाणिना तु घृत अक्तेन मूर्धानम् संस्पृशेत् ततः | कर्णौ नेत्रे च छुबुकम् नासिके चैव संस्पृशेत् ||
text_mt: Then with a hand smeared with clarified butter he should touch the crown of the head; / he should also touch the ears, eyes, chin, and nostrils.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva japen nityam yakṣmaṇo vipramucyate | pūrva uktena eva kalpena yakṣma nāśanam ācaret ||
meaning: एवम् एव जपेन् नित्यम् यक्ष्मणो विप्रमुच्यते | पूर्व उक्तेन एव कल्पेन यक्ष्म नाशनम् आचरेत् ||
text_mt: In this very way he should constantly recite; he is completely freed from consumption; / by the procedure previously declared he should perform the destruction of consumption.

sanskrit_iast: homena ca japaiś caiva yakṣam nāśanam ācaret | apehi iti ca japet sūktam śucir duhsvapna nāśanam ||
meaning: होमेन च जपैश् चैव यक्षम् नाशनम् आचरेत् | अपेहि इति च जपेत् सूक्तम् शुचिर् दुह्स्वप्न नाशनम् ||
text_mt: By fire offering and by muttered recitations he should perform the destruction of consumption; / and pure, he should recite the hymn "Go away!" which destroys bad dreams.

sanskrit_iast: devāḥ kapota iti tu kapotasya upaveśane | sūktena juhuyād ājyam yama dūtam hi tam viduḥ ||
meaning: देवाः कपोत इति तु कपोतस्य उपवेशने | सूक्तेन जुहुयाद् आज्यम् यम दूतम् हि तम् विदुः ||
text_mt: Upon the alighting of a pigeon, however, with [the hymn] "O gods, the dove," / one should offer clarified butter; for they know it to be the messenger of Yama.

sanskrit_iast: sapatnaghnam prayuñjīta ṛṣabham japa homayoḥ | yena idam iti vai nityam japeta niyata vrataḥ ||
meaning: सपत्नघ्नम् प्रयुञ्जीत ऋषभम् जप होमयोः | येन इदम् इति वै नित्यम् जपेत नियत व्रतः ||
text_mt: One should employ the rival-slaying hymn "The bull" in muttered recitation and fire offering; / one with restrained vows should indeed recite daily "By whom this [world]..."

sanskrit_iast: samādhim manasas tena vindate na eva muhyati | mayo bhūr vāta iti tu gavām svastyayane japet ||
meaning: समाधिम् मनसस् तेन विन्दते न एव मुह्यति | मयो भूर् वात इति तु गवाम् स्वस्त्ययने जपेत् ||
text_mt: By this he attains composure of mind [and] does not become bewildered; / and for the welfare of cows one should recite "Comfort-causing is the wind."

sanskrit_iast: yavānām tu ghṛta aktānām kārīṣe agnau samāhitaḥ | juhuyād goṣṭha madhye tu dadhi madhv ājya saṃskṛtān ||
meaning: यवानाम् तु घृत अक्तानाम् कारीषे अग्नौ समाहितः | जुहुयाद् गोष्ठ मध्ये तु दधि मध्व् आज्य संस्कृतान् ||
text_mt: Collected in mind, one should offer in the middle of a cow-pen into a dried-cow-dung fire / barley grains smeared with clarified butter and prepared with curd, honey, and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: rājānam abhiṣiñceta tiṣyeṇa śravaṇena vā | pauṣṇa sāvitra saumya aśvi rohiṇīṣu uttarāsu ca ||
meaning: राजानम् अभिषिञ्चेत तिष्येण श्रवणेन वा | पौष्ण सावित्र सौम्य अश्वि रोहिणीषु उत्तरासु च ||
text_mt: One should consecrate a king under [the lunar mansion] Tiṣya or Śravaṇa, / or under Pauṣṇa, Sāvitra, Saumya, Aśvī, Rohiṇī, and the Uttarās.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā agnim rāja liṅgābhiḥ sāvitryā prayataḥ śuciḥ | mahā vyāhṛtibhiś caiva sampāta abhihuto bhavet ||
meaning: हुत्वा अग्निम् राज लिङ्गाभिः सावित्र्या प्रयतः शुचिः | महा व्याहृतिभिश् चैव सम्पात अभिहुतो भवेत् ||
text_mt: Having offered into the fire with verses having royal marks, with the Sāvitrī, restrained and pure, / and with the great mystic utterances, he should be consecrated with the residues.

sanskrit_iast: sarva oṣadhi rasaiḥ ślakṣṇair nadīnām salilena ca | vyāghra carmaṇy atha āsīnam āsandyām abhiṣicya ca ||
meaning: सर्व ओषधि रसैः श्लक्ष्णैर् नदीनाम् सलिलेन च | व्याघ्र चर्मण्य् अथ आसीनम् आसन्द्याम् अभिषिच्य च ||
text_mt: With pure juices of all herbs and with water of rivers, / and having consecrated him seated on an āsandī-chair on a tiger-skin,

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhan pratyan mukho brūyāj jaya tvam pṛthivīm imām | dharmas te nikhilo rājan vardhatām pālayan prajāḥ ||
meaning: तिष्ठन् प्रत्यन् मुखो ब्रूयाज् जय त्वम् पृथिवीम् इमाम् | धर्मस् ते निखिलो राजन् वर्धताम् पालयन् प्रजाः ||
text_mt: standing facing the west, he should say: "Conquer you this earth; / may your entire virtue increase, O king, as you protect your subjects.

sanskrit_iast: vardhasva tvam śriyai puṣṭyai jayāya abhyudayāya ca | rājānaḥ santu te gotre tato apratiratham japet ||
meaning: वर्धस्व त्वम् श्रियै पुष्ट्यै जयाय अभ्युदयाय च | राजानः सन्तु ते गोत्रे ततो अप्रतिरथम् जपेत् ||
text_mt: Increase for splendor, for prosperity, for victory, and for elevation; / may there be kings in your lineage!" Then one should recite the Apratiratha hymn.

sanskrit_iast: vaiyāghram tu bhavet carma samid audumbarī bhavet | tir enam abhiṣicya evam dundubhīn abhimantrayet ||
meaning: वैयाघ्रम् तु भवेत् चर्म समिद् औदुम्बरी भवेत् | तिर् एनम् अभिषिच्य एवम् दुन्दुभीन् अभिमन्त्रयेत् ||
text_mt: The skin should be of a tiger; the kindling stick should be of udumbara; / having thrice consecrated him in this way, he should address the drums with mantras:

sanskrit_iast: prācyām tvā diśi vasavo abhiṣiñcantu tejase | dakṣiṇasyām tvā diśi rudrā abhiṣiñcantu vṛddhaye ||
meaning: प्राच्याम् त्वा दिशि वसवो अभिषिञ्चन्तु तेजसे | दक्षिणस्याम् त्वा दिशि रुद्रा अभिषिञ्चन्तु वृद्धये ||
text_mt: "In the eastern quarter may the Vasus consecrate you for splendor! / In the southern quarter may the Rudras consecrate you for growth!

sanskrit_iast: pratīcyām tvā diśy ādityā abhiṣiñcantu puṣṭaye | viśvedevā udīcyām tu abhiṣiñcantu śreyase ||
meaning: प्रतीच्याम् त्वा दिश्य् आदित्या अभिषिञ्चन्तु पुष्टये | विश्वेदेवा उदीच्याम् तु अभिषिञ्चन्तु श्रेयसे ||
text_mt: In the western quarter may the Ādityas consecrate you for prosperity! / And in the northern quarter may the Viśvedevas consecrate you for the highest good!"

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣicya ca rājānam āśīrbhir abhinandya ca | ā tvā ahārṣam antaredhī ity atha enam abhimantrayet ||
meaning: अभिषिच्य च राजानम् आशीर्भिर् अभिनन्द्य च | आ त्वा अहार्षम् अन्तरेधी इत्य् अथ एनम् अभिमन्त्रयेत् ||
text_mt: And having consecrated the king and greeted him with blessings, / one should then address him with the mantra "I have taken you; be within."

sanskrit_iast: pataṅgam iti nityam tu japed ajñāna bhedanam | māyā bhedanam etadd hi sarva māyāḥ prabādhate ||
meaning: पतङ्गम् इति नित्यम् तु जपेद् अज्ञान भेदनम् | माया भेदनम् एतद्द् हि सर्व मायाः प्रबाधते ||
text_mt: One should constantly recite "The bird..." which shatters ignorance; / for this shatters illusions and ward off all magical illusions.

sanskrit_iast: śāmbarīm indra jālām vā māyām etena vārayet | adṛṣṭānām ca sattvānām māyām etena bādhate ||
meaning: शाम्बरीम् इन्द्र जालाम् वा मायाम् एतेन वारयेत् | अदृष्टानाम् च सत्त्वानाम् मायाम् एतेन बाधते ||
text_mt: With this one should ward off the illusion of Śambara or sorcery; / and with this he wards off the illusion of unseen beings.

sanskrit_iast: tyamūṣv iti svastyayanam japeta niyata vrataḥ | puṣpam dṛṣṭvā tu yā garbham na gṛhṇīyād vayo anvitā ||
meaning: त्यमूष्व् इति स्वस्त्ययनम् जपेत नियत व्रतः | पुष्पम् दृष्ट्वा तु या गर्भम् न गृह्णीयाद् वयो अन्विता ||
text_mt: One of restrained vows should recite the welfare-prayer "Those indeed..."; / but a woman of suitable age who, having seen her menses, does not conceive,

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇur yonim nejameṣa yonim spṛṣṭvā tato japet | mahi trīṇām avo astv iti pathi svastyayane japet ||
meaning: विष्णुर् योनिम् नेजमेष योनिम् स्पृष्ट्वा ततो जपेत् | महि त्रीणाम् अवो अस्त्व् इति पथि स्वस्त्ययने जपेत् ||
text_mt: having touched her womb, one should then recite "Viṣṇu the womb..." and the Nejameṣa hymn; / for welfare on a road, one should recite "May the aid of the three great ones be [with us]..."

sanskrit_iast: pra agnaye atha dviṣad dveṣyam japed dveṣasya niṣkṛtim | āyam gauḥ sārparājñīs tu sarvān etena bādhate ||
meaning: प्र अग्नये अथ द्विषद् द्वेष्यम् जपेद् द्वेषस्य निष्कृतिम् | आयम् गौः सार्पराज्ञीस् तु सर्वान् एतेन बाधते ||
text_mt: Then [reciting] "Forward to Agni," an object of hatred to an enemy, one should recite the expiation of hatred; / with "This bull..." [and] the Sārparājñī hymns he wards off all [enemies].

sanskrit_iast: pavitrāṇām pavitram tu japed eva aghamarṣaṇam | apaḥ praviśya yaś ca etat triḥ paṭhet susamāhitaḥ ||
meaning: पवित्राणाम् पवित्रम् तु जपेद् एव अघमर्षणम् | अपः प्रविश्य यश् च एतत् त्रिः पठेत् सुसमाहितः ||
text_mt: One should recite the purifier of purifiers, the Aghamarṣaṇa; / and he who, having entered the waters, reads this thrice with a concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast: yathā aśva medha avabhṛthas tādṛśam manur abravīt | yathā aśva medhaḥ kratu rāṭ sarva pāpa praṇodanaḥ ||
meaning: यथा अश्व मेध अवभृथस् तादृशम् मनुर् अब्रवीत् | यथा अश्व मेधः क्रतु राट् सर्व पाप प्रणोदनः ||
text_mt: Manu declared it to be such as the concluding bath of an horse sacrifice; / just as the horse sacrifice, the king of rituals, is the expeller of all sins,

sanskrit_iast: tathā aghamarṣaṇam sūktam sarva pāpa praṇodanam | senā dāraṇam etat syān nairhastyam iti śaunakaḥ ||
meaning: तथा अघमर्षणम् सूक्तम् सर्व पाप प्रणोदनम् | सेना दारणम् एतत् स्यान् नैर्हस्त्यम् इति शौनकः ||
text_mt: so the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn is the expeller of all sins; / this would be the shattering of an army; "Loss of hands," says Śaunaka.

sanskrit_iast: manasādhyeyam etat tu manyate śaunakas tv ṛṣiḥ | sam samid yuvase vṛṣan saubhrātṛ karaṇam mahat ||
meaning: मनसाध्येयम् एतत् तु मन्यते शौनकस् त्व् ऋषिः | सम् समिद् युवसे वृषन् सौभ्रातृ करणम् महत् ||
text_mt: The ṛṣi Śaunaka considers that this is to be meditated upon in thought; / "You unite together, O bull" is a great maker of brotherhood.

sanskrit_iast: jñāti bhede prayuñjīta na bhidyante kadācana | kṛte bhede tu saṃjñānam etat saṃdhi karam japet ||
meaning: ज्ञाति भेदे प्रयुञ्जीत न भिद्यन्ते कदाचन | कृते भेदे तु संज्ञानम् एतत् संधि करम् जपेत् ||
text_mt: One should employ [it] when there is discord among kinsmen; they never divide. / But when division has occurred, one should mutter this Saṃjñāna [hymn], which creates concord.

sanskrit_iast: na tatra bhedo bhūyaḥ syād yatra etat satatam japet | tac śamyor ā vṛṇīmaha iti svastyayane japet ||
meaning: न तत्र भेदो भूयः स्याद् यत्र एतत् सततम् जपेत् | तच् शम्योर् आ वृणीमह इति स्वस्त्ययने जपेत् ||
text_mt: Division will not occur there again where one mutters this constantly. / One should mutter "tac chaṃyor ā vṛṇīmahe" in a rite for well-being.

sanskrit_iast: mahānāmnyaḥ param brahma śukram jyotiḥ sanātanam | sapatnaghnyaś ca puṇyāś ca pāvamānyaḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: महानाम्न्यः परम् ब्रह्म शुक्रम् ज्योतिः सनातनम् | सपत्नघ्न्यश् च पुण्याश् च पावमान्यः पराः स्मृताः ||
text_mt: The Mahānāmnī verses are the supreme Brahman, bright and eternal light. / And the Pāvamānī verses are considered supreme, slaying rivals and holy.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭi kāmo japec ca etā āpo hi ṣṭhāḥ sanātanāḥ | om kāra pūrvā vyāhṛtayo madhucchandasa āditaḥ ||
meaning: वृष्टि कामो जपेच् च एता आपो हि ष्ठाः सनातनाः | ओम् कार पूर्वा व्याहृतयो मधुच्छन्दस आदितः ||
text_mt: And one desiring rain should mutter these eternal [verses], "āpo hi ṣṭhā". / Preceded by the syllable Om and the mystic utterances, beginning with Madhucchandas,

sanskrit_iast: sūktāny ante mahānāmnyaḥ saṃhitā sā amṛtā smṛtā | amṛtatvam yayur devāḥ pūrvam sahitayā anayā ||
meaning: सूक्तान्य् अन्ते महानाम्न्यः संहिता सा अमृता स्मृता | अमृतत्वम् ययुर् देवाः पूर्वम् सहितया अनया ||
text_mt: [and] the hymns ending with the Mahānāmnī verses: that Saṃhitā is considered immortal. / By means of this Saṃhitā the gods formerly attained immortality.

sanskrit_iast: japed etām śucir nityam amṛtatvam sa gacchati | atra eva tv āvapen madhye pitṛ sūktāny anekaśaḥ ||
meaning: जपेद् एताम् शुचिर् नित्यम् अमृतत्वम् स गच्छति | अत्र एव त्व् आवपेन् मध्ये पितृ सूक्तान्य् अनेकशः ||
text_mt: Being pure, one should mutter this constantly; he goes to immortality. / But right here in the middle one should insert the Pitṛ hymns in various places.

sanskrit_iast: pitryām tām saṃhitām vidyāt pitṝn prīṇāti ca etayā | evam eva samāhṛtya vāsavī saṃhitā bhavet ||
meaning: पित्र्याम् ताम् संहिताम् विद्यात् पितॄन् प्रीणाति च एतया | एवम् एव समाहृत्य वासवी संहिता भवेत् ||
text_mt: One should know that to be a Pitṛ-Saṃhitā, and by it one pleases the ancestors. / In the very same way, by bringing together [appropriate hymns], it becomes a Vāsavī-Saṃhitā,

sanskrit_iast: raudra ādityā vaiśvadevī yad devatyām ca kāmayet | kurvīta vāstu śamanam madhye goṣṭhasya dharmavit ||
meaning: रौद्र आदित्या वैश्वदेवी यद् देवत्याम् च कामयेत् | कुर्वीत वास्तु शमनम् मध्ये गोष्ठस्य धर्मवित् ||
text_mt: a Raudrī, an Ādityā, a Vaiśvadevī, or dedicated to whatever deity one may desire. / One who knows dharma should perform the pacification of the homestead in the middle of the cowpen.

sanskrit_iast: puṣpair gandhairś ca mālyaiś ca vānaspatyais tathā auṣadhaiḥ | vāstu sarvam pratikiret sapta dhānyais tathaiva ca ||
meaning: पुष्पैर् गन्धैर्श् च माल्यैश् च वानस्पत्यैस् तथा औषधैः | वास्तु सर्वम् प्रतिकिरेत् सप्त धान्यैस् तथैव च ||
text_mt: With flowers, perfumes, and garlands, with forest-trees and herbs, / and likewise with the seven grains, he should scatter over the entire homestead site.

sanskrit_iast: vāstoṣpatim yajec ca atra pāyasena bṛhaspatim | audumbara palāśaiś ca balim pratidiśam haret ||
meaning: वास्तोष्पतिम् यजेच् च अत्र पायसेन बृहस्पतिम् | औदुम्बर पलाशैश् च बलिम् प्रतिदिशम् हरेत् ||
text_mt: And there he should sacrifice to Vāstoṣpati and to Bṛhaspati with milk-rice, / and offer an oblation in every direction with udumbara and palāśa [leaves].

sanskrit_iast: sūryo vāyur yamaḥ pitaro varuṇo nirṛtis tathā | somo mahā indra ity etā dikṣu vai devatāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: सूर्यो वायुर् यमः पितरो वरुणो निरृतिस् तथा | सोमो महा इन्द्र इत्य् एता दिक्षु वै देवताः स्मृताः ||
text_mt: Sūrya, Vāyu, Yama, the Pitṛs, Varuṇa, and Nirṛti, / Soma, and Mahā-Indra—these indeed are considered the deities in the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: dadyād dānam brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śivam bhavati vāstuni | pratisaṃvatsaram kāryam gṛhe vai gṛhamedhinā ||
meaning: दद्याद् दानम् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः शिवम् भवति वास्तुनि | प्रतिसंवत्सरम् कार्यम् गृहे वै गृहमेधिना ||
text_mt: He should give a gift to the brahmins; auspiciousness comes upon the homestead. / It must be performed in the house year after year by the householder.

sanskrit_iast: yady evam savidham ca anyad anuktam api kiṃcana | agnim indram atho vāyum sūryam anyāś ca devatāḥ ||
meaning: यद्य् एवम् सविधम् च अन्यद् अनुक्तम् अपि किंचन | अग्निम् इन्द्रम् अथो वायुम् सूर्यम् अन्याश् च देवताः ||
text_mt: If there is any other rite of this kind, even if unstated, / [directed to] Agni, Indra, as well as Vāyu, Sūrya, and the other deities,

sanskrit_iast: ārirādhāyaṣur yām yām abhidhāveta devatām | abhirūpeṇa sūktena yathā ādiṣṭam prayojanam ||
meaning: आरिराधायषुर् याम् याम् अभिधावेत देवताम् | अभिरूपेण सूक्तेन यथा आदिष्टम् प्रयोजनम् ||
text_mt: whichever deity one wishes to propitiate and runs toward, / [one should do so] with a suitable hymn according to the prescribed purpose.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣīṇām mantra dṛṣṭena pratyakṣā siddhir iṣyate | sarvatra dakṣiṇām dadyād dhanam vā karma siddhaye ||
meaning: ऋषीणाम् मन्त्र दृष्टेन प्रत्यक्षा सिद्धिर् इष्यते | सर्वत्र दक्षिणाम् दद्याद् धनम् वा कर्म सिद्धये ||
text_mt: Magical accomplishment is directly perceived through that which was seen in mantras by the ṛṣis. / One should give a priestly fee everywhere, or wealth, for the accomplishment of the rite.

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva adakṣiṇam karma kiṃcid asti iti śaunakaḥ | śaktyā hi pūrṇa pātreṇa sammitā apy antato bhavet ||
meaning: न त्व् एव अदक्षिणम् कर्म किंचिद् अस्ति इति शौनकः | शक्त्या हि पूर्ण पात्रेण सम्मिता अप्य् अन्ततो भवेत् ||
text_mt: "There is no rite whatever without a priestly fee," says Śaunaka. / For according to one's ability, it may at least be equal to a full vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt svalpā api dātavyā dakṣiṇā karma siddhaye | ṛṣabha ekādaśā dadyād yena vā tuṣyate guruḥ |
meaning: तस्मात् स्वल्पा अपि दातव्या दक्षिणा कर्म सिद्धये | ऋषभ एकादशा दद्याद् येन वा तुष्यते गुरुः |
text_mt: Therefore even a very small priestly fee should be given for the accomplishment of the rite. / He may give eleven cattle with a bull, or whatever pleases the guru.

sanskrit_iast: dharmajñe satya vādini brahma dānam ca dīyate || tad idam param brahma guhyam pāvanam adbhutam |
meaning: धर्मज्ञे सत्य वादिनि ब्रह्म दानम् च दीयते || तद् इदम् परम् ब्रह्म गुह्यम् पावनम् अद्भुतम् |
text_mt: And the gift of the Veda is given to one who knows dharma and speaks the truth. / This is the supreme Brahman, secret, purifying, and wonderful.

sanskrit_iast: na apraśāntāya dātavyam na aputrāya atapasvine | na asaṃvatsara uṣitāya na aśiṣyāya ahitāya ca ||
meaning: न अप्रशान्ताय दातव्यम् न अपुत्राय अतपस्विने | न असंवत्सर उषिताय न अशिष्याय अहिताय च ||
text_mt: It should not be given to one who is not tranquil, not to one without a son, nor to one devoid of ascetic heat, / not to one who has not resided for a year, not to a non-pupil, nor to one who is unfavourably disposed.

sanskrit_iast: narāṇām bhāgya hīnānām ṛgvidhānam ajānatām | ṛgvedaḥ kalpa vṛkṣo ayam phalam naiva prayacchati ||
meaning: नराणाम् भाग्य हीनानाम् ऋग्विधानम् अजानताम् | ऋग्वेदः कल्प वृक्षो अयम् फलम् नैव प्रयच्छति ||
text_mt: For men devoid of fortune who do not know the Ṛgvidhāna, / this Ṛgveda, though a wish-fulfilling tree, yields no fruit at all.

sanskrit_iast: ratna garbha iva āvāsa ṛgvedaḥ pratibhāti me | ṛgvidhāna pardīpena vinā naiva prakāśate ||
meaning: रत्न गर्भ इव आवास ऋग्वेदः प्रतिभाति मे | ऋग्विधान पर्दीपेन विना नैव प्रकाशते ||
text_mt: The Ṛgveda appears to me like a dwelling full of gems; / without the lamp of the Ṛgvidhāna it does not shine forth at all.

sanskrit_iast: ratnākara iva udāra ṛgvedo atyanta duṣṭaraḥ | ṛgvidhāna mahā potam vinā naiva phala pradaḥ ||
meaning: रत्नाकर इव उदार ऋग्वेदो अत्यन्त दुष्टरः | ऋग्विधान महा पोतम् विना नैव फल प्रदः ||
text_mt: Like the ocean, generous, the Ṛgveda is exceedingly difficult to cross; / without the great ship of the Ṛgvidhāna it does not bestow its fruit at all.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvedaḥ pathito hy eṣa nṛṇām bhavati nihphalaḥ | ṛgvidhānam vinā tasmād adhyeyam tat prayatnataḥ ||
meaning: ऋग्वेदः पथितो ह्य् एष नृणाम् भवति निह्फलः | ऋग्विधानम् विना तस्माद् अध्येयम् तत् प्रयत्नतः ||
text_mt: For this Ṛgveda, when recited without the Ṛgvidhāna, / becomes fruitless for men; therefore it must be studied with effort.

sanskrit_iast: sūkta tattva artha kathanam ṛgvidhānam avaiti yaḥ | ṛgvedo jāyate tasya prasādāt phulla mānasaḥ ||
meaning: सूक्त तत्त्व अर्थ कथनम् ऋग्विधानम् अवैति यः | ऋग्वेदो जायते तस्य प्रसादात् फुल्ल मानसः ||
text_mt: He who knows the Ṛgvidhāna, which declares the true meaning of the hymns, / finds that through its grace his mind blooms with the Ṛgveda.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣyam sampado mūlam sarva kalmaṣa nāśanam | ṛgvidhāna abhyanuṣṭhānam śubhra kīrti karam param ||
meaning: आयुष्यम् सम्पदो मूलम् सर्व कल्मष नाशनम् | ऋग्विधान अभ्यनुष्ठानम् शुभ्र कीर्ति करम् परम् ||
text_mt: It brings longevity, is the root of wealth, destroys all stain; / the practice of the Ṛgvidhāna is supreme, producing radiant renown.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvidhānena samyuktam ṛgvedam vetti yo dvijaḥ | dharma artha kāma mokṣāṇām āśrayaḥ sa bhaved dhruvam ||
meaning: ऋग्विधानेन सम्युक्तम् ऋग्वेदम् वेत्ति यो द्विजः | धर्म अर्थ काम मोक्षाणाम् आश्रयः स भवेद् ध्रुवम् ||
text_mt: The twice-born who knows the Ṛgveda joined with the Ṛgvidhāna / surely becomes a resting-place of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: vedeṣu prathamo veda āyurveda nidhiḥ prabhuḥ | ṛgvidhāna sadābhyāsād atīva parituṣyati ||
meaning: वेदेषु प्रथमो वेद आयुर्वेद निधिः प्रभुः | ऋग्विधान सदाभ्यासाद् अतीव परितुष्यति ||
text_mt: The master, the first Veda among the Vedas, a treasury of long life, / is exceedingly pleased by the constant study of the Ṛgvidhāna.

sanskrit_iast: śatru nāśam manas tuṣṭim suhṛj jana samāgamān | ṛgvedaḥ prayantā nityam ṛgvidhānena toṣitaḥ ||
meaning: शत्रु नाशम् मनस् तुष्टिम् सुहृज् जन समागमान् | ऋग्वेदः प्रयन्ता नित्यम् ऋग्विधानेन तोषितः ||
text_mt: Destruction of enemies, satisfaction of the mind, association with friends— / the Ṛgveda, pleased by the Ṛgvidhāna, bestows these constantly.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvedam vetti yaḥ sāṅgam ṛgvidhāna rataḥ sadā | mano rathād apy adhikam bhavet tasya samīhitam ||
meaning: ऋग्वेदम् वेत्ति यः साङ्गम् ऋग्विधान रतः सदा | मनो रथाद् अप्य् अधिकम् भवेत् तस्य समीहितम् ||
text_mt: He who knows the Ṛgveda with its ancillary limbs, always devoted to the Ṛgvidhāna, / his desire will be greater even than the wish of his heart.

sanskrit_iast: kule janmani śīle vā prajñāyām udyame api ca | ṛgvidhāna parijñānād uśanti carita arthatām ||
meaning: कुले जन्मनि शीले वा प्रज्ञायाम् उद्यमे अपि च | ऋग्विधान परिज्ञानाद् उशन्ति चरित अर्थताम् ||
text_mt: In family, birth, or character, in wisdom, or also in effort, / they consider one's purpose fulfilled through thorough knowledge of the Ṛgvidhāna.

sanskrit_iast: tuṣyanti devatāḥ sarvāḥ sampadyante vibhūtayaḥ | durādhayaḥ praṇaśyanti nityam ṛg vidhi pāṭhinām ||
meaning: तुष्यन्ति देवताः सर्वाः सम्पद्यन्ते विभूतयः | दुराधयः प्रणश्यन्ति नित्यम् ऋग् विधि पाठिनाम् ||
text_mt: All deities are pleased, manifestations of power are attained, / and deep afflictions vanish for those who daily recite the rules of the Ṛgveda.
